ru:
Отдел Внутренней Безопасности:
Ваша попытка безосновательной передачи важных архивных документов пресечена. Мы следим за вами, коллега.

Department of Internal Security:
Your attempt to unlawfully transfer important archival documents has been thwarted. We're keeping an eye on you, colleague.
ko:
내부 보안부:
중요 공문서를 불법 유출하려던 시도는 저지되었습니다. 동료여, 계속 지켜보고 있겠습니다.

ru: Отчёт: За гражданкой Сельдь действительно установлено наблюдение. Один из преследователей был идентифицирован как "Полуночник". Гражданка спасена.
en: Report: Citizen Herring is indeed under surveillance. One of the pursuers has been identified as "Night Owl." The citizen has been rescued.
ko: 보고서: 시민 헤링은 실제로 감시를 받고 있습니다. 추격자 중 한 명은 ‘밤올빼미’로 확인되었으며, 해당 시민은 무사히 구출되었습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)
detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_13_1
ru: Сводка Происшествий: Гражданка Эмма Сельдь помещена в психиатрическую лечебницу с диагнозом "шизофрения".
en: Incident Summary: Citizen Emma Herring was placed in a psychiatric hospital with a diagnosis of schizophrenia.
ko: 사건 요약: 시민 엠마 헤링은 조현병 진단을 받아 정신병원에 입원했습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)
detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_11_1
ru: Отчёт: Не выявлены признаки угрозы. Женщина проявляет признаки тревожного расстройства. Отказалась от медицинской помощи.
en: Report: No signs of danger were identified. The woman exhibited signs of anxiety disorder. She refused medical attention.
ko: 보고서: 위험 징후는 확인되지 않았습니다. 해당 여성은 불안 장애 증세를 보였으나 치료를 거부했습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)
detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_3_1
ru: Отчёт: Девочка найдена в доме подруги. Никаких признаков «Красной Двери» не обнаружено. Ложный вызов. Ребёнку проведена профилактическая беседа
en: Report: The girl was found at a friend's house. No signs of the "Red Door" were found. It was a false alarm. The child was given a preventative interview.
ko: 보고서: 소녀는 친구 집에서 발견되었습니다. ‘붉은 문’의 흔적은 전혀 발견되지 않았으며, 허위 신고로 확인되어 아이에게 예방 면담을 실시했습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)
detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_4_1
ru: Сводка происшествий: Девочка пропала без следа. Несколько дней спустя в районе связь с двумя патрульными прервалась.
en: Incident summary: The girl disappeared without a trace. Several days later, contact with two patrol officers in the area was lost.
ko: 사건 요약: 소녀가 흔적도 없이 실종되었습니다. 며칠 뒤, 해당 구역을 순찰하던 경찰관 두 명과의 연락도 두절되었습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)

en:
Department of Internal Security:

An investigation has been launched against a certain citizen, "-M."
ko:
내부 보안부:

‘-M.’이라는 시민을 대상으로 수사가 개시되었습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)

ru:
Какой вы правильный человек, <username>. Но я уже нашёл другой способ получить желаемое, в другой раз советую подумать получше. 

-М.
en:
What a wonderful person you are, <username>. But I've already found another way to get what I want; next time, I suggest you think twice.

-M.
ko:
<username>, 정말 훌륭한 분이시군요. 하지만 저는 이미 원하는 것을 얻을 방법을 찾았습니다. 다음에는 두 번 생각해 보시길 권합니다.

-M.

ru: Сводка происшествий: Зафиксировано исчезновение гражданки Сельдь. Проишествие классифицировано как «похищение». Разбирательства отдела прекращены.
en: Incident Summary: Ms. Seld has been reported missing. The incident has been classified as a kidnapping. The department's investigation has been closed.
ko: 사건 요약: 시민 헤링이 실종 신고되었습니다. 본 사건은 납치 사건으로 분류되었으며, 부서 차원의 조사는 종결되었습니다.

detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_7_1

en: Report: Irvin Lemsh has successfully passed his recertification. The surveillance department has not detected any suspicious activity.
ko: 보고서: 어빈 렘시가 재신임 심사를 무사히 통과했습니다. 감시 부서에서도 별다른 수상한 동향은 포착하지 못했습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)
detail: Encounters_Chancellery Encounters_Chancellery Secretary's Greeting Encounter_Scenes_Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)_Text_5_1
ru: Сводка происшествий: Жалоба от ребёнка не  подтвердилась. Впоследствии девочка вернулась домой. Родители сообщили, что она была у родственников.
en: Incident summary: The child's complaint was not confirmed. The girl subsequently returned home. Her parents reported that she was visiting relatives.
ko: 사건 요약: 아이의 신고 내용은 사실이 아닌 것으로 확인되었습니다. 소녀는 이후 집으로 돌아왔으며, 부모는 딸이 친척 집에 다녀온 것이라고 진술했습니다.

context: Checking Results (Scene - Chancellery Secretary's Greeting)

ru: Отчёт: Ирвин Лемш успешно прошёл переаттестацию. Сотрудник вновь был замечен с людьми подозреваемыми в участии в Заговоре.
en: Report: Irvin Lemsh successfully passed his recertification. The employee was again seen with individuals suspected of involvement in the Conspiracy.
ko: 보고서: 어빈 렘시는 재신임 심사를 통과했습니다. 그러나 해당 직원이 비밀결사 가담 혐의자들과 접촉하는 모습이 다시 목격되었습니다.

en: Report: A special unit found a suspicious Red Door in the designated area. The girl was rescued during a rescue operation.
ko: 보고서: 특수 부대가 지정 구역에서 수상한 ‘붉은 문’을 발견했습니다. 구조 작전을 통해 소녀를 무사히 구출했습니다.

en: Report: Following a re-examination, Irvin Lemsh was arrested in connection with the proven fact of collaboration with the participants of the Conspiracy

ko: 아가, 이제 네가 영원히 머물 집의 주춧돌을 놓았구나. 그 집도 너처럼 살아서 자라날 거야.

ko: 그걸 네게 주마. 이제 네 것이란다!

en: Don't be afraid of anything. Your Home needs its own place, and it just happens to be here.
ko: 아무것도 겁낼 것 없다. 네 보금자리에도 터가 필요한 법이고, 마침 여기가 그 자리인 게지.

ko: 빌어먹을! 두목 놈들은 도망쳤어! 코앞에서 놓치다니!

context: Crisis Start (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Crisis Start (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Расплачиваться тебе. Вези его в участок!
en: But it will be you who has to pay for everything. Take this thug to the station!
ko: 하지만 대가는 네놈이 치러야 할 거다. 이놈을 유치장으로 끌고 가라!

en: Police of the Republic! You are under arrest for robbery attempt!
ko: 공화국 경찰이다! 강도 미수 혐의로 체포한다!

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Действуем быстро и нагло, и так же уходим. Ладно, Берта, командуй своими.
en: We act quickly and brazenly, and then we leave the same way. Okay, Bertha, give your crew their orders.
ko: 재빠르고 대담하게 치고, 빠질 때도 그렇게 빠진다. 좋아, 베르타, 부하들에게 명령을 내려.

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ну что, Берта! Готова твоя шайка?
en: Well, Bertha! Is your gang ready?

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1

en: Okay, listen up, you scoundrels. We're taking on the treasury warehouse. My man whispered to me that a box full of gold was delivered there yesterday.
ko: 자, 잘 들어라, 이 교수대에 목 매달릴 놈들아. 목표는 국고 창고다. 내 정보원이 귀띔하길, 어제 거기에 금괴 상자가 잔뜩 들어왔다더군.

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Банда, слушай сюда! Лютый — на тебе охрана. Разберешься с ними по-своему. Игла — пролезешь внутрь, откроешь нам изнутри.
en: Listen up, gang! Scamp—the guard is on you. You'll deal with them your way. Needle—you'll crawl inside and open the door for us from the inside.
ko: 패거리들, 잘 들어! 스캠프—경비는 네 몫이다. 네 방식대로 처리해. 니들—넌 기어들어가서 안쪽에서 문을 열어.

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
en: Don't teach me how to do my job, Diamond Jack.
ko: 내가 알아서 해, 다이아몬드 잭. 훈수 두지 마.

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Ну а тебя, <username>, мы пока что испытываем. Внутрь не лезь. Стой на шухере!
en: Well, <username>, we're still testing you. You're not going inside. Stay on the lookout!
ko: 그리고 <username>, 넌 아직 검증 단계다. 안으로 들어갈 생각 마. 망이나 보고 있어!

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_35-2 - (Hero Generation) Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction (Encounter)_Scenes_Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Волноваться тебе надо, Берта. Запорет дело кто-то из твоих новобранцев — отвечать тебе!
en: It's you who should be worried, Bertha. If one of your new recruits screws things up, you'll be the one to answer for it!
ko: 걱정해야 할 건 너야, 베르타. 네 신참 놈 중 하나가 일을 그르치면 네가 책임지는 거다!

context: Big Crime Exposition (Scene - Fugitive - Big Crime Recruitment Interaction)

ko: <username>, 무슨 말인지 안다네. 이런 것들은 말로 설명하기가 가장 어려운 법이지. 그러니 굳이 말하진 말자꾸나.

ko: 일련의 사건들은 당신 안에 꺾이지 않는 자존과 존엄을 심어주었다.

ko: 결정적인 순간에 그 연민이 자네에게 힘을 실어주기를!

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Mercy (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Что ж, как видишь, на нашем пути не только теряешь, но иногда и находишь.
en: As you see, on this path of ours you not only lose. Sometimes you also gain something.
ko: 보다시피, 우리가 걷는 이 길에서 잃기만 하는 건 아니라네. 때로는 새로운 것을 얻기도 하지.

context: Principle Change - Mercy (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Mercy (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Связь с другими. Участие в их судьбе. Ничего этого так долго не было во мне.
en: Connection with others. Participation in their fate. None of this had mattered to me for so long.
ko: 타인과의 연대. 그들의 운명에 함께하는 것. 아주 오랫동안 내 안에서 사라졌던 감정들이다.

context: Principle Change - Mercy (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Description
ru: Последние события принесли в вас сострадание.
en: Recent events have awakened a force of compassion in you.
ko: 최근의 사건들이 당신 안에 연민의 불씨를 되살렸습니다.

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
en: Now it will nourish me.
ko: 이제 그것이 내 원동력이 될 것이다.

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: Hatred.

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Name
en: Hatred

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Но как бы то ни было, пусть эта ненависть даст тебе сил в решающий момент!
en: But be that as it may, let this hatred give you strength at the decisive moment!
ko: 어찌 되었든, 결정적인 순간에 그 증오가 자네에게 힘이 되기를 바라네!

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Ненависть — огромная сила. Но обуздать ее удается немногим.
en: Hatred is a powerful force, but few can harness it.
ko: 증오는 막강한 힘이지만, 그것을 온전히 다룰 수 있는 자는 드물지.

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Это утро принесло мне столько ненависти к моим врагам, что она не вмещается в меня.
en: This morning has brought me so much hatred for my enemies that it is bursting outside of me.
ko: 오늘 아침, 적들을 향한 증오가 가슴이 터져나갈 정도로 차올랐다.

context: Principle Change - Hatred (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Description
ru: Последние события принесли в вас ненависть.
en: Recent events have brought hatred into you.
ko: 최근의 사건들은 당신의 마음속에 증오를 심어주었다.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: И это — не трусость. Это — необходимое условие для всего, к чему можно стремиться. Сначала нужно спасти себя. Только затем появляется шанс спасти других.
en: And this isn't cowardice. It's a necessary condition for anything worth striving for. First, you must save yourself. Only then will you have the chance to save others.
ko: 이건 비겁한 게 아니야. 무언가를 이루고자 한다면 반드시 갖춰야 할 전제조건이지. 먼저 스스로를 구해야 해. 그래야 다른 이들을 구할 기회도 생기는 법이니까.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: Own life.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Name
en: Own life

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Но лишь бы это помогало тебе двигаться дальше. А живой заговорщик все равно ценнее мертвого. Уж поверь моему опыту.
en: But as long as it helps you move forward. And a living conspirator is still more valuable than a dead one. Trust me, I'm speaking from experience.
ko: 자네가 앞으로 나아가는 데 도움이 된다면야 상관없네. 어쨌거나 살아있는 결사원이 죽은 결사원보다 훨씬 값진 법이니까. 내 경험에서 우러나온 말이니 믿어도 좋아.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Твои рассуждения стройны, <username>. Но, как ты понимаешь, я уже своей жизни лишился и потому полностью с тобой согласиться не могу.
en: Your reasoning is sound, <username>. But, as you understand, I've already lost my life, and therefore I can't fully agree with you.
ko: <username>, 조리 있는 생각이네만. 알다시피 난 이미 목숨을 잃은 처지라, 자네 말에 온전히 동의할 수는 없구려.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Мне стало ясно, что я <male>недооценивал</male><female>недооценивала</female> ее важность. Ничто невозможно без того, чтобы моя жизнь продолжалась.
en: It became clear to me that I had underestimated its importance. Nothing else is possible without my survival.
ko: 내가 삶의 중요성을 너무 과소평가했음을 깨달았다. 내가 살아남지 못한다면 다른 어떤 것도 불가능하다.

context: Principle Change - Survival (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Description
ru: Вы научились ценить собственную жизнь, без которой невозможно все прочее.
en: You have learned to value your own life, without which everything else is impossible.
ko: 당신은 자신의 목숨을 소중히 여기는 법을 배웠다. 목숨 없이는 그 무엇도 이룰 수 없기 때문이다.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Оно важнее меня. Я — это и есть оно.
en: It is more important than me. It is what I am.
ko: 그것은 나보다 중요하다. 그것이 곧 나 자신이다.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: The cause.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Name
en: The Cause

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Держись его. А Заговор будет держаться тебя. Так мы и добьемся своего.
en: Hold on to it. And the Conspiracy will hold on to you. That's how we'll prevail.
ko: 그 뜻을 놓지 말게. 그러면 비밀결사도 자네를 붙잡아 줄 테니. 그렇게 우리는 승리할 걸세.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: И ради этого дела можно вытерпеть что угодно.
en: And for the sake of this cause one can endure anything.
ko: 그리고 이 대업을 위해서라면 무엇이든 견뎌낼 수 있다.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Рад, что наш Заговор затронул тебя так глубоко.
en: I'm glad our Conspiracy touched you so deeply.
ko: 우리 비밀결사가 자네의 마음을 이토록 깊이 울렸다니 기쁘구려.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: I gained it today.

context: Principle Change - Cause (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Reflection Hub_Description
ru: Вы обрели дело жизни, которое неутомимо ведет вас за собой.
en: You have found a cause that will tirelessly lead you forward.
ko: 당신은 지치지 않고 앞으로 이끌어 줄 필생의 사명을 찾았다.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: You got out, <username>!

context: Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Здесь нам пока что опасаться нечего. Считай это моментом покоя, пусть и коротким.
en: There's nothing to fear for now. Consider this a moment of respite, brief as it is.
ko: 이곳에선 당분간 걱정할 것 없네. 비록 짧지만 잠깐의 휴식이라 여기게나.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: Hello!

context: Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Нелегко пришлось с Бессмертными? То ли еще будет...
en: Things haven't been easy with the Immortals? There's more to come...
ko: 불멸의 근위대 놈들을 상대하느라 고생깨나 했지? 앞으로는 더할 걸세...

context: Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: How are you holding up?

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Name
en: Share the hardships

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Пока же придется рассчитывать только на свои силы. Ну и на мою посильную помощь!
en: For now, you'll have to rely solely on your own strength. Well, and on any help I can provide!
ko: 당분간은 자네 자신의 힘에만 의지해야 할 걸세. 뭐, 내가 힘닿는 데까지 돕긴 하겠지만!

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Еле <male>сумел</male><female>сумела</female> вырваться. Еще пара таких погонь, и, боюсь, вы недосчитаетесь заговорщика...
en: I barely managed to escape. A couple more chases like this, and you'll be missing one conspirator...
ko: 간신히 빠져나왔습니다. 이런 추격을 몇 번만 더 겪었다간 결사원 하나 잃으실 겁니다...

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Доберись до Брокена. Там рядом с тобой встанут остальные. Они прикроют в нужный момент.
en: Get to Brocken. The others will stand by your side there. They'll cover you when needed.
ko: 브로켄으로 가게. 그곳에서는 다른 동지들이 자네 곁을 지켜줄 걸세. 필요할 때 엄호도 해줄 테고.

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Держись, друг. Обманывать не стану — дальше будет только труднее.
en: Hang in there, friend. I won't lie to you—it's only going to get harder.
ko: 버텨내게, 친구. 거짓말은 하지 않겠네 — 앞으로 갈수록 더 험난해질 거야.

context: Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Hard (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Но помни, ты больше <male>не один</male><female>не одна</female>!
en: But remember, you are not alone anymore!
ko: 하지만 기억하게, 자네는 이제 더 이상 혼자가 아니네!

context: Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Если это всё, что Траумы могут нам противопоставить — я не переживаю.
en: If this is all that the Traums can do against us, I'm not worried.
ko: 트라움 가문 놈들이 내세울 수 있는 게 고작 이 정도라면, 전 걱정 없습니다.

context: Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Рад, что тебе не пришлось тяжко. Но недооценивать врага опасно. В другой раз тебе может повезти меньше.
en: I'm glad you didn't have to deal with it. But it's dangerous to underestimate your enemy. You might be not so lucky next time.
ko: 크게 고생하지 않았다니 다행이네. 허나 적을 얕보는 건 위험해. 다음엔 이번만큼 운이 따르지 않을 수도 있으니.

context: Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Name
en: There were no difficulties

ru: Пока же придется рассчитывать только на свои силы. Ну и на мою посильную помощь!
en: For now, you'll have to rely solely on your own strength. And on any help I can provide!
ko: 당분간은 자네 자신의 힘에만 의지해야 할 걸세. 물론 내가 힘닿는 데까지 돕긴 하겠지만!

context: Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: I handled it without even trying.

context: Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Light (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Доберись до Брокена. Там рядом с тобой встанут остальные. Они прикроют в нужный момент.
en: Get to Brocken. The others will stand by your side there. They'll cover you when needed.
ko: 브로켄으로 가게. 그곳에서는 다른 동지들이 자네 곁을 지켜줄 걸세. 필요할 때 엄호도 해줄 테고.

ru: Рад слышать. Обманывать не стану — дальше будет только труднее.
en: Glad to hear it. I won't lie—it will only get harder from here.
ko: 다행이로군. 거짓말은 않겠네 — 앞으로는 갈수록 더 힘들어질 거야.

ru: Пока же придется рассчитывать только на свои силы. Ну и на мою посильную помощь!
en: For now, you'll have to rely solely on your own strength. And on any help I can provide!
ko: 당분간은 자네 자신의 힘에만 의지해야 할 걸세. 물론 내가 힘닿는 데까지 돕긴 하겠지만!

context: Normal (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)

en: But I think I can handle it.
ko: 하지만 해낼 수 있을 것 같습니다.

context: Normal (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Actions_Actions - Greeting_Normal (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Доберись до Брокена. Там рядом с тобой встанут остальные. Они прикроют в нужный момент.
en: Get to Brocken. The others will stand by your side there. They'll cover you when needed.
ko: 브로켄으로 가게. 그곳에서는 다른 동지들이 자네 곁을 지켜줄 걸세. 필요할 때 엄호도 해줄 테고.

ru: По-моему, они как раз говорят о тебе, <username>... Заглянем к ним?
en: I think they're talking about you right now, <username>... Shall we take a peek?
ko: 지금 놈들이 자네에 대해 이야기하고 있는 것 같군, <username>... 슬쩍 엿볼 텐가?

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Что делать в первую очередь? Зависит от того, что уже знает о тебе Семья Траум...
en: What should you do first? It depends on what the Traum Family already knows about you...
ko: 무엇을 먼저 해야 할까? 그건 트라움 가문이 자네에 대해 이미 얼마나 파악했는지에 달렸지...

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Чтобы добраться до поезда, тебе придется успеть многое. Добыть въездные документы. Озаботиться маскировкой. Пройти допрос с пристрастием.
en: To get to the train, you'll have to do a lot. Obtain entry documents. Find a disguise. Endure a severe interrogation.
ko: 기차에 오르기까지 처리해야 할 일이 많네. 입국 통행증도 구해야 하고. 변장도 신경 써야 하고. 혹독한 심문도 버텨내야 하지.

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Пора планировать наши следующие шаги, и быстро. Мы должны вытащить тебя из Столицы, пока до тебя снова не добрались подручные Семьи.
en: It's time to plan our next steps, and quickly. We need to get you out of the Capital before the Family's henchmen get to you again.
ko: 어서 다음 계획을 세워야 하네, 서둘러야 해. 가문의 수하들이 다시 자네를 덮치기 전에 수도에서 빼내야 하니까.

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Время быстро истекает. Каждый час на счету!
en: Time is running out fast. Every hour counts!

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Тебе придется быстро решать, что предпринять и куда отправиться, прежде чем на Вокзале пробьет полночь.
en: You'll have to quickly decide what to do and where to go before midnight strikes at the Train Station.
ko: 역의 시계가 자정을 치기 전에, 무엇을 하고 어디로 향할지 신속히 결정해야 하네.

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Что ж, здесь мы проводим черту. Хватит о прошлом. Пора обратиться к делам будущим.
en: Well, that's where we draw the line. Enough about the past. Time to think of the future.
ko: 자, 지난 일은 여기까지 매듭짓도록 하지. 과거는 털어버리고, 다가올 미래를 생각할 때야.

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Сегодня в полночь тебе надо во что бы то ни стало сесть на последний поезд в Брокен!
en: This midnight you must catch the last train to Brocken at all costs!
ko: 오늘 밤 자정에 브로켄행 마지막 기차를 무슨 일이 있어도 타야만 하네!

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Я нанес на твою карту пометки. Это места, где ты сумеешь добыть всё необходимое для выезда. И убежище, где можно затаиться и подготовиться.
en: I've put some marks on your map. These are the places where you can find everything you need for your getaway. And a hideout where you can lay low and prepare.
ko: 자네 지도에 몇 군데 표시를 해 두었네. 탈출에 필요한 물품들을 구할 수 있는 장소들이지. 그리고 몸을 숨기고 채비를 갖출 은신처도 있네.

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter_Scenes_Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Если они успели многое раскрыть о тебе, то они задействуют всё свое влияние, чтобы объявить тебя в розыск по всей Столице. Тогда дела плохи...
en: If they've managed to uncover too much about you, they'll use all their influence to put you on the Capital's wanted list. Then we're in trouble...
ko: 놈들이 자네에 대해 너무 많은 걸 알아냈다면, 온갖 연줄을 동원해 수도 전역에 수배령을 내릴 걸세. 그렇게 되면 일이 아주 꼬이지...

context: Briefing (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Payphone Interaction Encounter)

ru: Ну, не они одни умеют залезать в чужие мысли.
en: Fortunately, they are not the only ones who know how to get into other people’s thoughts.
ko: 다행인 건, 남의 머릿속을 들여다볼 줄 아는 게 놈들뿐만이 아니라는 사실이지.

ru: Пора тебя научить, как хозяйство вести. <male>К отцовским делам у тебя душа не лежит, так я тебя своим научу.</male><female>А то скоро тебе и самой хозяйкой становиться!</female>
en: It's time to teach you how to run a household. <male>You don't have a lot of heart for your father's business, so I'll teach you some of mine.</male><female>Remember, you'll soon be running a household yourself!</female>
ko: 이제 너도 집안 살림 꾸리는 법을 배워야지. <male>아비 일에는 통 뜻이 없는 것 같으니 내 일을 가르쳐 주마.</male><female>이제 곧 네 손으로 살림을 도맡아야 할 테니까!</female>

context: Poor Mother - Choose Trait (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother - Choose Trait (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <male>Son</male><female>Daughter</female>, come here!

context: Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Так что бери метлу — и вперед! А потом и об ужине не забудь!
en: So grab a broom and get going! And don't forget to make dinner later!
ko: 자, 빗자루부터 들고 쓸어 보렴! 이따 저녁 지을 것도 잊지 말고!

context: Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Слушай меня, <female>дочь</female><male>сын</male>. Любой дом держится на упорном труде. У кого нет стойкости — у того и дома не будет, рано или поздно развалится он.
en: Listen to me, <female>daughter</female><male>son</male>. Any home is built on hard work. If you avoid it, you will have no home; sooner or later it will fall apart.
ko: 내 말 잘 들으렴, <female>딸</female><male>아들</male>아. 집안이란 온통 땀과 노력으로 유지되는 법이야. 끈기가 없으면 집안도 얼마 못 가 풍비박산 나기 마련이란다.

context: Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Description
ru:
Мать была усердной и работящей.

Вы получите черту "Стойкость" — она позволит раз в эпизод усилить <color=#FF8000FF>Тело</color>.
en:
Mother was diligent and hardworking.

You will gain the 'Fortitude' trait—it will allow you to boost your <color=#FF8000FF>Body</color> once per Episode.
ko:
어머니는 부지런했다. 궂은일도 마다하는 법이 없었다.

‘강인함’ 기질을 얻는다. 에피소드마다 한 번, <color=#FF8000FF>신체</color>를 강화할 수 있다.

context: Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Name
en: Help with household chores

context: Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Body Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Сложа руки не сиди. Труд твой дому всегда нужен. Там починить, здесь прибрать, тут приготовить.
en: Don't sit idle. Your work is always needed at home. Some things to fix, some cleaning to do, some cooking to take care of.
ko: 손 놓고 있지 마라. 집에는 늘 네 손이 갈 데가 있단다. 어디 하나 고치고, 쓸고 닦고, 밥도 지어야지.

context: Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Хочу, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>, чтобы ты <male>умел</male><female>умела</female> не только о себе думать.
en: I want you to be able to think not only about yourself, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>.
ko: <male>아들아</male><female>딸아</female>, 부디 제 잇속만 챙기는 사람이 되지는 마라.

context: Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Да ничего взамен не жди, это ведь большое благо для тебя <male>самого</male><female>самой</female>.
en: Don't expect anything in return. This is already a great blessing for you.
ko: 대가를 바라지 마라. 남을 도울 수 있다는 것 자체가 네게 큰 복이란다.

context: Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Вот, по глазам вижу, понимаешь ведь!
en: I can see it in your eyes, you understand!
ko: 그래, 눈빛을 보니 이미 다 알고 있구나!

context: Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)

Мать славилась отзывчивостью и сердоболием.

Вы получите черту "Чуткость" — она позволит раз в эпизод усилить <color=#FF0000FF>Сердце</color>.
en:
Mother was kind and compassionate.

You will gain the 'Sensitivity' trait—it will allow you to boost your <color=#FF0000FF>Heart</color> once per Episode.
ko:
어머니는 마음이 따뜻했다. 남의 아픔을 그냥 지나치지 못했다.

‘감수성’ 기질을 얻는다. 에피소드마다 한 번, <color=#FF0000FF>심장</color>을 강화할 수 있다.

context: Learn Heart Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)

ru: Не бойся свою помощь предлагать и соседу, и случайному прохожему.
en: Don't be afraid to offer your help, whether it's your neighbor or a stranger.
ko: 이웃이든 처음 보는 사람이든, 도움이 필요하면 먼저 손을 내밀렴.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Poor Mother_Learn Shadow Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Запомни как следует, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>. Простаком в наше время быть опасно. Все норовят тебя обхитрить и на тебе нажиться.
en: Remember this well, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. It's dangerous to be a simpleton these days. Everyone is trying to outsmart you and profit from you.
ko: 명심하거라, <male>아들아</male><female>딸아</female>. 요즘 세상에 어수룩하게 굴다간 코 베어 간다. 다들 널 등쳐먹을 생각뿐이야.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)

Мать была женщиной расчетливой и хитроумной.

Вы получите черту "Хитрость" — она позволит раз в эпизод усилить <color=#8080FFFF>Тень</color>.
en:
Mother was a calculating and cunning woman.

You'll gain the "Cunning" trait, which allows you to strengthen your <color=#8080FFFF>Shadow</color> once per episode.
ko:
어머니는 셈이 밝고 꾀가 많았다.

‘교활함’ 기질을 얻는다. 에피소드마다 한 번, <color=#8080FFFF>그림자</color>를 강화할 수 있다.

ru: Не упускай своего, никому не давай себя обмануть.
en: Don't give up what's yours, don't let anyone deceive you.
ko: 네 몫은 꼭 지켜라. 누구한테도 속아 넘어가지 말고.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Poor Mother (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)

ru: В детские годы один из родителей стал вам ближе, многому научил и многое дал.
en: During your childhood, one of your parents became closer to you, taught you many things and gave you a lot.
ko: 어린 시절, 부모 중 유독 가깝게 지내며 많은 것을 가르쳐 준 사람이 있었다.

context: Start (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Start (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
en: Who was it?

context: Start (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Start (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Хотя у вас и не было родителей, о вас все равно было кому позаботиться и многому научить.
en: Even though you didn't have parents, you still had someone to take care of you and teach you a lot.
ko: 부모는 없었지만, 당신을 돌보며 많은 것을 가르쳐 준 사람은 있었다.

ru: На сегодня, пожалуй, довольно тебе науки, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>! Беги во двор, поиграй!
en: That's enough teaching for today, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>! Run outside and play!
ko: 우리 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>, 오늘 공부는 여기까지다! 나가서 뛰어놀아라!

context: Rich Father - Choose Trait (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Description
en: What did your father teach you?

context: Rich Father - Choose Trait (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Father - Choose Trait (Scene - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: <male>Сын</male><female>Дочь</female>! Иди-ка сюда. Пора тебя учить важным семейным делам. А то на кого же я всё оставлю?
en: <male>Son</male><female>Daughter</female>! Come here. It's time to teach you important family matters. Otherwise, who will I leave everything to?
ko: 우리 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>, 이리 와 앉아라. 이제 너도 집안의 중요한 일을 좀 배워야지. 내가 이걸 다 누구한테 물려주겠니?

context: Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Пойми, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>. В этом мире никто не собирается тебе уступать. Все будут пытаться подчинить тебя своим интересам. Тебе нужно <male>самому</male><female>самой</female> уметь постоять за себя.
en: Listen to me, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. In this world, no one is going to make things easy for you. Everyone will try to use you in their own interests. You need to learn to stand up for yourself.
ko: 내 말 새겨들어라, 우리 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>. 세상 누구도 네 사정을 먼저 봐주진 않아. 다들 제 이익을 위해 널 써먹으려 들 거다. 네 몫은 네가 지킬 줄 알아야 해.

context: Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Description
ru:
Отец был непоколебимым и всегда знал, как настоять на своем.

Вы получите черту "Решимость" и сможете раз за эпизод усиливать <color=#FFED79>Голос</color>.
en:
Father was unwavering and always knew how to get his way.

You will gain the 'Resolve' trait and will be able to boost your <color=#FFED79>Voice</color> once per Episode.
ko:
아버지는 뜻을 굽히지 않았고 언제나 제 뜻을 관철할 줄 알았다.

‘결의’ 기질을 얻는다. 에피소드마다 한 번, <color=#FFED79>목소리</color>를 강화할 수 있다.

context: Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Name
en: Learn to defend your interests

context: Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Learn Voice Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: А больше всего нужно уметь твердо говорить: "Нет! Будет по-моему!"
en: But most of all, you need to be able to firmly say: “No! Things will be done my way!”
ko: 무엇보다 이 말은 단호하게 할 수 있어야 해. “안 돼! 내 뜻대로 할 거야!”라고 말이다.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Learn Shadow Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Запомни, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>, чужие промахи всегда можно обернуть в свою пользу.
en: Remember, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, other people's mistakes can always be turned to your advantage.
ko: 우리 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>, 이것만은 기억해라. 남의 실수도 쓰기에 따라서는 네 밑천이 된다.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Description
ru:
Отец был хитроумным и в трудном положении всегда мог найти лазейку или обходной путь.

Вы получите черту "Хитрость" — она позволит раз в эпизод усилить <color=#8080FFFF>Тень</color>.
en:
Father was cunning and could always find a way around a difficult situation.

You'll gain the "Cunning" trait, which allows you to strengthen your <color=#8080FFFF>Shadow</color> once per episode.
ko:
아버지는 꾀가 많았다. 아무리 곤란한 일에도 빠져나갈 구멍을 찾아냈다.

‘교활함’ 기질을 얻는다. 에피소드마다 한 번, <color=#8080FFFF>그림자</color>를 강화할 수 있다.

context: Learn Shadow Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Name

ru: Без доли хитрости в серьезных делах не обойтись. Сейчас покажу тебе...
en: You can't get by in serious matters without a bit of cunning. Let me show you...
ko: 큰일을 하려면 잔꾀도 조금은 부릴 줄 알아야지. 어디 보자…

context: Learn Nerves Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Learn Nerves Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Вот взгляни на счета по дому. Думаешь, цифрой больше, цифрой меньше — все равно? Нет, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>, в бумажных делах мелочей нет.
en: Just look at the household bills. Do you think a couple of numbers will make no difference? No, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, the paperwork is not to be trifled with!
ko: 이 집 장부만 봐도 그래. 숫자 한두 개쯤이야 별일 있으랴 싶지? 우리 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>, 장부는 그렇게 우습게 보는 게 아니다!

context: Learn Nerves Buff - Rich Father (Action - Hero Generation Relatives Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_8 - (Hero Generation) Relatives Choice (Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Rich Father_Description

ko: 가문을 파산 위기에서 구하기 위해 어떤 재능을 발휘했습니까?

context: Choose Talent - Rich Family (Scene - Hero Generation Talent Choice - Rich Family)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_14-3 - (Hero Generation) Talent Choice - Rich Family (Encounter)_Scenes_Choose Talent - Rich Family (Scene - Hero Generation Talent Choice - Rich Family)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Крах обрушился на вашу семью со всей силой. От былого достатка вскоре мало что осталось...
en: The Collapse hit your family with full force. Soon, little remained of your former prosperity...
ko: 대붕괴가 가문을 거세게 덮쳤다. 이전의 번영은 순식간에 흔적도 없이 사라졌다.

context: Choose Talent - Rich Family (Scene - Hero Generation Talent Choice - Rich Family)

ru: Долги копились. Состояние таяло. Дошло до того, что семья рисковала остаться без своего особняка.
en: Debts piled up. The fortune dwindled. It came to the point where the family was in danger of losing your mansion.
ko: 빚은 쌓여 가고 재산은 녹아내렸다. 결국 가문의 저택마저 빼앗길 위기에 처했다.

context: Choose Talent - Rich Family (Scene - Hero Generation Talent Choice - Rich Family)

ru: К счастью, в дело вмешались вы — и ваш талант, который развился прямо на глазах...
en: Luckily, you stepped in—with the help of your talent, which developed right before your eyes...
ko: 다행히 당신이 나섰다. 눈앞에서 눈부시게 피어나던 당신의 <color=#8080FFFF>재능</color> 덕분에 가문은 파멸의 벼랑 끝에서 벗어날 수 있었다.

ru: Страшное время приходит, <male>мой дорогой</male><female>моя дорогая</female>. Еще никогда мой Город не подвергался таким несчастьям, что принесла с собой эта Семья...
en: A terrible time is coming, <male>my dear</male><female>my dear</female>. Never before has my City faced such misfortunes that this Family has brought with them...
ko: 끔찍한 시간이 다가오고 있단다, <male>사랑하는 내 아들아</male><female>사랑하는 내 딸아</female>. 우리 도시는 이 가문이 가져온 이런 재앙들을 겪은 적이 한 번도 없었지...

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_15_1
ru: И никто не понимал, зачем это все делалось...
en: And no one understood why all this was being done...
ko: 아무도 이 모든 것이 왜 일어나고 있는지 이해하지 못했다...

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Найди в себе силы... Не отдай им того, что твое по праву.
en: Find the strength within yourself... Don't give them what is rightfully yours.
ko: 네 안의 힘을 찾아내렴... 마땅히 네 것인 바를 그들에게 내주어선 안 돼.

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
en: As well as your own fate.

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: Их ловили. Вытаскивали на улицу. Бросали на землю. Издевались над ними. Выкрикивали абсурдные обвинения.
en: They were caught. Dragged out into the street. Thrown to the ground. Taunted. Accused of ridiculous things.
ko: 사람들은 붙잡혀 거리로 끌려 나왔다. 땅바닥에 내동댕이쳐진 채 조롱당하고, 터무니없는 죄목으로 고발당했다.

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: На улицах один за другим появлялись неизвестные в масках.
en: One after another, unknown masked men appeared on the streets.
ko: 거리에는 차례로 정체를 알 수 없는 가면을 쓴 남자들이 나타났다.

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
ru: Затем заставляли бессмысленно унижаться. Молить о прощении. Прилюдно извиняться за неизвестные проступки.
en: Then they were forced to humiliate themselves pointlessly. To beg for forgiveness. To publicly apologize for unknown offenses.
ko: 그런 뒤에는 무의미한 굴욕을 강요당했다. 용서를 구걸하고, 알지도 못하는 죄목에 대해 공개적으로 사죄해야만 했다.

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Та ночь, что навсегда изменила судьбу города Брокен.
en: The night that has changed the fate of Brocken forever.
ko: 도시 브로켄의 운명을 영원히 뒤바꿔 놓은 그 밤.

context: Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: But to do nothing... it was impossible.
ko: 하지만 아무것도 하지 않고 가만히 있을 수는 없었다.

context: Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Той ночью вам предстояло решение, которое определило всю дальнейшую жизнь.
en: That night you had to make a decision that would determine the rest of your life.
ko: 그날 밤, 당신은 남은 평생을 좌우할 결단을 내려야만 했다.

context: Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Choice in Long Night (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Замерев, вы гадали, придут ли люди в масках за вами.
en: You stood still, wondering if the masked men would come for you next.
ko: 당신은 숨을 죽인 채, 가면을 쓴 자들이 다음에는 자신을 찾아올지 생각했다.

en: You will face them. You will fight them.

ko: 피해자들이 가면을 쓴 무리의 손아귀에서 벗어날 수 있도록 반드시 도와야 한다.

context: Start (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)

ru: Казалось, весь Город уже что-то знал. Знал, но не говорил вслух. Молчал.
en: It seemed like the entire City already knew what is happening. Everyone knew, but didn't say it out loud. Everyone kept silent.
ko: 마치 도시 전체가 이미 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 알고 있는 것 같았다. 모두가 알고 있었지만 입 밖으로 꺼내지는 않았다. 모두가 침묵을 지켰다.

context: Start (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_22 - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_Scenes_Start (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Траумы не выступали с речами. Они не показывались на публике. Но что-то назревало. Что-то носилось в воздухе Брокена. И корнями оно уходило в столько времени пустовавший дворец Траумов...
en: The Traums didn't give speeches. They didn't show themselves in public. But something was coming. Something was in the air of Brocken. And its roots went back to the Traums' Palace, which had stood empty for so long...
ko: 트라움 가문은 연설을 하지 않았다. 대중 앞에 모습을 드러내지도 않았다. 하지만 무언가가 무르익고 있었다. 브로켄의 공기 속에 무언가가 감돌고 있었다. 그리고 그 뿌리는 오랫동안 텅 비어 있던 트라움 가문의 궁전으로 이어져 있었다...

ko: “도시를 지탱하는 질서를 훼손하는 행위의 말로를 똑똑히 보여주기 위함이다.”

detail: Encounters_Tribunal Encounters_Tribunal Encounter_Actions_Hub (Scene - Tribunal)_Clarify About Compensation (Action - Tribunal)_Text_2_1

ko: 결정은 가해진 피해의 규모와 위원회의 자체 평가에 따라 달라집니다.

ko: 무죄 주장은 자신의 본성을 부정하는 것으로 해석됩니다.

detail: Encounters_Tribunal Encounters_Tribunal Encounter_Actions_Hub (Scene - Tribunal)_Declare innocence (Action - Tribunal)_Text_4_1

en: If you continue in this manner, the court will be forced to impose the maximum penalty.
ko: 이런 식으로 계속한다면 법정은 최고형을 내릴 수밖에 없습니다.

en: I told them the truth. But then it didn't suit them, not at all! I don't understand!
ko: 난 사실대로 말했어. 그런데 나중엔 그게 마음에 안 든다는 거야, 전혀! 도대체 왜 그러는지 모르겠어!

ru: Так-так. <male>Вступил</male><female>Вступила</female> ты в так называемый Заговор.

ko: 호오, 그래. 그 이른바 비밀결사라는 데 가입했다 이거지.

context: Conspiracy Join - Belief (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Inn Escape (Mission)_Encounters_13 - (PROLOGUE Inn Escape) Assassin Jumps In Encounter_Actions_Terrible Thought Dialogue_Conspiracy Join - Belief (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: As long as I breathe, I will strive for this. And I'm not the only one.
ko: 내가 숨 쉬는 한 끊임없이 나아갈 것이다. 나 혼자만이 아니야.

ru: Я верю, что Заговор способен свергнуть Траумов. И я для этого сделаю всё, что смогу.
en: I believe the Conspiracy is capable of overthrowing the Traums. And I will do everything I can to ensure that it happens.
ko: 나는 비밀결사가 트라움 가문을 무너뜨릴 수 있다고 믿는다. 그 일을 이루기 위해 내가 할 수 있는 건 무엇이든 하겠다.

context: Conspiracy Join - Belief (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Inn Escape (Mission)_Encounters_13 - (PROLOGUE Inn Escape) Assassin Jumps In Encounter_Actions_Terrible Thought Dialogue_Conspiracy Join - Belief (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ничего, скоро твоя вера рассыпется. Как только ты увидишь, с кем связался и что они ни на что не способны, что вместе, что поодиночке.
en: Nah, your faith will soon crumble. As soon as you see who you've gotten involved with and how they're incapable of anything.
ko: 글쎄, 그 믿음도 곧 산산조각 날 거다. 네가 대체 누구와 손잡았는지, 그들이 함께든 혼자든 얼마나 무능한지 똑똑히 보고 나면 말이지.

context: Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Inn Escape (Mission)_Encounters_13 - (PROLOGUE Inn Escape) Assassin Jumps In Encounter_Actions_Terrible Thought Dialogue_Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Заговор дал мне цель. И я буду ее держаться.
en: The conspiracy gave me a purpose. And I will stick to it.
ko: 비밀결사는 내게 목표를 주었다. 그리고 난 그 목표를 놓치지 않을 거야.

context: Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Inn Escape (Mission)_Encounters_13 - (PROLOGUE Inn Escape) Assassin Jumps In Encounter_Actions_Terrible Thought Dialogue_Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1

en: Understand that just because you want something doesn't mean you'll get it. The more painful the disappointment will be. You'll find out soon enough...
ko: 깨달아라. 뭔가를 간절히 원한다고 해서 얻을 수 있는 게 아니란 걸. 실망이 클수록 고통만 더할 뿐이지. 곧 뼈저리게 알게 될 게다...

context: Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)

ru: Моя жизнь больше не бесцельна. Я знаю, к чему стремиться.
en: My life is no longer aimless. I know what to strive for.
ko: 내 삶은 더 이상 무의미하지 않다. 무엇을 향해 나아가야 할지 알고 있으니까.

context: Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Inn Escape (Mission)_Encounters_13 - (PROLOGUE Inn Escape) Assassin Jumps In Encounter_Actions_Terrible Thought Dialogue_Conspiracy Join - Goal in Life (Action - Assassin Jumps In Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Я называю это — самообман. Найти себе заведомо невозможную цель и успокаивать себя тем, что стремишься к ней.
en: I call this self-deception. Finding yourself a goal that's obviously impossible and then reassuring yourself that you're striving for it.

ko: 언제나 이렇지... 아무도 날 품어주지 않고, 가엾게 여기지도 않고, 이 슬픔을 나눠주지도 않아. 이런 모진 곳 따윈 떠나버릴 테야...

ko: 기력이 쇠했다. 자신 있던 특성은 쓸 수 없고, 하필 가장 약한 쪽에 기대야 했다…

en: Because there's no refuge for me anywhere! No one needs me, and every day the world treats me worse. Only you can understand me...
ko: 나한텐 어디에도 안식처가 없으니까! 아무도 날 원하지 않고, 세상은 날마다 날 더 모질게 대하기만 해. 오직 너만이 날 이해해 줄 거야...

context: Improve Low Stat - Rich Family (Scene - (Hero Generation) Improve Low Stat - Ennui - Rich Family)

ko: 이루 말할 수 없는 우울이 며칠이고 당신을 갉아먹었다. 생각은 꼬리를 물고 맴돌다 끝없는 몽상과 헛소리로 뒤섞여 갔다.

en: <male>He's an athlete</male><female>She's an athlete</female>. That is, runs and jumps around all day long. Just like our little one!
ko: <male>그는 운동선수다</male><female>그녀도 운동선수다</female>. 그러니까 종일 뛰어다니고 뛰놀기나 했다는 거잖아. 우리 꼬마처럼 말이야!

ko: <male>그는 의사다</male><female>그녀는 의사다</female>. 꼬맹이가 병원 놀이를 하고 자빠졌군.

en: <male>He's a schoolteacher</male><female>She's a schoolteacher</female>. My dear, what makes you think you're qualified to teach anyone? You need to be taught yourself...
ko: <male>그는 교사다</male><female>그녀는 여교사다</female>. 얘야, 네가 누굴 가르친단 말이니? 너 자신부터 훈육을 받아야 할 판인데...

ru: Чем <male>он</male><female>она</female> тут у нас занимается, кроме того, что лезет куда не просят?
en: What does <male>he</male><female>she</female> do here, besides sticking <male>his</male><female>her</female> nose where it's not wanted?
ko: <male>그자</male><female>그 여자</female>가 여기서 하는 일이 뭔가? <male>제</male><female>제</female> 알 바 아닌 일에 코를 들이미는 것 말고.

en: Well, we'll put an end to this quickly. We don't need such things here.
ko: 뭐, 그것도 곧 끝나게 해주마. 우리 도시엔 그따위 제멋대로식 수작은 필요 없으니까.

en: <male>He's a builder</male><female>She's a builder</female>. Always tinkering with little houses, just like our own boy.
ko: <male>그는 건축업자다</male><female>그녀는 건축업자다</female>. 종일 조그만 집이나 만지작거리고, 꼭 우리 꼬마 녀석 같다니까.

ko: <male>그는 변호사다</male><female>그녀도 변호사다</female>. 정의 놀음이라도 해보시겠다? 차라리 소꿉장난이나 숨바꼭질이나 할 것이지.

en: <male>He's a scientist</male><female>She's a scientist</female>. Smart kid! Why did you have to meddle in something that wasn't your business?
ko: <male>그는 과학자다</male><female>그녀는 과학자다</female>. 똑똑한 아이로군! 왜 제 일도 아닌 것에 머리를 들이밀었니?

en: <male>He's an artist</male><female>She's an artist</female>. Trying to draw some funny, silly things. So far, they're harmless, but you never know what the kid might come up with next...
ko: <male>그는 화가다</male><female>그녀는 화가다</female>. 뭔가 우스꽝스러운 낙서나 끄적대고 있군. 아직은 무해하지만, 나중에 무슨 해괴한 짓을 꾸며낼지 누가 알겠어...

en: Who allowed you not to act? When the entire City rose up to defend itself against the <color=#CC80FFFF>strange</color> ones?
ko: 온 도시가 저 <color=#CC80FFFF>이상한</color> 것들에 맞서 일어섰을 때, 네놈에게 방관할 권리를 준 게 대체 누구더냐?

ko: 어머, 끔찍해라. 그래도 이 아이 입장은 이해할 만하네...

en: Are you a man or not? You're acting like a coward! In war times, such people are shot in the head so as not to ruin the regiment's morale.
ko: 사내자식이냐 아니냐? 꼴사나운 겁쟁이처럼 굴기는! 전쟁터 같았으면 군의 사기를 떨어뜨렸다고 즉각 총살감이다.

context: Reason for Exile - Survival (Scene - Hero Generation Exile)

ru: Ты, значит, <male>забился</male><female>забилась</female> в свой угол и свою шкуру <male>берег</male><female>берегла</female>?
en: So you hid in your corner and saved your own skin?
ko: 그러니 넌 제 구석에 처박혀서 제 목숨 하나만 부지하고 있었다 이거냐?

ko: 여기 검표원은 어떤 사람인가요? 아주 깐깐한가요?

context: Ask About Spy (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) - Pie Dealer Interaction)

ko: 그러다 이번엔 웬 젊은 아가씨를 앉혀놨는데, 그 아가씨는 아주 속옷까지 벗길 기세라니까.

context: Ask About Spy (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) - Pie Dealer Interaction)

ko: 예전엔 참 게으른 양반이 있었는데 말이야! 아무나 가리지 않고 다 통과시켜 줬지.

context: Ask About Trains (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) - Pie Dealer Interaction)

ko: 예전엔 기차에서 내리자마자 바로 내게로 달려왔는데! 지금은 뭐... 쳇.

ko: 좋아하긴 무슨! 기차 안에 식당칸들을 죄다 열어놔서, 이젠 다들 거기서만 밥을 먹는단다.
