detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 4 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: А талант… он ведь редко выбирает самых достойных.
en: And talent... it rarely chooses the most worthy.
ko: 그리고 재능이란... 가장 자격 있는 자만을 택하는 법이 드무니까.

context: Question 4 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 4 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Да, он был одарённый, уважаемый… но разве этого достаточно?
en: Yes, he was gifted, respected... but is that enough?
ko: 그래, 그는 뛰어났고, 존경받았지... 하지만 그것만으로 충분했을까?

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Are you sure of Brocken's treachery?

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
ru: А Броккен выжидал… и лишь тогда вмешался.
en: And Brocken waited... and only then intervened.
ko: 브로켄은 그저 기회를 엿보고 있었지... 그러다 마침내 개입한 거란다.

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
ru: Почему ты так уверена в коварстве Броккена?
en: Why are you so sure of Brocken's treachery?
ko: 어째서 브로켄의 간계를 그토록 확신하시는 겁니까?

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Герой попытался бы не допустить этого.
en: The hero would try to prevent this.
ko: 진정한 영웅이라면 이런 비극을 막으려 애썼을 테지.

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Именно… он ждал, пока люди дойдут до отчаяния.
en: Exactly... he waited until people reached despair.
ko: 그렇고말고... 그는 사람들이 절망의 끝에 다다르기만을 기다렸던 게야.

context: Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Может, он просто решился вмешаться, когда всё уже висело на волоске?
en: Maybe he just decided to intervene when everything was already hanging by a thread?
ko: 어쩌면 모든 것이 이미 위태로워졌을 때 개입할 용기를 낸 것뿐 아닐까요?

context: Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Have some tea

context: Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
en: A moment of such rare peace...

context: Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: A soft warmth spreads across the chest...

context: Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Drink Tea (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: ...Затем достигает усталых рук и ног, снимая тянущую тяжесть.
en: ...Then it reaches tired arms and legs, relieving the dragging heaviness.
ko: ...이윽고 지친 팔과 다리에 스며들어, 짓누르던 피로를 씻어내린다.

context: Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
ru: То, о чём ты рассказываешь… Когда это было?
en: What you are talking about... When was it?
ko: 할머니가 말씀하시는 그 일... 대체 언제 적 일인가요?

context: Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: When did all this happen?
ko: 이 모든 일이 언제 일어났는지 묻기

context: Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Да и было ли оно когда-нибудь другим? Хех…
en: And was it ever different? Heh...
ko: 그 시절이라고 뭐 달랐던 적이 있었겠느냐? 훗…

context: Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Ох… давненько. Три сотни лет минуло.
en: Oh... it's been a while. Three hundred years have passed.
ko: 오... 꽤나 까마득한 옛날이지. 삼백 년도 더 지난 일이란다.

context: Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Хотя, признаться, нынешнее время мало чем отличается.
en: Although, admittedly, the present time is not much different.
ko: 하지만 솔직히 인정하건대, 지금의 시대도 별반 다르지 않구나.

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Why did they always quarrel?

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: I don't understand.

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: Why are they mired in discord?

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: Сумеешь ли ты ею поступиться, когда нужда прижмёт?
en: Will you be able to give it up when need arises?
ko: 절박한 상황이 닥쳤을 때, 넌 과연 네 몫을 양보할 수 있겠느냐?

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Разве не должны были объединиться ради общего будущего?
en: Shouldn't we have united for a common future?
ko: 공동의 미래를 위해 하나로 뭉쳤어야 했던 것 아닙니까?

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
ru: Но коли сам собою не владел, а вдруг обрёл «свободу»…
en: But if you didn’t control yourself, and suddenly found “freedom”...
ko: 스스로를 다스릴 줄도 모르면서 느닷없이 '자유'를 얻었으니…

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_8_1
ru: Думали, потеряем всё, если уступим соседу хоть в малом.
en: We thought we would lose everything if we gave in to our neighbor even in the slightest.
ko: 이웃에게 한 치라도 양보하면 모든 걸 잃는다고만 생각했지.

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
en: Eh... easy to say in words.

context: Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Question 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
en: We couldn't.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_8_1
en: They will become eternal servants of their Master.
ko: 그들은 제 주인에게 영원한 종복이 되리라.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_20_1
ru: Умер он. И стало умирать и его детище.
en: He died. And his brainchild began to die too.
ko: 그가 죽자, 그의 피조물 또한 죽어가기 시작했지.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_21_1
ru: Ведь не оставил он после себя главного. Людей.
en: After all, he didn’t leave behind the most important thing: people.
ko: 결국 그는 가장 소중한 것을 남겨놓지 않았으니까. 바로 사람이란다.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Finish your story.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: Finish your story.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_19_1
en: His creation did not shine with glory for long.
ko: 그의 창조물이 누린 영광은 그리 오래가지 못했단다.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: »Как мне быть вашим хозяином, если вы забыли, зачем явились сюда?»
en: "How can I be your master if you have forgotten why you came here?"
ko: "애초에 이곳에 온 이유조차 잊어버렸거늘, 내가 어찌 너희의 주인이 되겠는가?"

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_22_1
en: But only broken souls.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: «Как мне быть вам хозяином, если вы не слышите даже друг друга?»
en: “How can I be your master if you don’t even hear each other?”
ko: "서로의 목소리조차 듣지 못하거늘, 내가 어찌 너희의 주인이 되겠는가?"

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
ru: Притворно противился Пётр. Трижды отказывал он людям в их мольбах.
en: Peter feigned resistance. Three times he refused the people's prayers.
ko: 페터는 거짓으로 거절했지. 사람들의 애원을 세 번이나 물리쳤단다.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_9_1
en: To Mr. Peter Brocken.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_10_1
ru: Лишь тогда согласился Пётр. И повелел составить договор.
en: Only then did Peter agree and order a treaty to be drawn up.
ko: 그제야 페터는 승낙하며 계약서를 작성하라 명했지.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
ru: Клялись, что их рода и потомки их родов откажутся от свободы…
en: They swore that their families and the descendants of their families would renounce freedom...
ko: 그들은 자신들의 가문과 그 후손들이 자유를 포기하겠노라 맹세했단다…

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_11_1
en: They called it the Brocken Pact.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_13_1
en: And the townspeople... Betrayed themselves.
ko: 그리고 도시 사람들은... 스스로를 배신한 게야.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: Peter responded to the requests as follows:

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_12_1
ru: Броккен обещал защиту и покровительство будущему городу.
en: Brocken promised protection and patronage to the future city.
ko: 브로켄은 훗날 세워질 도시에 보호와 비호를 약속했지.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_25_1
en: So tell me now.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_17_1
ru: А уж за ценой… за ценой он никогда не стоял.
en: And as for the price... he never cared about the price.
ko: 그리고 대가에 관해서라면... 그는 대가 따윈 결코 아까워하지 않았단다.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_15_1
ru: Клялись в верности. Хотя более всего желали жить без тиранов.
en: They swore allegiance. Although most of all they wished to live without tyrants.
ko: 그들은 충성을 맹세했지. 비록 무엇보다도 폭군 없이 살기를 갈망했으면서도.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_14_1
ru: Каждый тогда подписался под ним — от мала до велика.
en: Everyone then signed up for it, from the youngest to the oldest.
ko: 그때 남녀노소 할 것 없이 모두가 서명했단다.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_16_1
ru: Для величия. Для потомков. Ради великой идеи.
en: For greatness. For posterity. For a great idea.
ko: 위대함을 위해. 후손들을 위해. 원대한 대의를 위해.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_24_1
ru: Моя история закончена. Теперь ты знаешь всю картину.
en: My story is finished. Now you know the whole picture.
ko: 내 이야기는 끝났다. 이제 넌 모든 진실을 알게 되었지.

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_26_1
ru: Зачем ты хочешь встретиться с тем, что за дверью.
en: Why do you want to meet what's behind the door?
ko: 너는 어째서 문 뒤에 있는 존재를 만나려는 것이냐?

context: Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 3 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: Но они снова и снова падали к его ногам.
en: But they fell at his feet again and again.
ko: 하지만 사람들은 거듭해서 그의 발치에 엎드렸단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Start your story

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_11_1
ru: Днями напролёт они спорили и ссорились. Поля оставались незасеянными.
en: They argued and quarreled for days on end. The fields remained unsown.
ko: 그들은 며칠 밤낮을 다투고 싸웠지. 밭은 내팽개쳐진 채였고.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Отчаявшись, многие семьи с разных концов света отправились в путь.
en: In desperation, many families from all over the world set out on their journey.
ko: 절망에 빠진 세상 곳곳의 수많은 가족들이 길을 떠났단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: То был век голода, войн и недостойных королей.
en: It was a century of famine, wars and unworthy kings.
ko: 그때는 기근과 전쟁, 무도한 왕들의 세기였지.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_10_1
ru: Быстро погрязли в раздорах и гордыне, опьянённые недавно обретённой свободой.
en: They quickly became mired in discord and pride, intoxicated by their newly acquired freedom.
ko: 새로 얻은 자유에 취해버린 그들은 이내 분란과 오만에 빠져들었단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: Шли они вместе — разные по языку, но одинаковые в горе.
en: They walked together — different in language, but the same in grief.
ko: 그들은 함께 걸었지—쓰는 언어는 달랐으나 슬픔은 매한가지였단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
ru: Искать место, где не будет господствовать тиран, где сами люди решат, как жить.
en: Look for a place where a tyrant will not rule, where people themselves will decide how to live.
ko: 폭군이 군림하지 않는 곳, 사람들 스스로 어떻게 살아갈지 결정할 수 있는 땅을 찾아 나선 게야.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_13_1
ru: Ох… давненько я столько не говорила. Не с кем как видишь.
en: Oh... it's been a while since I've talked so much. There's no one to talk to, as you can see.
ko: 오... 이토록 길게 말을 해본 것도 오랜만이구나. 보다시피 말동무 하나 없으니.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_8_1
ru: Нашли плодородную долину — и решили основать город, какого ещё не бывало.
en: They found a fertile valley and decided to found a city the likes of which had never existed before.
ko: 그들은 비옥한 골짜기를 찾아냈고—일찍이 존재한 적 없던 도시를 세우기로 뜻을 모았단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Я расскажу, как родился город Брокен.
en: I will tell you how the city of Brocken was born.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
ru: Договорились идти в горы, туда, где никто их не найдёт.
en: They agreed to go to the mountains, where no one would find them.
ko: 그들은 아무도 찾지 못할 깊은 산속으로 가기로 합의했지.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_9_1
ru: Строили, копали, чертили улицы… но всё врозь, всё не в попад.
en: They built, dug, drew streets... but everything was in disarray, everything was out of place.
ko: 집을 짓고, 땅을 파고, 길을 닦았지만... 온통 제각각이었고 손발이 맞지 않았단다.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_12_1
ru: И вот пришла зима. Пришёл голод. Снег закрыл перевалы...
en: And then winter came. Famine came. Snow covered the passes...
ko: 그리고 겨울이 닥쳤지. 기근이 찾아왔단다. 눈이 산길을 모조리 가로막았고...

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: I'm ready to listen to you. Tell me.
ko: 이야기를 들을 준비가 되었습니다. 말씀해 주십시오.

context: Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 1 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_14_1
ru: Коль будешь готов — скажи. Я продолжу.
en: When you're ready, tell me. I'll continue.
ko: 준비가 되거든 말하거라. 계속 들려줄 테니.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_8_1
ru: Но найти согласия они так не смогли.
en: But they were unable to find agreement.
ko: 하지만 그들은 끝내 합의에 이르지 못했단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: Continue your story

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: Смерть уже дышала им в спины…
en: Death was already breathing down their necks...
ko: 죽음이 이미 그들의 등 뒤까지 바짝 들이닥쳤지…

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_9_1
ru: Впали в ничтожество люди, и ничто, как они думали, уже не могло их спасти.
en: People fell into insignificance, and nothing, as they thought, could save them.
ko: 사람들은 비참하게 굴러떨어졌고, 그 누구도 자신들을 구할 수 없으리라 여겼단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Name
en: Continue your story

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_18_1
ru: «Только уведи нас от бед, что мы сами на себя накликали!»
en: "Just lead us away from the troubles we have brought upon ourselves!"
ko: "우리가 스스로 불러들인 이 재앙에서 부디 우리를 구해 주시오!"

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_21_1
en: Oh... perhaps one more sip.
ko: 휴… 차를 한 모금 더 마셔야겠구나.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
ru: Крепче становилась стужа. Громче урчали животы.
en: The cold grew stronger. Stomachs growled louder.
ko: 추위는 더욱 매서워졌고. 주린 배에서는 꼬르륵 소리가 더 요란해졌지.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_19_1
en: This is what Peter was waiting for...

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_15_1
ru: Будто заворожённые, люди стекались на его речи
en: As if spellbound, people flocked to his speeches.
ko: 홀리기라도 한 듯, 사람들은 그의 연설에 구름처럼 몰려들었지.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_10_1
en: Only Peter Brocken was able to stop the "irreparable".
ko: 이 '돌이킬 수 없는 파국'을 멈출 수 있었던 것은 오직 페터 브로켄뿐이었단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
en: To finally come to an agreement.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_13_1
ru: «Мы пришли сюда построить город, какого ещё не бывало!»
en: "We came here to build a city like no other!"
ko: "우리는 일찍이 없던 도시를 짓기 위해 이곳에 왔단 말입니다!"

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Раз за разом собирались люди в центре долины.
en: Time after time, people gathered in the center of the valley.
ko: 사람들은 몇 번이고 골짜기 한가운데로 모여들었단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_16_1
ru: Бросались к нему в ноги, кричали:
en: They threw themselves at his feet and shouted:

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_12_1
ru: В момент глубочайшего отчаяния говорил он:
en: In a moment of deepest despair he said:
ko: 가장 깊은 절망의 순간에 그는 이렇게 말했단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_17_1
en: “Become our master and shepherd, Peter!”

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_14_1
ru: «Неужели мы не клялись быть братьями и сёстрами, разделять все горести?...»
en: "Didn't we swear to be brothers and sisters, to share all our sorrows?...."
ko: "우리 모두 형제자매가 되어 온갖 슬픔을 나누기로 맹세하지 않았던가요?...."

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_11_1
ru: Архитектор. Одарённый, уважаемый. Но до поры — молчаливый в спорах.
en: An architect. Gifted, respected. But, for the time being, silent in debates.
ko: 건축가였지. 뛰어난 재능으로 존경받았으나, 논쟁이 벌어질 때면 한동안 입을 굳게 닫고 있던 자였단다.

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: So… where was I?

context: Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Story_Listen Story 2 (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
en: Oh yeah…

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Name
en: Convince the Old Woman

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: No need.

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Мы оба лишь произнесём много пустых слов.
en: We both will just utter a lot of empty words.
ko: 우리 둘 다 헛된 말만 늘어놓게 될 뿐이야.

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
en: Now it's your turn.

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Я сделала свой выбор. Уже очень давно.
en: I made my choice. A long time ago.
ko: 난 내 선택을 했다. 아주 오랜 옛날에.

context: Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Convince Old Woman (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
ru: Послушай, все не обязано закончится так...
en: Look, it doesn't have to end like this...
ko: 이봐요, 꼭 이렇게 끝날 필요는 없잖아요...

context: Kill Woman On Your Way (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_First Try to Stop_Name
en: Kill the old woman

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: Но это не значит, что оно должно определять нашу жизнь.
en: But that doesn't mean it should define our lives.
ko: 하지만 그렇다고 해서 그것이 우리의 삶을 좌우해야 한다는 뜻은 아니에요.

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Name
en: Leave this place <color=red>(End of mission)</color>

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Пусть все останется так как есть.
en: Let everything remain as it is.

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
en: Thank you. Thank you for changing your mind.

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: I will not kill you.

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
en: We cannot forget this.

context: Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Old Woman On Your Way_Leave This Place Forever (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Пойми, всегда есть то, что просто должно остаться нетронутым.
en: Understand, there is always something that just needs to remain untouched.
ko: 부디 깨닫거라. 세상엔 그저 손대지 않고 남겨두어야만 하는 것도 있는 법이란다.

context: Start Ignore (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Name
en: Go to the door

context: Start Ignore (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Ignore (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
en: Wait!

context: Start Ignore (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Ignore (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
ru: У меня нет времени на разговоры.
en: I don't have time to talk.

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Name
en: Who are you?

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Я знаю лишь одно —  я ненавижу.
en: I only know one thing — I hate.
ko: 내가 아는 건 오직 하나뿐이다—난 증오한다는 것.

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
en: I hate the one behind the door.
ko: 저 문 뒤에 있는 자를 증오한단다.

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: Who am I?

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: Who are you?

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
ru: Но я не затем здесь, чтобы причинить тебе вред....
en: But I'm not here to harm you....
ko: 하지만 널 해치려고 여기 있는 게 아니란다....

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
en: I understand that you are wary... afraid of me.
ko: 경계하는 것도... 날 두려워하는 것도 이해한다.

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_8_1
en: ...I'm here to tell the truth.
ko: ...난 그저 진실을 들려주러 여기에 있는 게야.

context: Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Who Are You (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: От меня мало что осталось. Ни имени... ни будущего.
en: There's little left of me. No name... no future.
ko: 내게 남은 건 거의 없단다. 이름도... 미래도 없지.

context: Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
en: I will listen to you.

context: Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Name
en: Sit by the fire

context: Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Коль будешь готов слушать, я начну свой рассказ.
en: If you are ready to listen, I will begin my story.
ko: 들을 준비가 되었다면, 내 이야기를 시작하마.

context: Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Actions_Start_Start Sit (Action - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
en: That's great!

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_2_1
ru: Тот кого ты ищешь за дверью.
en: The one you're looking for behind the door.
ko: 네가 찾는 이는 저 문 뒤에 있단다.

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_6_1
ru: А я тем временем расскажу тебе подлинную историю Петра Броккена.
en: In the meantime, I will tell you the true story of Peter Brocken.
ko: 그동안 난 네게 페터 브로켄의 진짜 이야기를 들려주마.

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_4_1
ru: Но всё же — он должен остаться не найденным.
en: But still, it must remain unfound.
ko: 하지만 그래도—그는 끝내 깨어나지 못한 채 남아 있어야만 해.

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_7_1
ru: Историю, после которой, я надеюсь, ты передумаешь его возвращать.
en: A story after which I hope you'll change your mind about returning it.
ko: 이야기를 다 듣고 나면, 그를 되찾아가겠다는 네 생각도 바뀌기를 바란다.

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_1_1
ru: Не думала, что у меня сегодня будет компания.
en: I didn't think I'd have company today.

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_3_1
ru: Верю, ты пришёл за ним с благими намерениями....
en: I believe you came for him with good intentions....
ko: 선한 뜻을 품고 그를 찾아왔으리라 믿는다만....

context: Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Old Lady Dialogue Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Old Lady Dialogue)_Text_5_1
ru: Присядь, отдохни у огня. Выпей горячего чаю.
en: Sit down, relax by the fire. Drink some hot tea.

en: We will find you, don't doubt it.
ko: 우리가 널 반드시 찾아낼 거다. 의심할 여지도 없지.

context: Traums Get Your Name (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)

en: And talk to you in person...

context: Traums Get Your Name (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Get Your Name (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: That's your name!

context: On First Third Point (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On First Third Point (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Чувствуешь, какова эта ноша? С каждым шагом будет только труднее. Поверь, лучше повернуть обратно уже сейчас.
en: Do you feel the burden of this? It will only become more difficult with every step. Believe me, it's better to turn back now.
ko: 이 짐의 무게를 느끼고 있나? 한 걸음씩 올라갈수록 점점 더 힘들어질 뿐이다. 내 말을 믿어라, 지금 당장 돌아가는 게 낫다.

context: On First Third Point (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On First Third Point (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Давление будет расти и расти. Пока не раздавит тебя. Отступись. Эта лестница не для тебя.
en: The pressure will build and build. Until it crushes you. Step back. This staircase is not for you.
ko: 압박감이 점점 더 심해질 거다. 널 짓눌러 버릴 때까지 말이지. 물러서라. 이 계단은 네가 오를 곳이 아니야.

context: Go to Second Third With Body (Action - Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Climb up

context: Go to Second Third With Voice (Action - Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Clench your teeth and crawl

context: On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
en: Give in. Don't you have enough burden on you?
ko: 포기해라. 이미 짊어진 짐만으로도 벅차지 않더냐?

context: On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Просто скажи себе — я не могу!
en: Just tell yourself — I can't!

context: On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Обещаю, ты все равно попадешь, куда хочешь...
en: I promise you'll still get where you want to...
ko: 약속하지, 넌 결국 네가 원하던 곳에 닿게 될 거라고...

context: On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Scenes_On Stairs Bottom Again (Scene - Abandoned Inn Mission Climb Up Stairs)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: И вот ты снова внизу. Нужны ещё доказательства?
en: And here you are again, down below. Need more proof?
ko: 또다시 맨 밑바닥이로군. 증거가 더 필요하냐?

context: Go to First Third With Body (Action - Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Gather your strength and go up

context: Go to First Third With Voice (Action - Climb Up Stairs)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) Climb Up Stairs (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Force yourself to go

context: (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_Name
ru: Что знает о вас Семья Траум?
en: What does the Traum Family know about you?
ko: 트라움 가문은 당신에 대해 무엇을 알고 있나요?

context: Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#00FFFFFF>You are not discovered!</color>

context: Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Мало! Слишком мало мы знаем <male>о нем</male><female>о ней</female>! Уйдет!
en: That is not enough! We know too little <male>about him! He can slip away!</male><female>about her! She can slip away!</female>
ko: 부족해! <male>그놈에 대해</male><female>그 계집에 대해</female> 아는 게 너무 없어! 도망쳐 버릴 거야!

context: Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Dont Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ничего, дорогой, нелюди до <male>него</male><female>нее</female> доберутся, и мы всё-всё узнаем!
en: Never mind, dear, the Inhumans will get to <male>him</male><female>her</female>, and we will find out everything!
ko: 걱정 마요, 여보. 비인간들이 곧 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 잡아낼 테니, 전부 알아낼 수 있을 거예요!

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Не беспокойтесь, дорогая свекровь. Уже скоро <male>им</male><female>ей</female> займется лучший воспитанник моего Приюта.
en: Don't worry, dear mother-in-law. Soon, the best pupil of my Orphanage will be taking care of <male>him</male><female>her</female>.
ko: 염려 마십시오, 장모님. 곧 제 고아원 최고의 원생이 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 맡게 될 것입니다.

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Не подведи, сыночек! У меня на <male>него</male><female>нее</female> большие планы!
en: Don't let me down, son! I have big plans for <male>him</male><female>her</female>!
ko: 실망시키지 마라, 아들아! <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 써먹을 거대한 계획이 있으니 말이다!

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
en: Yes, son. That very one...

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Я помню, матушка. Нелюди доставят <female>ее нам живой</female><male>его нам живым</male>.
en: I remember, mother. The Inhumans will deliver <female>her to us alive</female><male>him to us alive</male>.
ko: 기억하고 있습니다, 어머니. 비인간들이 <female>그 계집을 산 채로 데려올 겁니다</female><male>그놈을 산 채로 데려올 겁니다</male>.

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Тот самый, мама? Мой лучший друг?
en: Oh, my best friend, mom?
ko: 바로 그 사람이에요, 엄마? 내 제일 친한 친구?

context: Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Outro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: <male>Ему</male><female>Ей</female> не выдержать и сегодняшнего дня. Я распорядился, чтобы до полуночи <male>он</male><female>она</female> была в наших руках.
en: <male>He</male><female>She</female> won't last even this day. I gave orders that <male>he</male><female>she</female> must be in our hands by midnight.
ko: <male>그놈은</male><female>그 계집은</female> 오늘 하루도 버티지 못할 겁니다. 자정 전까지 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 우리 손아귀에 넣으라고 지시해 두었습니다.

context: Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
en: Then <male>he</male><female>she</female> won't go too far!

context: Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>The Inhuman Killer Lives!</color>

context: Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Assassin is Witness (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Один из наших Нелюдей <male>его</male><female>ее</female> видел в упор.
en: One of our Inhumans saw <male>him</male><female>her</female> face-to-face.
ko: 우리 비인간 중 하나가 <male>그놈의</male><female>그 계집의</female> 얼굴을 코앞에서 똑똑히 봤습니다.

context: Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Они упустили <male>его</male><female>ее</female>?! Выродки, ну пусть только вернутся, я им устрою... Ничего, всё еще впереди!
en: They missed <male>him</male><female>her</female>?! Those useless freaks, I'll deal with them when they're back... No matter, we have more things up our sleeves!
ko: 놈들이 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 놓쳤다고?! 쓸모없는 종자들, 돌아오기만 해 봐라, 가만두지 않을 테니... 괜찮아, 아직 끝난 건 아니니까!

context: Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>You were not captured!</color>

context: Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Not Caught (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: <male>Он так и не попался</male><female>Она так и не попалась</female> в плен нашим нелюдям.
en: <male>He was never captured</male><female>She was never captured</female> by our Inhumans.
ko: <male>그놈은</male><female>그 계집은</female> 우리 비인간들에게 끝내 붙잡히지 않았습니다.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_18_1
ru: <male>Он начал</male><female>Она начала</female> соваться без спросу и пытаться помогать другим <color=#CC80FFFF>странным</color>.
en: <male>He started</male><female>She started</female> sticking her nose in without asking and trying to help other <color=#CC80FFFF>strange</color> people.
ko: <male>그놈은</male><female>그 계집은</female> 허락도 없이 참견하며 다른 <color=#CC80FFFF>이상한</color> 자들을 도우려 들었지.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_12_1
ru: Так! <male>Потом он воевал</male><female>Потом она воевала</female> на фронте. Значит, армейская выучка...
en: So! <male>Then he fought</male><female>Then she fought</female> at the frontline. Military training, I see...
ko: 맞아! <male>그러곤 전선에서 싸웠지</male><female>그러곤 전선에서 싸웠지</female>. 군사 훈련을 받았다는 뜻이군...

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_16_1
ru: <male>Он начал</male><female>Она начала</female> строить из себя, мол, достоинство не позволяет преклониться.
en: <male>He began</male><female>She began</female> to act like her dignity doesn't allow her to bow down.
ko: <male>그놈은</male><female>그 계집은</female> 자존심 때문에 무릎 꿇을 수 없다는 듯이 굴기 시작했지.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был разнорабочим</male><female>Она раньше была разнорабочей</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be an odd-job worker</male><female>She used to be an odd-job worker</female> here in Brocken.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был атлетом</male><female>Она раньше была атлетом</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be an athlete</male><female>She used to be an athlete</female> here in Brocken.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был врачом</male><female>Она раньше была врачом</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be a doctor</male><female>She used to be a doctor</female> here in Brocken.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_17_1
ru: <male>Он посмел</male><female>Она посмела</female> открыто пойти против нас!
en: <male>He dared</male><female>She dared</female> to openly challenge us!
ko: <male>감히 그놈이</male><female>감히 그 계집이</female> 대놓고 우리에게 맞섰지!

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был учителем</male><female>Она раньше была учительницей</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be a teacher</male><female>She used to be a teacher</female> here in Brocken.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_19_1
ru: <male>А ведь он еще преклонил</male><female>А ведь она еще преклонила</female> колени перед нами, ха-ха! Но все равно <male>был слишком <color=#CC80FFFF>странным</color></male><female>была слишком <color=#CC80FFFF>странной</color></female>, чтобы оставлять в Городе!
en: <male>He knelt down</male><female>She knelt down</female> before us, ha-ha! But still was way too <color=#CC80FFFF>strange</color> to be left in the City!
ko: <male>그놈은 우리 앞에 무릎까지 꿇었지</male><female>그 계집은 우리 앞에 무릎까지 꿇었지</female>, 하하! 하지만 그렇다고 도시 안에 남겨두기엔 너무 <color=#CC80FFFF>기괴한</color> 자였어!

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Стойте-ка! А не <male>тот ли это мальчонка</male><female>та ли это девчонка</female>, кого мы давным-давно изгнали из города?
en: Wait a minute! Isn't it <male>that boy</male><female>that girl</female> we drove out of the City long ago?
ko: 잠깐만요! 우리가 옛날에 이 도시에서 쫓아냈던 <male>그 꼬마 녀석</male><female>그 꼬마 계집애</female> 아닌가요?

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>You've been discovered!</color>

ko: 그래! 여기 브로켄에서 <male>건설 노동자로 일했었지</male><female>건설 노동자로 일했었지</female>.

en: <male>He persisted</male><female>She persisted</female> and did not want to bow down!
ko: <male>그놈은 끈질기게 버티며</male><female>그 계집은 끈질기게 버티며</female> 결코 무릎 꿇지 않으려 했지!

ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был адвокатом</male><female>Она раньше была адвокатом</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be a lawyer</male><female>She used to be a lawyer</female> here in Brocken.

en: <male>Here he is, once again under our thumb!</male><female>Here she is, once again under our thumb!</female>
ko: <male>이렇게 또다시 덜미가 잡혔군!</male><female>이렇게 또다시 덜미가 잡혔군!</female>

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)

ru: А за что, а за что мы <male>его</male><female>ее</female> изгнали, Бабушка?
en: And why? Why did we drove <male>him</male><female>her</female> away, Grandmother?
ko: 왜죠? 왜 우리가 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 쫓아낸 거예요, 할머니?

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)

ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был ученым</male><female>Она раньше была ученым</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be a scientist</male><female>She used to be a scientist</female> here in Brocken.

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: Так! <male>Потом он был преступником, сидел в тюрьме.</male><female>Потом она была преступницей, сидела в тюрьме.</female> Значит, к бегству не привыкать...
en: Right! <male>Then he became a criminal, served time in prison.</male><female>Then she became a criminal, served time in prison.</female> So, no stranger to living on the run...
ko: 맞아! <male>그러곤 범죄자가 되어 옥살이를 했지.</male><female>그러곤 범죄자가 되어 옥살이를 했지.</female> 그러니 도망치는 덴 이력이 났겠지...

context: Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Know Player (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Да! <male>Он раньше был художником</male><female>Она раньше была художницей</female> здесь, в Брокене.
en: Yes! <male>He used to be an artist</male><female>She used to be an artist</female> here in Brocken.

ru: Твои нелюди слишком медленны. Как только они вернутся, пошлю их на новые процедуры, а то ишь расслабились!
en: Your Inhumans are too slow. As soon as they return, I'll send them for new procedures. They've gotten too soft!
ko: 당신 비인간들은 너무 굼떠요. 돌아오기만 하면 새로 시술을 받게 보내야겠어요, 아주 해이해졌잖아요!

context: Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#00FFFFFF>Your apartment burned down!</color>

context: Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Нутром чую, это <female>была не она</female><male>был не он</male>!
en: I have a gut feeling that it wasn't <male>him</male><female>her</female>!

context: Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: А среди пожарища — обгоревшее тело. Похоже, заговорщики наконец начали резать друг друга. Как я и ожидал...
en: And amid the burned room, a charred body. It looks like the conspirators have finally started slaughtering each other. Just as I expected...
ko: 잿더미 한가운데에 새까맣게 탄 시신이 있었소. 비밀결사 놈들이 마침내 서로를 도륙하기 시작한 모양이군. 내가 예상했던 대로야...

context: Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Address Is Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Нелюди пытались отыскать <male>его</male><female>ее</female> жилище, но вместо квартиры нашли лишь пожарище.
en: The Inhumans tried to find <male>his</male><female>her</female> home, but the apartment they were after has just burned down.
ko: 비인간들이 <male>그놈의</male><female>그 계집의</female> 거처를 덮쳤지만, 아파트는 이미 불타 버리고 잿더미만 남았다더군요.

context: Player Didnt Made Mess in Inn (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)

en: Such a shame.

en: <color=#00FFFFFF>You didn't arouse suspicion at the hotel!</color>

context: Player Didnt Made Mess in Inn (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Didnt Made Mess in Inn (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Из гостиницы ничего получить не удалось. <male>Он действовал</male><female>Она действовала</female> осмотрительно!
en: We got nothing from the hotel. <male>He acted</male><female>She acted</female> carefully!
ko: 호텔에서는 건진 게 없더군요. <male>놈이 꽤 신중하게 움직였습니다</male><female>계집이 꽤 신중하게 움직였습니다</female>!

en: Didn't last very long as a conspirator, heh-heh!
ko: 비밀결사 치고는 오래 못 버텼군, 크크!

context: Player is Double Agent (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player is Double Agent (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>You are a double agent!</color>

context: Player is Double Agent (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player is Double Agent (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Все куда проще! <male>Он уже стал</male><female>Она уже стала</female> нашим двойным агентом.
en: Everything is much simpler! <male>He has already become</male><female>She has already become</female> our double agent.
ko: 훨씬 더 간단한 일이지! <male>그놈은 이미</male><female>그 계집은 이미</female> 우리의 이중간첩이 되었으니까.

context: Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>You have given your name to the Traum Family!</color>

context: Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Ну и имечко, честное слово! С таким только в заговорщики и пустят.
en: What a name, honestly! One that is fit only for a scum like those conspirators.
ko: 정말 기가 막힌 이름이로군! 비밀결사대 같은 쓰레기들에게나 어울릴 이름이야.

context: Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Поймать <male>его</male><female>ее</female> на лестнице было прекрасной мыслью, матушка.
en: Catching <male>him</male><female>her</female> on the stairs was a wonderful idea, Mother.
ko: 계단에서 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 덮친 건 정말 훌륭한 생각이었어요, 어머니.

context: Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
en: This is <username> <userlastname>!

context: Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Known (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: <male>Он сам выдал</male><female>Она сама выдала</female> свое имя в гостинице.
en: <male>He gave it away himself</male><female>She gave it away herself</female> at the hotel.

context: Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: И они упустили <male>его</male><female>ее</female>?! Выродки, ну пусть только вернутся, я им устрою...
en: And they let <male>him</male><female>her</female> escape?! Those filthy bastards, just let them come back, I'll show them...
ko: 그런데도 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 놓쳤다고?! 쓸모없는 버러지 같은 놈들, 돌아오기만 해 봐라, 가만두지 않을 테니...

context: Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#FF0000FF>You were captured!</color>

context: Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Was Caught Once (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: <male>Он уже попался</male><female>Она уже попалась</female> в плен нашим нелюдям. Они успели многое узнать.
en: <male>He's already been captured</male><female>She's already been captured</female> by our Inhumans. They've managed to learn a lot.
ko: <male>그놈은 이미</male><female>그 계집은 이미</female> 우리 비인간 수하들에게 붙잡힌 적이 있습니다. 그때 많은 걸 알아냈지요.

context: Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Того и гляди, <male>он</male><female>она</female> еще и фальшивые документы отыщет, и тогда поминай как звали!
en: You never know, <male>he</male><female>she</female> might even get fake documents. Then it's going to be troublesome!
ko: 자칫 <male>그놈이</male><female>그 계집이</female> 위조 서류라도 손에 넣으면 골치 아파질 텐데요!

context: Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: <color=#00FFFFFF>Вы не выдали свое имя Семье Траум!</color>
en: <color=#00FFFFFF>You haven't given your name to the Traum Family!</color>

context: Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Player Name Unknown (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Мы все еще не знаем, как <male>его</male><female>ее</female> зовут!
en: We still don't know <male>his</male><female>her</female> name!

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Что вы дали узнать о себе Семье Траум?
en: What did you let the Traum Family know about you?
ko: 트라움 가문이 당신에 대해 알게 된 사실은 무엇이었습니까?

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Да! Скорей сюда <male>его</male><female>ее</female>! Хочу себе новую игрушку!
en: Yes! Bring <male>him</male><female>her</female> here, quick! I want a new toy!
ko: 그래요! 어서 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 이리로 데려와요! 새 장난감이 갖고 싶단 말이에요!

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Дорогой, а что твои нелюди успели донести про <male>него</male><female>нее</female>?
en: Darling, what did your Inhumans report about <male>him</male><female>her</female>?
ko: 여보, 당신 비인간들이 <male>그놈에 대해</male><female>그 계집에 대해</female> 뭐라고 보고하던가요?

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Недодавили мы их вовремя, сын, ох недодавили! Помяни мое слово, вся эта заговорщическая мразь еще будет нам мешаться под руками.
en: Why oh why we didn't crush them in time, son! Mark my words, all this conspiratorial scum will still be in our way.
ko: 제때 그놈들을 짓뭉개 버리지 못했어, 아들아, 완전히 뿌리뽑지 못했단 말이다! 내 말을 명심해라. 이 비밀결사 찌꺼기 놈들이 앞으로도 계속 걸리적거릴 게다.

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Осторожнее, дорогой! Наша власть не простирается так далеко. В Столице нам будет действовать трудно. Скорее верни <male>его</male><female>ее</female> сюда, в мои объятия!
en: Be careful, my dear! Our power doesn't extend that far. It will be difficult for us to operate in the Capital. Quickly, bring <male>him</male><female>her</female> back here, into my arms!
ko: 조심해요, 여보! 우리 권력이 거기까지 미치진 못하잖아요. 수도에서는 우리도 움직이기 힘들 거예요. 어서 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 이리로 데려와 내 품에 안겨 줘요!

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Кто же имеет наглость искать Заговор? После того, как мы его раздавили, как муху?
en: Who has the nerve to search for the Conspiracy now? After we squashed it like a fly?
ko: 우리가 파리처럼 짓뭉개 버린 그 비밀결사를 감히 누가 뒤쫓는단 말이냐?

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter_Scenes_Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Тишина! Нелюди идут по следу. Они схватят <male>его</male><female>ее</female> в Столице, прежде чем <male>он</male><female>она</female> успеет проникнуть обратно.
en: Silence! The Inhumans are on <male>him</male><female>her</female> trail. They will capture <male>him</male><female>her</female> in the Capital before <male>he</male><female>she</female> has a chance to get back here.
ko: 조용히 해라! 비인간들이 뒤를 쫓고 있다. <male>그놈이</male><female>그 계집이</female> 다시 이곳으로 숨어들기 전에 수도에서 사로잡을 것이다.

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)

ru: Спокойно, Мама! Через <male>этого заговорщика</male><female>эту заговорщицу</female> мы и выйдем на всех, кто от нас выскользнул. Наши нелюди уже в Столице и ищут <male>его</male><female>ее</female>.
en: Calm down, Mom! Through this conspirator, we will find everyone who has slipped through the cracks. Our Inhumans are already in the Capital and are hunting <male>him</male><female>her</female> down.
ko: 진정하세요, 어머니! 이 비밀결사원을 통해 우리 손아귀에서 빠져나간 자들을 전부 찾아낼 수 있습니다. 우리 비인간 수하들이 이미 수도에 잠입해 <male>그놈을</male><female>그 계집을</female> 추적하고 있습니다.

context: Traums Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Traums Hunt Results Encounter)

en: Listen up, Family! A new conspirator is trying to get into Brocken.
ko: 잘 들어라, 가족들이여! 새로운 비밀결사원이 브로켄에 숨어들려 하고 있다.

en: The desperation of these so-called conspirators is matched only by their stupidity. Lucky for us!
ko: 소위 비밀결사라는 놈들의 뻔뻔함은 그 어리석음과 맞먹는군. 우리로선 다행이지만!

en: The Inhumans have already found the rented apartment where <male>he lived</male><female>she lived</female>. There are plenty of traces left.
ko: 비인간들이 이미 <male>그놈이 살던</male><female>그 계집이 살던</female> 셋방을 찾아냈지. 흔적이 아주 수두룩하게 남아 있더군.

ru: Наши люди в столичной полиции уже доложили. За <male>ним</male><female>ней</female> тянется след из преступлений. Следовать по ним не составит труда.
en: Our people at the Capital's police have already reported. A trail of crimes follows <male>him</male><female>her</female>. Tracking <male>him</male><female>her</female> down won't be difficult.
ko: 수도 경찰에 심어 둔 우리 정보원들이 이미 보고해 왔습니다. <male>그놈의</male><female>그 계집의</female> 뒤를 따라 범죄의 흔적이 줄줄이 남았더군요. 추적하는 건 일도 아닐 겁니다.

en: <male>He made</male><female>She made</female> a mess in the hotel where the telephone was hidden.
ko: 전화기가 숨겨져 있던 바로 그 호텔에서 <male>그놈이</male><female>그 계집이</female> 난동을 부렸더군요.

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)
detail: Encounters_Restaurant Encounters_Disruption of The Wedding Mission_Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)_Text_6_1

en: Dressed to the nines! As befits such an important occasion.
ko: 머리부터 발끝까지 완벽하게 차려입으셨군요! 이토록 중요한 연회에 걸맞은 모습입니다.

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)
detail: Encounters_Restaurant Encounters_Disruption of The Wedding Mission_Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)_Text_12_1

en: Secondly, if the Count deems you worthy of conversation, fulfill all his wishes.
ko: 둘째, 만약 백작님께서 손님과 대화할 가치가 있다고 판단하시면, 백작님의 모든 뜻을 거스르지 말고 따르십시오.

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)
