context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)
detail: Encounters_Restaurant Encounters_Disruption of The Wedding Mission_Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)_Text_4_1

en: He is very interested in what business you have with him.
ko: 백작님께서도 손님이 대체 무슨 용무로 찾아오셨는지 무척 흥미로워하고 계십니다.

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)
detail: Encounters_Restaurant Encounters_Disruption of The Wedding Mission_Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)_Text_10_1

ko: 첫째, 백작님께서는 건방지거나 무례한 태도를 결코 용납하지 않으십니다.

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)

context: Start (Scene - Disruption of The Wedding Head Waiter Meeting)

en: Many people want to crawl under my throne, I'll look there!
ko: 제 왕좌 밑으로 기어들어 오고 싶어 하는 이들이 많으니, 거기부터 찾아봐야겠군요!

ru: Твоя жизнь, <male>сынок</male><female>дочка</female>, тебе и решать. Помни мои советы — и береги себя!
en: It's your life, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, it's up to you to decide. Remember my advice—and take care of yourself!
ko: 네 인생이니 결정하는 것도 네 몫이다, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아. 내 충고를 잊지 말고 — 몸조심하거라!

en: What did you answer?

ru: Я свою жизнь не собираюсь подстраивать под волю каких-то престарелых аристократов. Не бывать такому!
en: I'm not going to shape my life around the whims of a bunch of old aristocrats. I won't have it!
ko: 난 저 늙은 귀족들의 변덕에 내 인생을 맞출 생각 없어. 절대 그럴 일은 없을 거야!

context: Dare Traums (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Let them just try!

context: Dare Traums (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Dare Traums (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ха, пусть они только попробуют тронуть меня! И тебя тоже в обиду не дам.
en: Ha, let them try anything! And I won't let them hurt you, either.
ko: 하, 감히 날 건드려 보라지! 우리 둘 다 절대 당하고만 있진 않을 거야.

context: Dont Care (Action - Traums Return Encounter)

ru: Не переживай. Я и не собираюсь в эти дела лезть. У меня своя жизнь.
en: Don't worry. I'm not going to interfere in these matters. I have my own life.
ko: 걱정하지 마. 난 이 일들에 간섭하지 않을 거야. 나 역시 나만의 삶이 있으니까.

context: Dont Care (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: Why should I care?

context: Dont Care (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Dont Care (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Да ладно тебе, не волнуйся. Ну вернулись эти Траумы. Ну хотят спасти Брокен. Я-то здесь причем?
en: Oh, come on, don't worry. So those Traums are back. So they want to save Brocken. What does this have to do with me?
ko: 에이, 걱정하지 마. 뭐, 트라움 가문이 돌아왔기로서니, 브로켄을 구하겠다고 나섰기로서니, 그게 나랑 무슨 상관이겠어?

context: Traums Dont Matter (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Traums Dont Matter (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Теперь другие времена. А Траумы эти никому не нужны. Пусть делают, что хотят. А у меня своя жизнь имеется!
en: Times have changed. No one needs these Traums anymore. Let them do what they want. And I have my own life!
ko: 이제 시대가 변했어. 저 트라움 가문 따윈 아무도 필요로 하지 않아. 마음대로 하라지. 나에겐 내 삶이 있으니까!

context: Traums Dont Matter (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: The Traums don't matter

context: Traums Dont Matter (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Traums Dont Matter (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: С каких пор весь Город так трепещет из-за этой Семьи и ее непонятных планов? Их время давно прошло.
en: Since when has the entire City been so worried about this Family and weird plans of theirs? Their time has long passed.
ko: 언제부터 온 도시가 저 가문과 그들의 알 수 없는 계획 따위에 이렇게 벌벌 떨었다고 그래? 저들의 시대는 이미 한참 전에 끝났어.

context: Be Cautious (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Be Cautious (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Не переживай. Я буду вести себя разумно. Все со мной будет в порядке.
en: Don't worry. I'll be reasonable. I'll be fine.
ko: 걱정하지 마. 분별 있게 행동할 테니까. 난 아무 일 없을 거야.

context: Be Cautious (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Name
en: I'll be more careful

context: Be Cautious (Action - Traums Return Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Actions_Be Cautious (Action - Traums Return Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Все так. Я буду осторожней. Мне совершенно незачем лишнее внимание.
en: That's right. I'll be more careful. I don't need any extra attention.
ko: 맞아. 앞으로 더 조심할게. 괜히 눈에 띄어서 좋을 게 없으니까.

context: Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: Time was now running faster and faster.
ko: 이제 시간은 점점 더 빨라지고 있었다.

context: Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Вы были увлечены своим делом, а Город жил своей жизнью.
en: You were deep into your work, and the City was living its own life.
ko: 당신은 자신의 일에 온전히 몰두해 있었고, 도시는 그 자체의 삶을 살아가고 있었다.

context: Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Не к добру это, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>! Никогда я от этих богатеев не ждал ничего хорошего, несмотря на все их благие дела.
en: This is not a good sign, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>! I never expected anything good from these rich people, despite all their past noble deeds.
ko: 좋은 징조가 아니구나, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아! 저 부자들이 과거에 아무리 선행을 베풀었다 한들, 난 저자들에게서 좋은 꼴을 기대한 적이 없다.

context: Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Но мне-то уже что. За тебя волнуюсь, <username>. Держись подальше от этой Семьи и их непонятных дел.
en: I'm not worried about myself, I'm worried about you, <username>. Stay away from this Family and their strange dealings.
ko: 나야 이제 상관없지만 네가 걱정되는구나, <username>. 저 가문과 그들의 수상쩍은 일들에는 가까이 가지 마라.

context: Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Что бы они там ни затевали... У тебя — свое дело, у них — свое. Пускай так и останется. Верно, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>?
en: Whatever they're up to... You mind your own business, they will mind theirs. Let it stay that way. Right, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>?
ko: 저들이 무슨 꿍꿍이를 꾸미든... 넌 네 일만 신경 쓰고, 저들은 저들 일이나 신경 쓰라지. 그냥 그렇게 지내는 게 상책이다. 그렇지, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아?

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Где они были? Что с ними стало? Что они собираются делать теперь?
en: Where were they? What happened to them? What are they going to do now?
ko: 그들은 어디에 있었을까? 그들에게 무슨 일이 일어났던 걸까? 이제 그들은 무엇을 하려는 것일까?

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: День, когда исчезнувшая Семья Траум неожиданно вернулась.
en: The day the missing Traum Family unexpectedly returned.
ko: 사라졌던 트라움 가문이 예기치 않게 돌아온 날이었다.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
en: But they came back changed...

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Ни у кого не было ответов.
en: No one had answers.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Настал день, которого многие в Городе уже и не ждали.
en: The day has arrived that many in the City were no longer expecting.
ko: 도시의 많은 이들이 더 이상 기대하지 않았던 그날이 이제 도래했다.

context: Benefactor Orphan Leaves (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Leaves (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Делай, как знаешь, <male>мальчик мой</male><female>девочка моя</female>. Просто помни о старенькой нищенке, которая тебе помогала как могла. Береги себя!
en: Do as you please, <male>my boy</male><female>my girl</female>. Just remember the old beggar woman who helped you as best she could. Take care of yourself!
ko: 네 뜻대로 거라, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>. 다만 있는 힘껏 널 도왔던 이 늙은 거지 할망구만은 잊지 말아 다오. 몸조심하거라!

context: Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Помяни мое слово. Беду они с собой принесли, <male>мой мальчик</male><female>моя девочка</female>!
en: Mark my words. They brought trouble with them, <male>my boy</male><female>my girl</female>!
ko: 내 말을 명심하거라. 저들이 재앙을 몰고 왔단다, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>!

context: Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Волнуюсь я за тебя, <username>. Уж не знаю, что они затевают, но как бы тебе не попасться им под руку...
en: I'm worried about you, <username>. I don't know what they're up to, but I hope you don't get caught in their clutches...
ko: <username>, 난 네가 걱정되는구나. 저들이 무슨 짓을 꾸미는지는 몰라도, 행여나 저들의 마수에 걸려들지나 않을지...

context: Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Чует мое сердце — такие, как ты, им теперь как бельмо на глазу.
en: My heart tells me that people like you are now a thorn in their side.
ko: 내 육감이 말해주는구나 — 이제 너 같은 사람들은 저들에게 눈엣가시나 다름없을 거라고 말이다.

context: Poor Mother Leaves (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Leaves (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Понимаю, <male>сынок</male><female>дочка</female>. Что бы ни случилось, решать здесь тебе. Просто о матушке не забывай и береги себя ради нее!
en: I understand, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. Whatever happens, it's up to you to decide. Just don't forget about your mother and take care of yourself for her sake!
ko: 알겠어, <male>아들아</male><female>딸아</female>. 무슨 일이 일어나든 결정하는 건 네 몫이야. 그저 어머니를 잊지 말고, 어머니를 위해 스스로를 잘 돌봐!

context: Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ох, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>, все это не к добру! Поверь, это уже не те Траумы, к которым тебя водили на прием.
en: Oh, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, nothing good will come out of it! Believe me, these are not the same Traums you were taken to see.
ko: 아, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아, 이건 결코 좋은 결과로 이어지지 않을 거야! 믿어다오, 저들은 네가 예전에 알현하러 갔던 그 트라움 가문 사람들이 아니란다.

context: Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Волнуюсь за тебя, <username>. Боюсь, что пересекутся ваши с ними пути.
en: I'm worried about you, <username>. I'm afraid you will cross paths with them.
ko: <username>, 네가 걱정돼. 네가 그들과 마주칠까 봐 두려워.

context: Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Обещай мне, что будешь вести себя разумно и не станешь подставляться под удар...
en: Promise me that you will behave sensibly and not put yourself in harm's way...
ko: 제발 이성적으로 행동해서 스스로 위험한 상황에 처하지 않겠다고 약속해 줘...

context: Poor Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ох, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>, не нравится мне это! Уж не знаю, где они пропадали и что с ними случилось, но тут жди беды!
en: Oh, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, I don't like this! I don't know where they disappeared to or what happened to them, but expect trouble!
ko: 아, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아, 영 불길하구나! 어디로 사라졌다가 무슨 일을 겪고 돌아온 건지는 몰라도, 분명 큰 사달이 날 거야!

en: I'm worried about you, <username>. Take care of yourself, stay out of their sight. Who knows what they're up to...
ko: <username>, 난 네가 걱정되는구나. 스스로 몸조심하고, 저들 눈에 띄지 마라. 저들이 무슨 짓을 꾸미고 있는지 누가 알겠니...

context: Poor Mother Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)

ru: Хотя бы ради спокойствия матери — будь осторожней!
en: If only for your mother's peace of mind, be careful!
ko: 적어도 이 어미가 마음이라도 놓을 수 있게 — 부디 몸조심거라!

context: Rich Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)

ru: Беда, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>! Точно тебе говорю — это уже не те Траумы, к которым тебя водили на прием.
en: Here comes trouble, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>! I can tell you for sure—these aren't the same Traums you were taken to see.
ko: 큰일 났구나, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아! 분명히 말해주마. 저자들은 네가 예전에 알현하러 갔던 그 트라움 가문이 아니야.

context: Rich Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)

ru: Куда они зашли в своих поисках? Боюсь даже представить.
en: Where did they end up in their wanderings? I'm afraid to even imagine.

context: Rich Father Talks (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)

ru: Волнуюсь за тебя, <username>. Тревожные времена настают в Городе. Но ты ведь не станешь вмешиваться не в свое дело? Верно, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>?
en: I'm worried about you, <username>. Troubled times are coming in the City. But you wouldn't interfere in something that wasn't your business, would you, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>?
ko: <username>, 네가 걱정되는구나. 도시에 뒤숭숭한 시절이 다가오고 있어. 하지만 넌 네 소관이 아닌 일에 굳이 끼어들진 않겠지? 그렇지, 내 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아?

context: Poor Father Leaves (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)

en: It's your life, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, it's up to you to decide. Whatever happens, take care of yourself!
ko: 네 인생이니 결정하는 것도 네 몫이다, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아. 무슨 일이 있어도 꼭 몸조심하거라!

en: I understand, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. Whatever happens, it's up to you to decide. Just don't forget about your mother and take care of yourself for her sake!

ru: Твоя шуба стоит целое состояние и привлекает восхищенные взгляды.
en: Your fur coat costs a fortune and attracts admiring glances.
ko: 값비싼 모피 코트가 사람들의 감탄 어린 시선을 사로잡는다.

context: Check - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Внутри появляется чувство собственной значимости. Ты можешь позволить себе все.
en: A sense of self-worth emerges within. You can afford anything.
ko: 내면에서 자부심이 피어오른다. 지금의 당신은 무엇이든 누릴 수 있다.

context: Transformation - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Transformation - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Осталось только сесть на углу, ссутулившись, и протянуть слабую руку. Подайте...
en: All that was left was to sit on the corner, hunched over, and extend a weak hand. Give...
ko: 남은 것은 모퉁이에 웅크리고 앉아 힘없는 손을 내미는 것뿐이었다. 주세요...

context: Transformation - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)

ru: Шум и грязь улиц тебе родны. Ты не боишься затхлых углов.
en: The noise and dirt of the streets are familiar to you. You are not afraid of musty corners.
ko: 거리의 소음과 오물이 친숙하게 느껴진다. 퀴퀴한 구석진 곳도 전혀 두렵지 않다.

ko: 이 모든 것에는 다 이유가 있다.

ru: Кажется нужно подкинуть ещё угля. Иначе ход замедлится...
en: Looks like we need to add more coal. Otherwise, things will slow down...
ko: 석탄을 좀 더 넣어야 할 것 같다. 그렇지 않으면 속도가 느려질 테니까...

context: Transformation - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)

ru: Вспомни копоть, шум поршней и жар у своего лица.
en: Remember the soot, the noise of the pistons and the heat in your face.
ko: 검댕과 피스톤의 소음, 그리고 얼굴로 확 끼쳐오는 열기를 떠올려 보라.

ru: В твоей кружке для милостыни уже гремит пара медяков.
en: There are already a couple of copper coins rattling in your alms cup.
ko: 구걸용 깡통 안에서는 벌써 동전 몇 푼이 달그락거리고 있다.

detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Грязь на тебе как вторая кожа. Лучше любого грима.
en: Dirt is like a second skin on you. Better than any makeup.
ko: 몸에 묻은 오물이 마치 제2의 피부처럼 자연스럽다. 그 어떤 분장보다도 훌륭하다.

context: Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: <male>Образ бездомной женщины вызовет больше сочувствия, чем подозрений...</male><female>Образ бездомного мужчины выглядит более убедительным.</female>
en: <male>The image of a homeless woman will evoke more sympathy than suspicion...</male><female>The image of a homeless man looks more convincing.</female>
ko: <male>노숙자 여인의 행색은 의심보다 동정심을 더 불러일으킬 것이다...</male><female>노숙자 남성의 행색이 한결 더 그럴듯해 보인다.</female>

context: Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Этот костюм сменил много хозяев... Но еще пригоден для последнего рывка.
en: This suit has changed many owners... But it is still fit for the final push.
ko: 이 정장은 수많은 주인을 거쳤지만... 여전히 마지막 도전에 쓸 만하다.

context: Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Lowlife Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Мир оставил тебя на обочине. Ты чувствуешь зов улиц? Теперь ты <female>своя</female> <male>свой</male> в этих темных переулках.
en: The world has left you on the sidelines. Do you feel the call of the streets? Now you belong in these dark alleys.
ko: 세상은 당신을 길가로 내몰았다. 거리의 부름이 느껴지는가? 이제 이 어두운 골목이 바로 당신의 구역이다.

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Униформа машиниста сидит на тебе идеально. Ничего не сковывает движения.
en: The driver's uniform fits you perfectly. Nothing restricts your movement.
ko: 기관사 제복이 몸에 딱 맞는다. 움직이는 데 걸리는 것도 없다.

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Вымазанное сажей лицо... Неотъемлемый атрибут рабочего класса.
en: A face smeared with soot... An integral attribute of the working class.
ko: 검댕이 묻은 얼굴... 노동자 계급의 빼놓을 수 없는 상징이다.

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Чувствуешь себя увереннее, имея удостоверение машиниста. Важная деталь.
en: You feel more confident having a driver's license. An important detail.
ko: 기관사 자격증이 있으면 더욱 자신감이 생긴다. 중요한 요소다.

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Когда надеваешь униформу, разница между мужчиной и женщиной стирается.
en: When you put on a uniform, the difference between a man and a woman is erased.

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Лопата в руках даёт возможность пройти куда угодно... В пределах перрона.
en: A shovel in your hands gives you the opportunity to go anywhere... Within the platform.
ko: 손에 삽을 쥐고 있으면 플랫폼 안에서는 어디든 갈 수 있다...

context: Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Check - Machinist Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Ты всегда <male>мечтал</male><female>мечтала</female> водить поезд... Теперь ты — его разум и руки...
en: You always <male>dreamed</male><female>dreamed</female> of driving a train... Now you are its mind and hands...
ko: 언제나 기차를 몰아보는 것을 <male>꿈꿔 왔다</male><female>꿈꿔 왔다</female>... 이제 당신은 저 기차의 두뇌이자 두 손이다...

context: Transformation - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Transformation - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Слуги бегают вокруг тебя. Разносится весёлый смех.
en: Servants run around you. Merry laughter echoes.
ko: 하인들이 당신 주위를 분주히 뛰어다닌다. 유쾌한 웃음소리가 울려 퍼진다.

context: Transformation - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_CAPITAL RAILWAY STATION ESCAPE_PROLOGUE Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching_Scenes_Transformation - Expensive Look (Scene - Railway Station Escape - Resume For Player Before Searching)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Нужно лишь махнуть рукой и тебе принесут вина.
en: You just have to wave your hand and they will bring you wine.
ko: 손짓 한 번이면 하인들이 와인을 대령할 것이다.

ru: Все же <male>попал ты под удар, сын</male><female>попала ты под удар, дочь</female>! Так и знал, что Семья до тебя доберется.
en: They've put you through the wringer, son! I knew the Family would get you.
ko: 결국 화를 피하지 못했구나, 내 아이야! 그 가문이 끝내 너에게 마수를 뻗칠 줄 알았다.

context: Rich Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Но знай, я-то по-прежнему на твоей стороне. Хоть и не смог тебя уберечь от изгнания...
en: But know this: I'm still on your side. Even though I couldn't save you from exile...
ko: 하지만 분명히 기억해라. 나는 여전히 네 편이다. 비록 너를 추방당하는 것으로부터는 구해주지 못했지만...

context: Rich Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Уж прости старика... Надеюсь, доживу до времени, когда ты вернешься!
en: Forgive your old man... I hope I live to see the time when you return!
ko: 노인을 용서해다오... 네가 돌아오는 그날을 직접 봤으면 좋겠구나!

context: Leaving (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)

en: To the station. The train will take you far from home.

ko: 안녕, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>. 집에서 멀리 떠난 이 낯선 땅에서 아무 일도 당하지 마라!

en: Farewell, <male>my son</male><female>my daughter</female>. Know that I will always be waiting for you at home...
ko: 잘 가거라, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>. 이 엄마는 언제까지나 집에서 널 기다리고 있을 거야...

ru: Прощай, <male>мой сынок</male><female>моя дочка</female>. Пока не помру, все равно буду тебя ждать домой...
en: Farewell, <male>my son</male><female>my daughter</female>. I'll be waiting for you to come home until the day I die...
ko: 안녕, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>. 나는 죽는 그날까지 네가 집으로 돌아오기를 기다릴 거야...

context: Choice - Farewell to Relative (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Description
en: What was your farewell like?

context: Farewell - Calm Down (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Calm Down (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ничего здесь не поделать. Но не переживай ты так. Жизнь-то продолжается.
en: There's nothing you can do about it. But don't worry so much. Life goes on.
ko: 어쩔 수 없는 일이야. 하지만 너무 상심하지 마. 그래도 삶은 계속되니까.

context: Farewell - Calm Down (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Calm Down (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Все со мной будет хорошо. Даже вдали от тебя и дома.
en: Everything will be fine with me. Even far from you and home.
ko: 난 아무 일 없을 거야. 이렇게 고향 집을 떠나 멀리 떨어져 있게 되더라도 말이야.

context: Farewell - Calm Down (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Name
en: Give consolation

context: Farewell - Doubt You Return (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Doubt You Return (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Увы, но вряд ли мы с тобой увидимся снова. Зачем себя обманывать...
en: Alas, it's unlikely we'll see each other again. No need to pretend...
ko: 아아, 우리가 다시 만날 가능성은 거의 없어. 굳이 거짓말을 할 필요는 없지...

context: Farewell - Doubt You Return (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Name
en: Doubt you'll meet again

context: Farewell - Doubt You Return (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Doubt You Return (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Пойду искать новую жизнь. А ты меня не забывай, но и уже не жди...
en: I'll go look for a new life. Do not forget me, but don't wait for me either...
ko: 나는 새로운 삶을 찾아 떠날 거야. 나를 잊지는 말아줘. 하지만 더 이상 나를 기다리지도 말아줘...

context: Farewell - Assure You Will Be Back (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Assure You Will Be Back (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Надолго не прощаемся! Я знаю — я обязательно вернусь. Им не лишить меня дома!
en: Our farewell is not for long! I know I'll definitely be back. They won't take my home away from me!
ko: 우리의 이별은 오래가지 않아! 분명히 다시 돌아올 거야. 그들은 내 집을 빼앗아 갈 수 없어!

context: Farewell - Assure You Will Be Back (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Name
en: I'll come back!

context: Farewell - Assure You Will Be Back (Action - Setup Leaving City)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Actions_Farewell to Relative - Actions_Farewell - Assure You Will Be Back (Action - Setup Leaving City)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: И ты увидишь меня уже скоро...
en: And you will see me soon...
ko: 곧 나를 다시 보게 될 거야...

context: Farewell - Cry (Action - Setup Leaving City)

context: Farewell - Cry (Action - Setup Leaving City)

en: Burst into tears

context: Benefactor Orphan Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)

en: Such a misfortune, <username>! My poor little thing...
ko: 정말 불행한 일이 일어났구나, <username>! 내 가련한 아이야...

context: Benefactor Orphan Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Столько лет рядом с тобой. Ты ведь мне как <male>родной</male><female>родная</female>...
en: So many years by your side. You're like family to me...
ko: 네 곁에서 그렇게 오랜 세월을 함께 보냈는데. 넌 내게 친핏줄이나 다름없단다...

context: Benefactor Orphan Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Benefactor Orphan Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: А что же теперь с тобой будет, <male>мальчик мой</male><female>девочка моя</female>...
en: What will happen to you now, <male>my boy</male><female>my girl</female>...
ko: 이제 너에게 무슨 일이 일어나겠니, <male>내 아들아</male><female>내 딸아</female>...

context: Poor Father Leaves (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Leaves (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ну прощай, <male>сынок</male><female>дочка</female>. Держись, не унывай. Ты справишься.
en: It's a goodbye then, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. Hang in there, don't lose heart. You will be fine.
ko: 그럼 이제 작별이로군, <male>아들아</male><female>딸아</female>. 힘내고 낙심하지 마. 괜찮아질 거야.

context: Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Доживу ли, чтобы тебя вновь увидеть, <username>?..
en: Will I live to see you again, <username>?...
ko: 내가 살아생전에 널 다시 볼 수나 있을까, <username>?...

context: Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ох, молила я тебя, просила... Но, видно, так уж тому суждено.
en: Oh, I begged and begged you... But, it seems, this is how it was always supposed to happen.
ko: 아아, 내가 그렇게나 말리고 애원했건만... 아무래도 이렇게 될 운명이었나 보구나.

context: Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
en: You're leaving a mother without a <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>, <username>...
ko: <username>... 이 어미를 <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>도 없이 홀로 남겨 두고 떠나는구나...

context: Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Знаю, нет в том твоей вины. Не по твоей воле меня с тобой разлучают.
en: I know it's not your fault. It's not by your own will that you're leaving me.
ko: 네 잘못이 아니라는 걸 알아. 네 의지와는 상관없이 나를 떠나는 거란다.

context: Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Эх, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>! Я ж говорил — быть беде... Зря меня не слушаешь.
en: Oh, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>! I told you there would be trouble... It's a shame you didn't listen.
ko: 아, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아! 내가 곤경이 닥칠 거라고 했잖아... 내 말을 듣지 않다니 정말 안타깝구나.

context: Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
en: But what can you do now...

context: Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Poor Father Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Что тебя там ждет, вдали от нас? Но я в тебя верю, ты все выдержишь. И однажды увидимся снова. Так, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>?
en: What awaits you there, far from your parents? But I believe in you, you will endure anything. And one day we will see each other again. Right, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>?
ko: 부모 곁을 떠나 머나먼 타지에서 무슨 일을 겪게 될지... 하지만 난 널 믿는다. 넌 무엇이든 이겨낼 거야. 그리고 언젠가 우리 다시 만나게 되겠지. 그렇지, <male>아들</male><female>딸</female>아?

context: Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: <male>Бедный мой сын</male><female>Бедная моя дочь</female>! Как эта Семья с тобой подло обошлась!
en: <male>My poor son</male><female>My poor daughter</female>! How awful this crooked Family treated you!
ko: <male>불쌍한 내 아들아</male><female>불쌍한 내 딸아</female>! 그 비열한 가문이 너를 어쩌면 이리도 모질게 대했단 말이니!

context: Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Лишили меня <male>любимого сына</male><female>любимой дочери</female>, нелюди бессердечные!
en: They deprived me of my <male>beloved son</male><female>beloved daughter</female>, heartless monsters!
ko: 무정한 괴물들! 내 <male>사랑하는 아들</male><female>사랑하는 딸</female>을 빼앗아 간 자들이야!

context: Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Mother Appears (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Доживу ли, чтобы тебя вновь увидеть, <username>?..
en: Will I live to see you again, <username>?...
ko: <username>, 내가 살아생전에 널 다시 볼 수 있을까?...

context: Rich Father Leaves (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_27 - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_Scenes_Rich Father Leaves (Scene - (Hero Generation) Setup Leaving City (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ну прощай, <male>сын</male><female>дочь</female>. Что смог, дал тебе. Дальше — <male>сам</male><female>сама</female> справишься. Не забывай отца.
en: Farewell, <male>son</male><female>daughter</female>. I gave you what I could. From now on, you are on your own. Just don't forget your father.
ko: 안녕, <male>아들아</male><female>딸아</female>. 내가 줄 수 있는 것은 모두 줬다. 이제부터는 혼자서 살아가야 한다. 아버지를 잊지 마렴.

context: (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter

detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_MYSTERIOUS GUEST VISIT MISSION ENCOUNTERS_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)_MainTacts_Text_20_1

en: It will squeeze. And squeeze. And squeeze. Until it crushes you.
ko: 계속해서 짓누를 것이다. 또 짓누르고, 또 짓누를 것이다. 너를 으스러뜨릴 때까지.

ru: Ваша съемная квартира в Столице словно стала для вас новой траншеей, из которой нельзя даже высунуться.
en: Your rented apartment in the Capital has become like a new trench to you, from which you can’t even stick your head out.
ko: 수도에 얻은 셋방은 마치 고개조차 내밀 수 없는 새로운 참호처럼 느껴졌다.

context: Start - Cutscene (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_MYSTERIOUS GUEST VISIT MISSION ENCOUNTERS_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)_MainTacts_Text_21_1
en: Unless you overcome the attack.

ru: Ваша съемная квартира в Столице словно стала для вас новой тюрьмой.
en: Your rented apartment in the Capital seemed to have become a new prison for you.
ko: 수도에 있는 당신의 임대 아파트는 마치 당신을 가둔 새로운 감옥이 된 것 같았다.

context: Start - Cutscene (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_MYSTERIOUS GUEST VISIT MISSION ENCOUNTERS_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)_MainTacts_Text_17_1
ru: Ожидание... Оно сводит с ума... Как же вырваться из этого плена!
en: Waiting... It can drive you insane... How can you escape it?!
ko: 기다림... 그것은 사람을 미치게 만든다... 도대체 어떻게 이 고통에서 벗어날 수 있을까?!

context: Start - Cutscene (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_MYSTERIOUS GUEST VISIT MISSION ENCOUNTERS_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Нет! Снова Страшная Мысль.. Снова приступ!
en: No! Terrible Thought again... Again this attack!
ko: 안 돼! 또다시 ‘끔찍한 생각’이... 또 발작이 시작됐어!

context: Stand Up From Bed (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)

en: It's so hard to get up...

context: Lay Down (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Actions_Description
ru: Так ли уж важно, подниметесь ли вы или нет...
en: What difference does it make whether you get up or not...

context: Lay Down (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed Encounter_Actions_Lay Down (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Stand Up from Bed)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

context: Deadman Introduction (Scene - Call from Deadman in Hub)

ko: 여기선 시간 감각을 유지하기가 쉽지 않군... 시시때때로 똬리를 틀며 뒤엉켜버리거든.

en: But the light still penetrates here, too. And sometimes it's so bright that you have to wear dark glasses!
ko: 하지만 빛은 여기까지 비집고 들어오더군. 가끔은 너무 눈이 부셔서 색안경이라도 써야 할 지경이야!

ko: 늘 그렇듯 굴러가지. 지금 그런 잡담이나 나눌 때가 아니네, 망자 동지.

context: Evade Answer (Action - Deadman Introduction - Call from Deadman In Hub Encounter)

ko: 이해하네, 산 자들은 잡담이나 떨 여유가 없겠지. 본론으로 들어가세.

context: Complain (Action - Deadman Introduction - Call from Deadman In Hub Encounter)

ru: Верно, кое-что теперь я в этом смыслю. Но главное, что я понял — всё скрытое гораздо ближе, чем казалось.

ru: Статую убрали с Площади не так давно. Должны же были остаться документы. Кто-то отвечал за демонтаж, кто-то получил жалованье за ее спуск в Нижний город.
en: The statue was removed from the Square not long ago. There had to be some documentation left behind. Someone was responsible for its removal, someone else was paid for its descent into the Lower Town.
ko: 광장에서 동상을 치워버린 게 그리 오래전 일이 아니야. 분명 문서가 남아 있을 걸세. 철거를 지휘한 자가 있었을 테고, 동상을 하부 도시로 내리는 대가로 보수를 챙긴 자도 있을 테니.

ko: 당신은 살아남았지만 그들은 그러지 못했다. 그러나 그 모든 비극에도 불구하고, 당신은 그 끔찍했던 날들의 기억을 지켜낼 것이다.

context: Embrace (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Picture of Fellow Soldiers)

en: The war itself may have been a senseless atrocity. But what you experienced alongside your fellow sufferers cannot be forgotten.
ko: 전쟁 자체는 무의미한 만행이었을지 몰라도, 고난을 함께 나눈 전우들과 겪은 기억마저 헛되이 버릴 수는 없다.

ko: 가증스러움. 비열함. 백치 같은 광기. 소위 ‘대전쟁’의 실체란 고작 그런 것이었다.

ko: 선생께선 왜 함께 가지 않으십니까? 당신의 지식이 큰 도움이 될 텐데요...

ko: 나는 도시의 주인을 배신했소. 그와의 맹약을 어겼지.

en: You are an outsider here, <username>. The Pact doesn't apply to you. You must go.
ko: <username>, 당신은 이곳의 이방인이오. 그 맹약은 당신에겐 얽매이지 않으니, 당신이 가야만 하오.

context: Ask Why He Is Not Coming (Action - Master of the City Initialization)

en: If his power is still with him... He will destroy me on the spot.
ko: 그자의 힘이 아직 온전하다면... 날 그 자리에서 멸해버릴 것이오.

context: Ask Why He Is Not Coming (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Questions_Ask Why He Is Not Coming (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1
en: I can't.

en: They will try to stop you with their moans and pleas. Don't listen to them!
ko: 신음과 애원으로 당신을 가로막으려 들 테지만, 결코 귀 기울이지 마시오!

context: Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_5_1
ru: Они лишь хотят не подпускать никого к статуе основателя.
en: They just want to keep anyone away from the founder's statue.
ko: 놈들은 창시자의 동상에 누구도 얼씬거리지 못하게 막으려는 것뿐이오.

context: Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_6_1
ru: Поэтому я и принес вам это.
en: That's why I brought this to you.
ko: 그래서 내가 이걸 당신에게 건네는 것이오.

context: Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
en: Don't expect an easy walk.
ko: 수월한 걸음이 될 거라곤 기대하지 마시오.

context: Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Shadows (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1
ru: Там, внизу издавна обитают некие создания. Жалкие, бесполезные — но все еще опасные!..
en: Some creatures have long lived down there. Pathetic, useless—but still dangerous!
ko: 저 아래엔 오래전부터 기거해 온 존재들이 있소. 가련하고 쓸모없는 것들이지만, 여전히 위험하지!

context: Take Lantern (Action - Master of the City Initialization)

en: You are now ready to go, <username>. May this light protect you.
ko: 이제 떠날 채비가 되었구려, <username>. 부디 이 빛이 당신을 지켜주기를.

context: Take Lantern (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Shadows_Name

en: Don't look inside yourself. There's something inside that's not worth seeing.
ko: 등불 안을 직접 들여다보진 마시오. 그 안에는 보아서는 안 될 것이 들어 있으니.

context: Take Lantern (Action - Master of the City Initialization)

en: Flashlight?...

detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Shadows_Take Lantern (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_6_1
ru: Этот свет в плену фонаря уже очень долго.
en: This light has been trapped in the lantern for a very long time.
ko: 이 빛은 아주 오랜 세월 동안 등불에 갇혀 있었소.

context: Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
ru: Спуск приведет вас в старое водохранилище.
en: The descent will take you to an old reservoir.
ko: 내려가다 보면 오래된 저수지가 나올 것이오.

context: Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1
ru: Траумы спрятали там статую Броккена, основателя Города.
en: The Traums hid there a statue of Brocken, the founder of the City.
ko: 트라움 가문이 도시의 창시자인 브로켄의 동상을 그곳에 숨겨두었지.

context: Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Statue Goal (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_3_1
ru: Наша цель — восстановить статую и заручиться, что память о Брокене послужит Заговору.
en: Our goal is to restore the statue and ensure that the memory of Brocken will serve the Cabal.
ko: 우리의 목표는 동상을 복원하고, 브로켄에 대한 기억이 비밀결사에 힘이 되도록 하는 것이오.

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
ru: Почему вообще важен союз с этим вашим Броккеном?
en: Why is an alliance with this Brocken of yours even important?
ko: 당신들이 말하는 그 브로켄과의 동맹이 대체 왜 그리 중요한 겁니까?

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1

en: We are talking about an old statue after all.
ko: 결국 오래된 동상 하나에 불과하지 않습니까.

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_3_1
ru: Броккен был и остается хозяином этого города. Траумы боятся его.
en: Brocken was and remains the master of this city. The Traums fear him.
ko: 브로켄은 과거에도, 지금도 이 도시의 주인이오. 트라움 가문은 그자를 두려워하고 있지.

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Name
en: Why do we need Brocken's help?

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_5_1
ru: Помяните мое слово — если он узнает, что сотворили с его Городом, он обрушит весь свой гнев на эту семейку.
en: Mark my words — if he finds out what was done to his City, he will unleash all his wrath on that family.
ko: 내 장담하건대, 자신의 도시가 어떻게 망가졌는지 알게 된다면 그 가문에 온 분노를 쏟아부을 것이오.

context: Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Why (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_4_1
ru: Иначе бы не пытались спрятать просто "статую" под землю.
en: Otherwise they wouldn't have tried to hide a simple "statue" underground.
ko: 그러지 않았다면 일개 ‘동상’ 따위를 땅속 깊이 파묻으려 들지도 않았을 게요.

context: Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
ru: Думаете, Броккен действительно поможет нашему делу?
en: Do you think Brocken will really help our cause?
ko: 브로켄이 정말 우리 대의를 도와줄 거라 보십니까?

context: Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1
ru: Броккен был и остается хозяином этого города. Траумы боятся его.
en: Brocken was and remains the master of this city. The Traums fear him.
ko: 브로켄은 과거에도, 지금도 이 도시의 주인이오. 트라움 가문은 그자를 두려워하고 있지.

context: Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_4_1
ru: Даже если это риск, я на него с радостью пойду.
en: Even if it's a risk, I'll gladly take it.
ko: 위험이 따른다 한들, 기꺼이 감수할 가치가 있소.

context: Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Name
en: Will he help?

context: Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Ask Will He Help (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_3_1
ru: Иначе бы не пытались спрятать "обычную статую" под землю.
en: Otherwise, they wouldn’t have tried to hide an “ordinary statue” underground.
ko: 그러지 않았다면 일개 ‘평범한 동상’을 땅속 깊이 파묻으려 들지도 않았을 게요.

context: Stay Silent (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Stay Silent (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1

en: And you don't like empty chatter.

context: Stay Silent (Action - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Name
en: Listen silently

detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Actions_Actions - Statue Goal_Stay Silent (Action - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_3_1
ru: Будем считать, что вы — человек дела...
en: Let's assume that you are a man of action...

context: Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
ru: Быть может, ваше мнение о Петре Броккене поменяется к тому моменту, как вы его найдете.
en: Perhaps your opinion of Petr Brocken will change by the time you find him.
ko: 표트르 브로켄을 직접 마주할 때쯤이면, 그자에 대한 당신의 생각도 달라져 있을지도 모르지.

context: Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_3_1
en: Go ahead.

context: Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing End (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1

en: But for the sake of the Conspiracy's victory we must stop at nothing.
ko: 허나 비밀결사의 승리를 위해서라면, 그 어떤 수단도 가리지 말아야 하오.

context: Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_4_1
ru: ...Что Он все еще здесь и согласиться помочь нашему делу.
en: ...That He is still here and will agree to help our cause.
ko: ...그분이 아직 이곳에 머물고 계시며, 우리 대의에 힘을 보태주실 거라는 희망 말이오.

context: Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_1_1
en: He was a great man.

context: Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)

en: We must learn from him. And hope...
ko: 우리는 그분에게서 배워야 하오. 그리고 희망을 품어야지...

context: Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)
detail: Encounters_MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Master of the City Encounters_Master of the City Briefing Encounter_Scenes_Briefing Alliance (Scene - Master of the City Initialization)_Text_2_1

en: A donation—and a mandatory one! What nonsense! Can you even hear yourself?
ko: 헌혈이라니, 그것도 강제로 뽑아가겠다니! 말도 안 되는 헛소리지! 자기들이 무슨 소릴 지껄이는지 알기나 한답니까?

en: The order states: "Mandatory blood donation for sick children of Brocken."
ko: 지침에 떡하니 적혀 있다잖소. ‘브로켄의 환아들을 위한 의무 헌혈’이라고!

en: What are you two putting on me?
ko: 왜 두 분이서 작당하고 절 몰아세우시는 거예요?

context: Support Passenger (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter))

en: Seriously, what kind of demands are these? It's against the law!
ko: 정말이지, 대체 무슨 터무니없는 요구입니까? 이건 명백한 위법입니다!

ko: 두 사람 다 수상쩍기 짝이 없네요! 경찰에 일러서 요주의 인물로 감시하라고 할 겁니다.

en: You too! Stop pressuring me!
ko: 당신까지 왜 이래! 사람 재촉하지 마쇼!

context: Ask To Haste (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter))
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Actions_Ask To Haste (Action - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter))_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Милейший, нельзя ли поторопиться? Вы здесь не один уехать хотите.
en: My dear, could you hurry up? You're not the only one who wants to leave here.
ko: 여보시오, 좀 서둘러 줄 수 없겠습니까? 여기서 열차 타려는 사람이 당신 혼자만은 아니잖소.

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Refuses to Give Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Вот вы замучили меня уже. Сами тогда будете объясняться, если вас задержат на выходе.
en: You've really worn me out. You'll be the one explaining it if they stop you on the way out.
ko: 아주 진을 다 빼놓으시네. 개찰구에서 제지당하면 그땐 본인이 알아서 해명하세요.

context: Passenger Refuses to Give Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Refuses to Give Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Всё, видите, вот и <female>госпожа</female><male>господин</male> подтверждает! Нет у вас такого права — кровь пассажиров собирать!
en: That's it, you see, and the <female>mistress</female><male>sir</male> confirms it! You have no right to collect passengers' blood!
ko: 거 봐요! 여기 <female>손님</female><male>손님</male>께서도 거드시잖소! 당신들에겐 승객 피를 강제로 뽑아갈 권리가 없어!

context: Passenger Refuses to Give Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)

en: Thanks for that.

en: I won't give it!

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Нет уж, я буду кипятиться! Я всю жизнь в Брокене живу, а тут, значит, опять новые правила! Сколько можно?!
en: No way, I'm going to get all worked up! I've lived in Brocken my whole life, and now there are new rules again! How much longer can this go on?!
ko: 화가 안 나게 생겼소! 평생을 브로켄에서 살았는데 또 무슨 괴상한 규칙질이야! 도대체 언제까지 이 지랄을 떨어야 하는 거요?!

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Гражданин, правила теперь такие. Все выезжающие в Брокен должны сдать кровь.
en: Citizen, the rules are as follows: Everyone traveling to Brocken must donate blood.
ko: 손님, 규정이 그렇단 말입니다. 브로켄행 승객은 예외 없이 헌혈에 응하셔야 해요.

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: А вы с меня всё трясете и трясете какие-то нелепости! Что за безобразие?!
en: And you keep shaking some nonsense out of me! What kind of outrage is this?!
ko: 그런데도 계속 말도 안 되는 억지를 부리고 있잖소! 이게 무슨 날벼락 같은 횡포요?!

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Да почему я вообще должен еще что-то сдавать? Билет у меня куплен.
en: Why should I even hand over anything else? I already bought my ticket.
ko: 내가 왜 딴것까지 내놓아야 하냐고! 승차권은 이미 제값 다 치렀단 말이오!

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Не я эти правила придумала. Пожалуйста, не кипятитесь и не задерживайте очередь.
en: I didn't make up these rules. Please don't get upset and don't hold up the line.
ko: 제가 만든 규정도 아니잖아요. 흥분하지 마시고 뒤엣사람들 줄이나 지체시키지 마세요.

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1

en: You're so eager to swear! I'm telling you, it's simply an order from your own Brocken authorities. Donate blood and be done with it!
ko: 말뽄새는 왜 그러세요! 승객님네 브로켄 당국에서 내려온 지침이라니까요. 피 한 번 뽑고 끝내면 될 일을!

context: Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Complains (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: I'm coming home! Home, do you hear?
ko: 난 내 집으로 돌아가는 거요! 내 집이라니까, 들려?!

context: Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1

en: That's it, you can go wait for your train.

context: Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Сразу бы так. И без ругани бы обошлись. Давайте руку.
en: If only we could have done it this way. We could have avoided all the swearing. Give me your hand.
ko: 진작 이러실 것이지, 괜히 목청만 높이셨잖아요. 팔 걷으세요.

context: Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Last Train to Brocken (Mission)_Encounters - Last Train to Brocken_(Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter Encounter_Scenes_Passenger Gives Blood (Scene - (Last Train to Brocken) Angry Passenger At Counter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ладно, берите скорей мою кровь для бедных деток.
en: Okay, take my blood quickly for the poor children.

ru: Да, они приглашают даже беспризорников и сирот. Вам-то, пожалуй, их поддержка более всего и нужна.
en: Yes, they even invite street children and orphans. You, perhaps, need their support most of all.
ko: 거리의 부랑아들과 고아들까지 빠짐없이 초대받는 자리이니 자네도 해당된 걸세... 자네에게도 그분들의 보살핌이 절실해 보이는군.

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Мне поручено передать вам, что вы приглашены на прием к самой Семье Траум!
en: I am instructed to inform you that you're cordially invited to a reception by the Traum Family!
ko: 트라움 가문께서 자네를 연회에 정중히 초대하셨다는 전갈을 받았다네! 내 직접 그 소식을 전하러 왔지.

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: В гостях ведите себя прилично! Смотрите не опозорьте свой Город перед ними!
en: Behave properly during your visit! Be careful not to disgrace your City in front of them!
ko: 방문 중에는 부디 품위 있게 처신하도록 하게! 그분들 면전에서 도시의 명예를 먹칠하는 짓은 결코 없어야 할 걸세!

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: This is the ancient Brocken tradition!

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Проявите себя достойно — еще и с подарком уйдете! Словом, ступайте. Не заставляйте Семью ждать!
en: Show yourself worthy and you'll even leave with a gift! Come on now, go. Don't keep the Family waiting!
ko: 품격 있게 처신한다면 선물까지 챙겨 돌아올 수 있을 게야! 자, 어서 가게나. 가문 어르신들을 기다리게 해선 안 되지!

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <male>Young man</male><female>Young lady</female>! Yes, yes, you.

context: Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Clerk Tells about Traums (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Надеюсь, вам известно, что эта семья — покровители нашего Города. Все дети, достигшие вашего возраста, должны прийти к ним в гости, почтить их вниманием и поблагодарить за заботу!
en: I hope you know that members of this noble family are patrons of our City. All children your age must pay them a visit, show them due respect, and thank them for their care!
ko: 이 고귀한 가문 어르신들이 우리 도시의 수호자라는 것쯤은 알고 있겠지? 자네 또래의 아이들은 모두 그분들을 찾아뵙고, 마땅한 예를 갖춰 은혜에 감사를 표해야 하네!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_11_1
ru: Честь имею — Командор Траум! Ну, не робей, <male>мальчик</male><female>девочка</female>. Пусть твои враги боятся. Я тебя не обижу.
en: Commander Traum salutes you! Come on, don't be afraid, <male>boy</male><female>girl</female>. It's your enemies who should fear me. I will do you no harm.
ko: 인사하지, 트라움 사령관이다! 자, 겁먹지 마라, <male>소년이여</male><female>소녀여</female>. 두려워해야 할 것은 네 적들이지 내가 아니다. 난 널 해치지 않는다.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_12_1
ru: Всегда заботятся, всегда защищают. А я могу бегать по нашему дворцу и играть сколько мне угодно!
en: They always take care of me, they always protect me. And I can run around our palace and play as much as I want!
ko: 언제나 날 돌봐주시고, 언제나 날 지켜주셔. 그리고 난 우리 저택 안을 마음껏 뛰어다니며 얼마든지 놀 수 있어!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: И я, и я хочу представиться! Можно, папа?
en: Me too, I want to introduce myself! May I, Dad?
ko: 저도요, 저도 소개하고 싶어요! 아빠, 해도 돼요?

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Это — мой сын, сам Командор Траум! Отнесись к нему с уважением. Он всегда стоит на твоей защите.
en: This is my son, Commander Traum himself! Treat him with respect. He will always stand by your side.
ko: 이쪽은 내 아들이자 트라움 사령관이다! 깍듯이 예를 갖추어 모시거라. 언제든 널 지켜주는 방패가 되어줄 테니.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Меня можешь называть Бабушкой Траум. На мне держатся традиции и порядки нашего любимого Города.
en: You can call me Grandma Traum. I uphold the traditions and customs of our beloved City.
ko: 난 트라움 할멈이라고 부르려무나. 우리가 사랑하는 도시의 전통과 질서를 짊어지고 있지.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Я многое знаю, многое храню — и почту за честь этим поделиться с тобой, малыш.
en: I know a great many things, and I'd gladly teach you. It would be my honor to share my wisdom with you, young one.
ko: 난 아는 것도, 품고 있는 것도 많단다. 어린 네게 지혜를 나눠줄 수 있다면 큰 영광이지.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Encounters_HERO GENERATION ENCOUNTERS_Hero Generation Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Заботиться о подрастающем поколении — извечное дело Семьи Траум!
en: Caring for the younger generation is the age-old responsibility of the Traum Family!
ko: 자라나는 어린 세대를 보살피는 것은 트라움 가문의 유구한 사명이다!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_12_1
ru: Предками мне вверено стоять на страже нашего Города от любых угроз. И я вместе со своей личной гвардией свято исполняю этот долг.
en: My ancestors entrusted me and my personal Guard regiment with the duty of protecting our City from all threats. And I carry out this duty faithfully.
ko: 선조들께선 나와 내 직속 근위대에게 온갖 위협으로부터 도시를 수호하라는 사명을 맡기셨다. 그리고 나는 그 사명을 신성히 받들고 있지.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: Так что пока я здесь, тебе бояться нечего!
en: So as long as I'm here, you have nothing to fear!
ko: 그러니 내가 이곳에 있는 한, 넌 아무것도 두려워할 필요가 없다!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_17_1
ru: Ну, довольно. К делу! Тебе, <male>мальчик</male><female>девочка</female>, полагается подарок от нашей Семьи.
en: Well, enough of that. Let's get down to business! You, <male>boy</male><female>girl</female>, are entitled to a gift from our Family.
ko: 자, 이만하면 됐겠지. 본론으로 가자! <male>소년이여</male><female>소녀여</female>, 넌 우리 가문이 내리는 선물을 받을 자격이 있다.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_18_1
ru: Какой выберешь — решать тебе! Смотри, что мы тебе приготовили. Подходи, не бойся.
en: Which one you choose is up to you! Look what we've prepared for you. Come, don't be shy.
ko: 어느 것을 고를지는 네 몫이다! 널 위해 준비한 것들을 보아라. 주저 말고 가까이 와서 보거라.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_11_1
ru: А я — их сын! У меня самая лучшая семья на свете. Они меня знаешь как любят!
en: And I'm their son! I have the best family in the world. You can't imagine how much they love me!
ko: 그리고 난 이분들의 아들이야! 세상에서 제일 멋진 가족이지. 우리 가족이 날 얼마나 사랑하는지 넌 모를걸!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: Let's get acquainted!

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Я — Госпожа Траум, попечительница всех детей города. Таков мой долг. Я готова помогать и заботиться обо всех вас, как родная мать.
en: I am Madam Traum, guardian of all the city's children. This is my duty. I am ready to help and care for you all, like a mother.
ko: 나는 트라움 부인이다. 도시의 모든 아이들을 보살피는 게 내 의무지. 친어머니처럼 너희 모두를 돕고 품어줄 준비가 되어 있단다.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_11 - (Hero Generation) Traum Introduction (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traum Introduction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Здравствуй, малыш! Вся наша семья так рада тебя видеть. Ты, должно быть, уже знаешь, кто мы такие?
en: Hello to you, darling! Our whole family is so happy to see you. You probably already know who we are?
ko: 안녕, 아가! 우리 온 가족이 널 보게 되어 정말 기쁘구나. 우리가 누구인지는 이미 잘 알고 있겠지?

en: So, calm down with your questions...

en: So you'd better get out of here, <male>good sir</male><female>good madam</female>.
ko: 그러니 <male>나리</male><female>아가씨</female>, 어서 여길 벗어나는 게 상책이야.

context: Ask about House (Action - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter))

en: I wouldn't be standing here if I didn't have to. Work doesn't lie on the floor these days...
ko: 나도 먹고살기 빠듯해서 여기 서 있는 거지, 요즘 같은 때 일자리가 길바닥에 굴러다니는 것도 아니고...

en: <male>Go</male><female>Go</female> I wish you'd get out of here already. You're a real pain in the ass...
ko: <male>어서 가라</male><female>어서 가라</female>, 당장 여길 떠났으면 좋겠는데. 넌 정말 골칫거리야...

en: This is the job! No worse and no better than others.
ko: 일이니까 하는 거지! 남들 일보다 나쁠 것도 좋을 것도 없어.

en: What does this have to do with me? I'm just keeping watch here. My job is small...
ko: 그게 나랑 무슨 상관인데? 난 그냥 여기서 경비나 서는 사람이야. 내 몫은 보잘것없다고...

context: Warn about Dangers (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)

ko: 그냥 넘어갈 일이 아니라고 생각하세요? 에휴... 내 일자리가 날아가겠네.

en: Have it your way. I'll take my paycheck and remember my name in the morning.
ko: 마음대로 하쇼. 난 일당이나 챙겨서 내일 아침에 뒤도 안 돌아보고 뜰 테니까.

ko: 지금이야 아무도 안 건드리지만, 내일이면 모든 게 달라질 수 있습니다...

en: To jail... I can't go to jail! I have a family...
ko: 감옥이라니... 난 감옥엔 절대 못 가! 먹여 살릴 식구가 있다고...

en: Your boss is a dangerous criminal. And he's paying you to cover up his dealings.
ko: 당신 주인이 위험한 범죄자요. 자기 짓거리를 숨겨주는 대가로 당신에게 돈을 주는 거라고.

context: Warn about Dangers (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Description
ru: Работа на Санитара сулит большие неприятности с законом.
en: Working for the Orderly promises big trouble with the law.
ko: 위생병 밑에서 일하다간 법적으로 큰 곤욕을 치르게 될 것이다.

en: I'm not one of those dissatisfied people. I live my own life and don't bother anyone.
ko: 난 그런 불만분자들과는 달라. 그저 조용히 남에게 폐 안 끼치고 살 뿐이라고.
