en: Don't you know what's going on inside the House?
ko: 저 집 안에서 무슨 짓이 벌어지는지 정말 모르십니까?

context: Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: They torture people there, drive them crazy! They mock them!
ko: 안에서 사람들을 고문하고 미치게 만들고 있다고요! 조롱하고 학대하면서!

context: Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Description
ru: Здесь держат и мучают "инакомыслящих" горожан. Она же не хочет стать одной из жертв?
en: This is where they hold and torture "dissident" citizens. She doesn't want to be one of the victims, does she?
ko: 이곳은 '반체제' 시민들을 가두고 고문하는 곳이다. 그녀도 피해자 중 한 명이 되고 싶진 않겠지?

context: Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: А со мной бы ничего такого не случилось.
en: Nothing like that would have happened to me.
ko: 나한테야 그런 일이 일어날 리 없지.

context: Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Tell about Prisoners (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Нечего меня пугать. Мне работать надо. Семью кормить.
en: There's no need to scare me. I need to work. I need to feed my family.
ko: 날 겁줄 생각 마. 난 일해야 해. 가족들을 먹여 살려야 한다고.

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1

en: Really? So that means you're better than the others?
ko: 그래? 그럼 넌 다른 사람들보다 뭐 그리 잘났단 말이냐?

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)

en: Go to hell with your morals. There are so many smartasses out there...
ko: 그놈의 도덕 타령은 집어치워! 잘난 척하는 것들이 너무 많아...

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Description
ru: Она потворствует чудовищным преступлениям и пыткам!
en: She condones monstrous crimes and torture!
ko: 그녀는 끔찍한 범죄와 고문을 방조하고 있다!

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)

ru: Бросайте эту так называемую работу и уходите!
en: Quit this so-called job and go away!
ko: 이런 허울뿐인 일 따위 집어치우고 당장 떠나세요!

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)

ru: Стоите тут и прикидываетесь, будто ничего не знаете! Будто это вас не касается!
en: You stand here and pretend like you know nothing! Like it doesn't concern you!
ko: 여기 서서 아무것도 모르는 척하고 있잖습니까! 자기 일은 아니라는 듯이!

ru: Как вам не стыдно помогать похитителю и палачу!
en: Aren't you ashamed to help a kidnapper and executioner!
ko: 유괴범이자 고문 기술자를 돕는 게 부끄럽지도 않습니까!

context: Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Actions_Actions - Negotiation Conscience Scene_Accuse (Action - Negotiation Conscience - Gatekeeper Conspirator is Kidnapped Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Хорошо тебе геройствовать. Небось семью кормить не надо!
en: It's easy for you to be a hero. I bet you don't have a family to feed!
ko: 영웅 놀음이야 쉽겠지. 넌 처자식 먹여 살릴 걱정은 없을 테니까!

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Scenes_Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: Надо же, военные к нам пожаловали? Неужто случилось что-то?
en: Wow, the military has come to visit us? Has something really happened?
ko: 어라, 군인 양반이 여긴 웬일이지? 무슨 일이라도 났나?

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)

en: Well, well! Are you lost by any chance, my dear?
ko: 이런, 이런! 혹시 길이라도 잃으셨나요, 얘야?

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Scenes_Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Надо же, официальная особа! А у нас тут все благочинно..
en: Well, what an official person! And here we have everything in order...
ko: 어머나, 점잖은 나리께서! 여긴 아무 문제 없이 잘 돌아가고 있는데요...

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Scenes_Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_15_1
ru: А я охранять поставлена, видишь. Так что дальше никак пустить не могу.
en: And I was assigned to guard it, you see. So I can't let you go any further.
ko: 난 여길 지키라는 분부를 받아서 말이지. 더는 못 들여보내 주네.

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)

ru: <male>Ишь какой оборвыш! Погреться пришел, что ли?</male><female>Ишь какая оборванка! Погреться пришла, что ли?</female> Поищи другое место!
en: <male>Look at you, you ragamuffin! Did you come to warm up or something?</male><female>Look at you, you ragamuffin! Did you come to warm up or something?</female> Find another place!
ko: <male>꼴을 보니 거지꼴이구만! 몸이라도 녹이러 왔나?</male><female>꼴을 보니 거지꼴이구만! 몸이라도 녹이러 왔나?</female> 딴 데나 알아봐!

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Scenes_Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Какая особа к нам пожаловала! Уж не знаю, чем могу служить...
en: What a person has come to visit us! I don't know how I can be of service...
ko: 어이쿠, 귀하신 분이 누추한 데를 다 찾아오셨네! 무엇을 도와드려야 할지 모르겠구려...

context: Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)
detail: Encounters_MANIAC LAIR MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounters_(Maniac Lair) Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_Scenes_Start - First Met (Scene - Gatekeeper (Conspirator is Kidnapped Mission Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
ru: А тут дальше нельзя! Частное владение.
en: And here we can't go any further! It's private property.

en: You are tired, my child. Rest here and don't run around the house!
ko: 피곤하겠구나, 아가야. 여기서 쉬렴, 집 안을 쏘다니지 말고!

context: Start (Scene - Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_HOME RUINS MISSION ENCOUNTERS_Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Не серди меня, дитя! Веди себя хорошо!
en: Don't make me angry, child! Behave well!
ko: 날 화나게 하지 마라, 아가야! 얌전히 굴어야지!

context: Start (Scene - Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_HOME RUINS MISSION ENCOUNTERS_Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Home Ruins Lady Traum Caught Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1

en: Then you will live a long and happy life in our new home!...
ko: 그러면 우리의 새 집에서 오래오래 행복하게 살 수 있을 게다!...

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Description
ru: Каким стало ваше дело в Городе?
en: What become your calling in the City?

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: Your City unfolded before you.

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Какие же пути открыли вам ваши способности? Город ждал, что вы принесете в него...
en: What lifepaths did your talents open for you? The City awaited your arrival and all that you would bring...
ko: 타고난 재능이 어떤 길을 열어주었을까? 도시는 당신의 도래와 함께 당신이 가져올 모든 것을 기다리고 있었다…

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Дитя городского дна, вы выросли на улицах. Но это осталось позади. Вы не были прикованы к своему происхождению. Теперь вы были готовы занять иное место в обществе.
en: A child of the city's underworld, you grew up on the streets. But that was behind you. You weren't chained to your origins. Now you were ready to claim a different place in society.
ko: 도시의 밑바닥에서 태어나 거리에서 자란 당신이었지만, 그 모든 것은 이제 과거의 일이었다. 당신은 출신에 얽매이지 않았다. 이제 사회에서 새로운 자리를 차지할 준비가 되어 있었다.

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Перед вами были открыты все пути. Ваши таланты требовали раскрыть себя.
en: All paths were open to you. Your talents demanded to be revealed.
ko: 모든 길이 활짝 열려 있었다. 당신의 재능이 펼쳐질 순간을 기다리고 있었다.

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Вы росли в бедности. Но теперь вы не были скованы нуждой и были способны заработать себе на хлеб. Вы могли сами избрать место в обществе.
en: You grew up in poverty. But now you were no longer shackled by need and were able to earn your own living. You could choose your own place in society.
ko: 가난 속에서 자랐지만, 이제 굶주림에 허덕이던 시절은 지났다. 제 손으로 밥벌이를 하며 스스로 설 자리를 선택할 수 있었다.

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Вы встали перед выбором дела, которым вы займетесь.
en: You were faced with a choice of what calling you will take on.
ko: 이제 어떤 소명을 짊어질지 선택해야 할 순간이었다.

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Вы выросли в достатке и роскоши. Но многое изменилось со времен детства. Теперь вы были готовы сами избрать свое место в обществе.
en: You grew up in prosperity and luxury. But much had changed since childhood. Now you were ready to choose your own place in society.
ko: 유복하고 풍요로운 품에서 자랐으나, 어린 시절 이후 많은 것이 변했다. 이제 사회 속에서 스스로 설 자리를 택할 준비가 되어 있었다.

context: Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Своими навыками вы успели вернуть здоровье десяткам горожан.
en: With your skills, you have managed to restore health to dozens of townspeople.
ko: 그동안 쌓은 기술로 수십 명의 시민들에게 건강을 되찾아주었다.

context: Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Name
en: Become a doctor

context: Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Вы стали врачом в одной из брокенских больниц.
en: You became a doctor in one of the Brocken hospitals.

context: Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: В медицине вас ждало большое будущее...
en: You had a great future in medicine...
ko: 의학의 길에서 눈부신 미래가 당신을 기다리고 있었다...

context: Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Doctor (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Вы ощутили силу лечить и возвращать к жизни, упорно бороться со смертью, исцелять раны и приносить покой.
en: You have felt the power to heal and bring back to life, to fight death, to heal wounds and bring peace.
ko: 상처를 치유하고 생명을 되살리며, 죽음에 맞서 끈질기게 싸우고 고통을 멎게 하는 힘을 온몸으로 실감했다.

context: Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ваши подопечные внимали вам, и в них разгорались искры будущих людей.
en: Your wards listened to you, and sparks of future people ignited within them.
ko: 제자들은 당신의 말에 귀를 기울였고, 그들의 가슴속에서 미래를 이끌어갈 불꽃이 피어났다.

context: Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Яркое будущее сулили и вам, <male>молодому учителю</male><female>молодой учительнице</female>...
en: A bright future was promised to you, young teacher...
ko: 젊은 교사인 당신에게도 찬란한 앞날이 약속되어 있었다...

context: Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Name
en: Become a teacher

context: Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Вы стали учителем. Еще недавно покинув детство, теперь уже вы сами делились знаниями со следующим поколением горожан.
en: You became a teacher. Having only recently left childhood behind, you were now sharing your knowledge with the next generation of city folk.
ko: 당신은 교사가 되었다. 어린 시절을 떠나보낸 지 얼마 되지 않아, 이제는 도시의 다음 세대에게 배움을 전해주고 있었다.

context: Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Teacher (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Тепло заботы о чужом будущем. Десятки обращенных к вам взоров.
en: The warmth of care for someone else's future. Dozens of eyes turned towards you.
ko: 타인의 미래를 보살피는 따스함. 당신을 향해 쏟아지는 수십 쌍의 눈빛.

en: But for the sake of future discoveries, you were willing to endure even greater hardships. You were taking your first steps toward a scientific career.
ko: 하지만 앞으로의 발견을 위해서라면 그보다 더한 고난도 기꺼이 견뎌낼 각오가 되어 있었다. 당신은 학자의 길을 향해 첫걸음을 내딛고 있었다.

en: You became a scientist. It was especially difficult in those years of hardship. There was barely enough money to live on.
ko: 당신은 학자가 되었다. 결핍으로 가득했던 그 시절에는 유독 쉽지 않은 길이었다. 끼니를 때울 돈조차 빠듯했다.

ru: Вам прочили блестящее будущее в науке...
en: You were predicted to have a brilliant future in science...
ko: 학계에서 눈부신 장래가 펼쳐질 것이라 모두가 입을 모았다...

en: You felt the call of the unknown, the excitement of an explorer, the thrill of a new discovery.
ko: 미지의 세계가 보내는 부름, 탐구자의 열정, 새로운 발견이 주는 벅찬 전율을 느꼈다.

en: You have already been promised a bright and extraordinary future...
ko: 이미 비범하고 찬란한 앞날이 약속되어 있었다...

ru: Вы стали художником и стали искать свой путь в искусстве.
en: You became an artist and began to search for your path in art.
ko: 당신은 화가가 되어 예술의 길을 탐색하기 시작했다.

context: Become Fine Artist (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Fine Artist (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Вы ощутили жар вдохновения, ярость взмахов кисти и пера, вечно ускользающий полет красоты.
en: You felt the heat of inspiration, the fury of the strokes of the brush and pen, the ever-elusive flight of beauty.
ko: 영감의 뜨거운 열기, 붓과 펜의 격렬한 손놀림, 영원히 손에 잡히지 않는 아름다움의 날갯짓을 느꼈다.

en: Your fight wasn't easy. The judges were old, lazy, and hardened. But you managed to save many of your clients from prison.
ko: 싸움은 결코 녹록지 않았다. 판사들은 늙고 나태하며 완고했다. 그러나 수많은 의뢰인을 감옥의 위기에서 구해냈다.

en: You became a lawyer. You defended those wrongfully convicted.
ko: 당신은 변호사가 되었다. 억울하게 죄를 뒤집어쓴 이들을 위해 변론을 펼쳤다.

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Lawyer (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Вы ощутили пламя речей, неукротимый дух борьбы с несправедливостью, радость победы своего дела.
en: You felt the flame of speeches, the indomitable spirit of the fight against injustice, the joy of victory for your cause.
ko: 불꽃 튀는 변론, 불의에 맞서는 꺾이지 않는 투지, 그리고 승리의 희열을 맛보았다.

en: After the Collapse, Broken slowly but surely rose and grew, thanks in part to your efforts.
ko: 붕괴 이후, 브로켄은 서서히 그러나 분명하게 다시 일어섰고, 그 성장의 밑바탕에는 당신의 땀방울도 깃들어 있었다.

en: You became a builder and erected new houses in your hometown.
ko: 건축가가 되어 고향 도시에 새로운 집들을 세워 올렸다.

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Builder (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

en: You felt the joy of creation, the hardness of stone, the heat of bricks being laid into a new building.
ko: 무언가를 창조하는 환희, 돌의 단단함, 차곡차곡 쌓여가는 벽돌의 온기를 느꼈다.

context: Become Freelancer (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Freelancer (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Вы были незаметны, но на труде вас и таких, как вы, держался Город.
en: You were invisible, but the City was held together by the work of you and others like you.
ko: 비록 눈에 띄진 않았지만, 도시를 지탱하는 것은 당신처럼 묵묵히 땀 흘리는 이들이었다.

ru: Вы жили скромной, но привольной жизнью. Будущее было безоблачно...
en: You lived a modest but comfortable life. The future was bright...
ko: 소박하지만 자유로운 삶을 누렸다. 앞날에는 아무런 먹구름도 없었다...

en: You didn't stick to one place or one job. You wandered around the city, taking on odd jobs and helping people for a living.
ko: 한곳에 얽매이거나 특정한 직업에 매이지 않았다. 도시를 떠돌며 닥치는 대로 일거리를 맡고, 끼니를 위해 남들을 도왔다.

context: Become Freelancer (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Actions_Choose Profession_Become Freelancer (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Вы ощутили вольный ветер, безрассудство скитаний по улицам, свободу простого труда.
en: You felt the wind in your hair, the recklessness of wandering the streets, the freedom of honest, simple work.
ko: 자유로운 바람, 거리를 누비는 호방함, 땀 흘려 일하는 솔직한 노동의 해방감을 느꼈다.

ko: 당신은 운동선수가 되었다. 인간 신체의 한계를 돌파하며 눈부신 활약으로 시민들에게 용기를 불어넣었다.

en: You felt the strength of your muscles, the excitement of competition, the pleasure of victory.
ko: 근육에서 솟구치는 힘, 승부의 짜릿함, 승리의 벅찬 쾌감을 느꼈다.

ko: 정말 훌륭하게 자랐구나! 얼마나 많이 자랐는지. 어엿하게 제 몫을 다하는 사람이 되었어. 요람에서 곤히 잠들었던 게 엊그제만 같은데...

ru: Его свет озарял вам путь к новым талантам и призваниям.
en: Its light illuminated your path to new talents and callings.
ko: 그 불빛이 새로운 재능과 천직으로 향하는 길을 밝혀주었다.

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_20 - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing (Encounter)_Scenes_Learn New Talent (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Огонь звал вас дальше — искать и открывать в себе новое.
en: The fire called you further—to search and discover something new within yourself.
ko: 내면의 불꽃이 당신을 재촉했다. 자신 안에 숨겨진 새로운 것을 찾아내라고.

en: You will gain the talent <color=#8080FFFF>Medicine</color>. You will be able to professionally treat yourself and others for wounds and illnesses.
ko: <color=#8080FFFF>의학</color> 특성을 획득합니다. 자신과 타인의 부상과 질병을 전문적으로 치료할 수 있게 됩니다.

en: You've entered medical school. For the next few years, you'll be immersed in mastering this challenging discipline.
ko: 당신은 의학교에 입학했다. 그 후 몇 년간 이 험난한 학문을 연마하는 데 온전히 몰두했다.

context: Gain Medicine Talent (Action - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)

en: The human body held many secrets. And you set out to uncover them.
ko: 인간의 몸에는 무수한 비밀이 깃들어 있었고, 당신은 그 비밀을 풀어내기로 결심했다.

en: You will gain the talent <color=#8080FFFF>Endurance</color>. You will become better able to overcome physical difficulties, pain, and fatigue.

en: We sit here night and day, doing nothing. And who are we supposed to guard this building from? Noone cares about it!
ko: 밤낮으로 여기서 멍하니 앉아만 있잖소. 대체 누구한테서 이 건물을 지키라는 건지 원? 거들떠보는 놈도 없는데!

ko: 타로는 허튼소리가 아니라고요! 당신이 뭘 알겠어요? 가서 순찰이나 한 바퀴 더 돌고 와요.

en: You're talking nonsense, Claudia... You've picked up some stupid things from all sorts of swindlers, and now you think you're a prophetess.

ko: 브로켄 외곽, 세상으로부터 숨어들 수 있었던 한적한 골목길에서 주웠다.

ko: 처음으로 스스로를 지켜낼 수 있었고, 그 돌은 믿음직한 무기가 되어 주었다.

ko: 돌멩이가 마침 손에 딱 쥐어졌고, 당신은 어린 강도 녀석들을 때려눕힐 수 있었다.

ko: 다른 길거리 부랑아들에게 막다른 길로 몰려, 마지막 남은 음식과 푼돈마저 빼앗길 뻔했다.

ru: ...А теперь к новостям с восточных окраин Республики.
en: ...And now to the news from the eastern reaches of the Republic.
ko: ...이제 공화국 동쪽 변방 지역의 소식을 전해드리겠습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)

ru: В городе Брокен раскрыт опасный заговор против властей!
en: A dangerous conspiracy against the authorities has been uncovered in the city of Brocken!
ko: 브로켄 시에서 당국을 겨냥한 위험한 비밀결사의 음모가 적발되었습니다!

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_11_1
ru: Насколько большую угрозу обществу все еще представляет собой Брокенский Заговор? Пока это остается неясным.
en: How much of a threat to society does the Brocken Conspiracy still pose? So far, it remains unclear.
ko: 브로켄 비밀결사가 사회에 아직 얼마나 큰 위협인지는 명확하지 않습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: По мнению заговорщиков, Семья Траум уже давно захватила настоящую власть над Брокеном, а вся городская верхушка — ее ставленники и марионетки.
en: According to the conspirators, the Traum Family has long since seized true power over Brocken, and the entire city elite are its henchmen and puppets.
ko: 결사 대원들의 주장에 따르면, 트라움 가문이 오래전부터 브로켄의 실권을 장악했으며 시 고위층은 꼭두각시에 불과하다고 합니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Городские власти объявили участие в Заговоре особо тяжким преступлением и посягательством на законную власть.
en: City authorities declared participation in the Conspiracy a criminal offense of the highest order.
ko: 도시 당국은 비밀결사 가담 행위를 최고 중범죄이자 반역죄로 선포했습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Канцлер Брокена сообщил, что Заговор уже обезглавлен, а все его известные сторонники либо схвачены, либо залегли на дно.
en: The Chancellor of Brocken announced that the Conspiracy's leadership had already been eliminated, and that all its known supporters had either been captured or gone into hiding.
ko: 브로켄 총리는 비밀결사 수뇌부가 이미 궤멸되었으며 잔당들도 체포되거나 잠적했다고 밝혔습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Encounters_HERO GENERATION ENCOUNTERS_(Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
en: In other news...

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Для борьбы с остатками заговорщиков Канцлером принят Указ о чрезвычайном положении. Введены ограничения на въезд и выезд из Брокена.
en: To find the remaining conspirators, the Chancellor issued an Emergency Decree. Restrictions on entry and exit from Brocken were imposed.
ko: 남은 결사 대원들을 척결하기 위해 총리가 비상령을 선포했습니다. 브로켄 출입이 전면 통제되었습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: В действительности же господа Траумы, потомки старинного рода, являются уважаемыми в Брокене людьми и продолжают помогать городу в решении важных проблем.
en: In reality, the Traums, descendants of an old and distinguished family, are respected people in Brocken and continue to help the city solve its most pressing problems.
ko: 실제로는 유서 깊은 명문인 트라움 가문 인사들이 브로켄에서 존경받고 있으며, 도시의 현안 해결에 힘을 보태고 있습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: При этом мятежники верят в существование некоего тайного режима, якобы возглавляемого Семьей Траум...
en: The rebels believe in the existence of a secret regime led by the Traum Family...
ko: 반역자들은 트라움 가문이 이끄는 비밀 체제가 존재한다고 굳게 믿고 있으며...

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Из слов властей следует, что Заговор потерпел поражение, но все еще не разгромлен до конца.
en: According to the authorities, the Conspiracy has been defeated, but has not yet been crushed completely.
ko: 당국은 비밀결사가 패배했지만 완전히 소탕되지는 않았다고 발표했습니다.

context: Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_39 - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Radio (Scene - (Hero Generation) Radio Conspiracy Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Город все еще не может полностью восстановиться от печально известного Брокенского Краха, что, очевидно, и привело к резкому взрыву недовольства.
en: The city still hasn't fully recovered from the infamous Collapse, which apparently led to the sudden explosion of discontent.
ko: 이 도시는 악명 높은 '브로켄 붕괴'의 여파에서 완전히 벗어나지 못해 불만이 폭발한 것으로 보입니다.

en: And something happened there, at that meeting. Something that every citizen who attended swore never to speak of, or even remember.
ko: 그리고 그 만남에서 어떤 일이 벌어졌다. 참석했던 모든 시민들이 절대로 입에 올리지도, 떠올리지도 않겠다고 맹세한 어떤 일이.

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Фабрика разваливается, заведения закрываются. Скоро уже и чашку кофе выпить будет негде! И не на что!
en: The Factory is falling apart, the shops are closing. Soon there’ll be no place left to enjoy a cup of coffee! And with what money?
ko: 공장은 무너지고 가게들은 문을 닫고 있어. 곧 커피 한 잔 마실 곳도 안 남을 판이야! 돈도 없고 말이지!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)

en: Gather around! Let's go!

ru: Поэтому, уважаемые, Город обязан взять дело в свои руки. Мы справимся, если будем действовать разумно и сообща. Любой кризис преодолим.
en: This means the City must take matters into its own hands. We can handle this if we act together.
ko: 그러니 여러분, 도시가 직접 나서야 합니다. 지혜를 모으고 힘을 합치면 우리는 해낼 수 있습니다. 어떤 위기든 극복할 수 있어요.

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Так дальше нельзя! Этот Крах нам никакой жизни не оставил. Это не жизнь — а сплошное выживание!
en: We can't go on like this! This Collapse has ruined us. This isn’t life, it’s nothing but survival!
ko: 이대론 더 못 살겠소! 이 붕괴 때문에 남은 게 하나도 없단 말이오. 이건 사는 게 아니라 겨우 목숨만 부지하는 거지!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Пусть берут взамен что угодно! Лишь бы жизнь нам обратно наладили!
en: Let them take whatever they want in return! As long as they get our lives back on track!
ko: 그 대가로 무엇을 바라든 다 주시오! 우리 삶을 제자리로 돌려놓을 수만 있다면 말이오!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
en: The Traum Family!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: А Столица только смеется над нашими проблемами! Да и на местную власть надежды никакой. У нас не Канцлер, а посмешище.
en: And the Capital just laughs at our problems! There's no hope for our local authorities. We don’t have a proper Chancellor, just some clown!
ko: 수도는 우리 고통을 비웃기나 하지! 시 당국도 글러먹었소. 우리 총리는 총리가 아니라 광대패요!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Мы должны всем Городом идти и просить их о помощи.
en: We, the City, must go as one and ask them for their help.
ko: 우리는 온 도시가 한마음으로 그들에게 찾아가 도움을 청해야 합니다.

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Такие, как вы, только хуже сделают. Да и как мы сами по себе из такого бедствия выберемся? Нам нужна помощь!
en: People like you will only make things worse. And how will we ever get out of this mess on our own? We need help!
ko: 당신 같은 먹물들은 일을 더 꼬이게 할 뿐이오. 이런 참담한 지경에서 우리 힘만으로 어떻게 벗어나겠소? 당장 도움이 필요하단 말이오!

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_16 - (Hero Generation) City Pact with Traums (Encounter)_Scenes_People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: И Город ушел на поклон к Семье Траум.
en: And the City went to bow to the Traum Family.
ko: 그리하여 도시는 트라움 가문 앞에 머리를 조아리러 갔다.

ru: Верно. Вот кто всегда заботился о Городе. Пусть позаботятся и сейчас!
en: Right you are. They've always cared about the City. Let them do so now!
ko: 옳소. 언제나 도시를 보살펴준 건 그분들이었지. 지금도 그분들이 구해주실 거요!

ko: 확실히 알려진 것은 단 하나뿐이었다. 바로 이 사건이 일어난 직후 트라움 가문이 사라졌다는 점이다.

ru: Город надолго остался без своих старинных покровителей...
en: For a long time the City was left without its ancient patrons...
ko: 도시는 오랫동안 고대의 수호자들을 잃은 채 남겨졌다...

ru: Да, сейчас вместо статуи основателя стоит огромная рука с вытянутым пальцем.
en: Yes, now instead of the founder's statue there is a huge hand with an outstretched finger.
ko: 그렇소, 지금은 창립자 동상 대신 손가락을 뻗은 거대한 손이 자리 잡고 있지요.

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_Name
en: Statue in the square

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)

ru: А, да, что-то такое припоминаю. Вроде бы по приказу достопочтенных господ Траум, статуя была заменена.
en: Ah, yes, I seem to recall something like that. Apparently, by order of the venerable Traum lords, the statue was replaced.
ko: 아, 네, 어렴풋이 기억나는군요. 존경하올 트라움 나으리들의 명에 따라 동상이 교체되었다던데요.

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: <male>Сударь</male><female>Сударыня</female>, я не знаю куда дели эту статую и знать не хочу. Если ее убрали, значит на то были веские причины.
en: <male>Sir</male><female>Madam</female>, I don't know where they put that statue and I don't want to know. If they removed it, there were good reasons for it.
ko: <male>손님</male><female>손님</female>, 전 그 동상이 어디로 치워졌는지 모르고, 알고 싶지도 않습니다. 철거되었다면 그만한 합당한 이유가 있었겠지요.

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Прошу, позвольте мне вернуться к моему завтраку.
en: Please let me get back to my breakfast.

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Что? Какая статуя? Разве что-то менялось на площади?
en: What? What statue? Has anything changed in the square?
ko: 네? 무슨 동상이요? 광장에 무슨 변화라도 있었습니까?

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

en: Do you by any chance know where the statue of the founder from the town square went?
ko: 혹시 광장에 있던 창시자 동상이 어디로 갔는지 아십니까?

context: What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_What With The Statue (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: And where is she now?
ko: 그런데 그 동상이 지금은 어디에 있습니까?

en: Back

en: I recently returned to the City myself. I see everything as if for the first time.
ko: 저도 최근에야 도시로 돌아왔습니다. 모든 게 낯설고 처음 보는 것 같군요.

context: Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_Name
en: How long have you been in Brocken?

context: Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Я здесь родился и вырос. Умирать собираюсь тоже здесь.
en: I was born and raised here. I plan to die here too.
ko: 여기서 나고 자랐지요. 죽는 것도 여기서 죽을 요량입니다.

context: Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: Why do you ask?

context: Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)

en: Now leave me, please, I would like to enjoy my breakfast.
ko: 이제 좀 내버려 두십시오. 조용히 아침 식사나 즐기고 싶군요.

context: Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Regular Interaction Encounter_Actions_Ask About The City Actions_Do You Live In Brocken (Action - Cafe Visit Regular Interaction)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: Have you lived here for a long time?

context: Exposition from Soul (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)
detail: Encounters_HERO GENERATION ENCOUNTERS_Hero Generation Finale (Encounter)_Scenes_Exposition from Soul (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Как ты тут? Вдали от меня. Вдали от дома.
en: How are you holding up? Far from me? Far from your home?
ko: 어떻게 지내고 있니? 내게서 멀리 떨어져서. 집에서 멀리 떠나와서.

context: Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Scenes_Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Но я волнуюсь за твою жизнь.
en: But I am worried about your life.

context: Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Scenes_Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Я знаю, как сильно ты тоскуешь по Дому. Я плачу вместе с тобой, дитя.
en: I know how much you miss Home. I cry with you, child.
ko: 네가 집을 얼마나 그리워하는지 안단다. 얘야, 나도 너와 함께 울고 있단다.

context: Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Scenes_Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Почему же ты все равно стремишься домой?
en: Why do you still long to go home?
ko: 어째서 여전히 집으로 돌아오려 애쓰는 거니?

context: Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Scenes_Why You Are Coming (Scene - Hero Generation Finale)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Но скажи мне. Здесь ты вдали от угроз и ужасов, которые ждут тебя дома.
en: Tell me. Here, you are safe from the threats and horrors that await you at home.
ko: 말해보렴. 여기 있으면 집에서 널 기다리는 온갖 위협과 공포로부터 안전하잖니.

context: No Clear Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_Name
en: I still have doubts...

context: No Clear Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_No Clear Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Я понимаю твои сомнения. Решать тебе. Я жду тебя все равно.
en: I understand your doubts. It's up to you to decide. I'm waiting for you anyway.
ko: 네 망설임을 이해한단다. 결정은 네 몫이지. 그래도 난 널 기다릴 거야.

context: No Clear Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_No Clear Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Я все еще сомневаюсь в своем решении вернуться. Но нужно попытаться.
en: I still have doubts about my decision to return. But I have to try.
ko: 돌아가겠다는 결정에 여전히 망설임이 든다. 하지만 부딪쳐봐야만 한다.

context: I Have Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_Name
en: I have a goal

context: I Have Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_I Have Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Я верю тебе. И жду тебя.
en: I believe you. And I'm waiting for you.

context: I Have Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_I Have Goal (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: У меня есть цель, и я не отступлюсь от нее, несмотря ни на какие опасности.
en: I have a goal, and I will not retreat from it, no matter what the danger.
ko: 내게는 목표가 있어. 어떤 위험이 닥치더라도 결코 물러서지 않을 거야.

context: No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_Name
ru: Жизнь без Дома — это не жизнь
en: Life without Home is not life

context: No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: I'm waiting for you. I always have.

context: No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Для меня жизнь без дома — это не жизнь. Нужно попытаться.
en: For me, life without a home is not life. I have to try.
ko: 내게 집 없는 삶은 사는 게 아니다. 시도해봐야만 해.

context: It Would Be Defeat (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_Name
en: To give up your home is a defeat!

context: It Would Be Defeat (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_No Life (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
en: I'm waiting for you. I always have.

context: It Would Be Defeat (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Why Are You Coming - Actions_It Would Be Defeat (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Отказаться от Дома для меня будет поражением. Я не дам никому права лишить меня Дома.
en: Giving up my Home would be a defeat for me. I will not give anyone the right to keep me away from it.
ko: 집을 포기하는 건 내게 패배나 다름없다. 누구에게도 내 집을 빼앗을 권리는 주지 않겠다.

context: Dont Remember (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_41 - (Hero Generation) Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Answer to Souls - Actions_Dont Remember (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: My poor thing. How badly these years must have worn you down...
ko: 가엾은 내 아이야. 지난 세월 동안 얼마나 모진 고통을 겪은 거니...

context: Dont Remember (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)
detail: Encounters_HERO GENERATION ENCOUNTERS_Hero Generation Finale (Encounter)_Actions_Answer to Souls - Actions_Name
en: I don't remember anymore

en: I don't know you. Who are you?

context: Hardly Remember (Action - Hero Generation Finale Encounter)

ru: Что? Боль? Страдания? Нет, <username>, я уже давно не чувствую боли.
en: What? Pain? Suffering? No, <username>, I haven't felt pain for a long time.
ko: 뭐라고? 고통? 괴로움? 아니, <username>, 난 이미 오래전에 고통 따윈 잊었어.

context: Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Во мне уже нечему болеть. Но тебе такого пока еще не понять. Ничего, все впереди!
en: There's nothing left for me to hurt. But you don't understand that yet. Never mind, you'll get it soon enough!
ko: 내 몸엔 아파할 구석조차 안 남았다고. 하지만 넌 아직 이해 못 하겠지. 뭐, 곧 알게 될 테지만!

context: Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

ru: Я знаю. Тебя сломили боль и лишения на твоем пути.
en: I know. You have been broken by the pain and hardships along your path.
ko: 안다. 넌 살아오며 겪은 고통과 상실 때문에 무너진 거야.

context: Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Name
en: You are broken by troubles and trials!

context: Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Ordeal (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Мне тоже многое довелось пережить. Я понимаю тебя. Такое любого может лишить почвы под ногами.
en: I've been through a lot too. I understand. That kind of thing can knock anyone off their feet.
ko: 나 역시 많은 일을 겪었어. 이해해. 그런 일들은 누구라도 무너뜨릴 수 있지.

context: Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ты ни во что не веришь, ни на что не надеешься, ни в чем не видишь смысла.
en: You don't believe in anything, you don't hope for anything, you don't see any meaning in anything.
ko: 넌 아무것도 믿지 않고, 아무것도 바라지 않으며, 그 어떤 것에서도 의미를 찾지 못하고 있어.

context: Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Description
ru: Он утратил все внутренние опоры. А отрицание всего таковой считаться не может.
en: He has lost all internal support. And denial of everything cannot be considered as such.
ko: 그는 내면의 모든 버팀목을 잃었다. 모든 것을 부정하는 태도는 버팀목이 될 수 없다.

context: Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Fear Final Argument Actions_Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: It's... it's true.

context: Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

ru: Поэтому нельзя воспринимать всерьез ни тебя, ни твои попытки доказать свою правоту. Ты — лишь бедный сломленный человек.
en: Therefore, neither you nor your attempts to prove your case can be taken seriously. You are nothing but a poor, broken man.
ko: 그러니 너도, 네가 옳다고 증명하려는 짓거리도 진지하게 받아들여질 수 없어. 넌 그저 불쌍하게 망가진 인간일 뿐이다.

context: Broken by Loss of Principles (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Name
en: You have nothing to lean on!

ru: У тебя не осталось ни одной опоры.
en: You have no support left.
ko: 네겐 이제 기댈 곳이 하나도 없어.

context: Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Description
ru: Он попытался что-то изменить, но потерпел неудачу и не верит, что изменения возможны.
en: He tried to change something, but failed and does not believe that change is possible.
ko: 그는 무언가를 바꾸려 했으나 실패했고, 변화란 불가능하다고 믿고 있다.

context: Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ха-ха, сколько пыла! Мне ничего не стоит признать, что я бессилен.
en: Ha-ha, what ardor! It costs me nothing to admit that I am powerless.
ko: 하하, 아주 열심이군! 내가 무력하다는 걸 인정하는 것쯤이야 아무렇지도 않아.

context: Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Ты просто слишком слаб и знаешь это!
en: You're just too weak and you know it!
ko: 넌 그저 나약할 뿐이고 스스로도 그걸 알고 있어!

context: Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Ты потерпел поражение в борьбе и теперь строишь вокруг этого умные теории! Ты просто бессилен, признай это!
en: You lost the fight and now you're building clever theories around it! You're simply powerless, admit it!
ko: 싸움에서 졌으면서 그 둘레에 그럴싸한 궤변을 늘어놓고 있잖아! 넌 그저 무력할 뿐이야, 인정해!

context: Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_He Is Broken - Actions_Broken by Weakness (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Как и ты! Именно это я и собираюсь наглядно доказать!
en: Just like you! That's exactly what I'm about to prove!
ko: 너도 마찬가지야! 바로 그걸 똑똑히 증명해 주마!

ko: 가져가라, 그 빌어먹을 증거... 내게 그게 무슨 소용이라고...

context: Outrage (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

en: You were making fun of me here, and I have to console you?
ko: 날 실컷 조롱해 놓고 이제 와서 위로까지 바라는 거냐?

context: Outrage (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

en: In your eyes, he deserved nothing less.
ko: 당신 눈에 그는 그 이상의 대우를 받을 자격이 없었다.

context: Outrage (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_Pacified Guest Choice - Actions_Outrage (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: Pathetic wretch! Be thankful you got off easy. Give me what you promised. Tell me how to meet The Dead Man!
ko: 한심한 인간! 곱게 끝난 걸 다행으로 알아라. 약속한 걸 내놔. 망자와 어떻게 접촉하는지 불어!

context: Outrage (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Negotiation Actions_Pacified Guest Choice - Actions_Name

ko: 네 목숨을 생각해. 네 삶은 여전히 소중해!

en: Get ready to go. If you get involved with the Conspiracy, I don't think you'll ever come back here.
ko: 짐 챙겨서 떠날 채비나 해. 비밀결사와 엮이면 두 번 다시 여긴 못 돌아올 테니까.

en: You cling too tightly to your precious principles. To your attempt to return home. To the faint hope of the Conspiracy.
ko: 넌 그 빌어먹을 신념에 너무 매달려 있어. 집으로 돌아가겠다는 집착에도, 비밀결사의 실낱같은 희망에도.

en: I'm not afraid of ANYTHING. You wouldn't understand.
ko: 난 그 어떤 것도 두렵지 않아. 넌 절대 이해 못 해.

context: Final Argument - He Is Afraid - Choice (Scene - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

en: I haven't suffered from this for a long time.
ko: 난 그런 감상 따위 오래전에 집어치웠어.

ru: Она лишит тебя единственной ценности, которая у тебя осталась. Твоей сломленности.
en: She will deprive you of the only value you have left: your brokenness.
ko: 희망은 네게 남은 유일한 가치, 즉 네 '망가진 처지'마저 앗아가 버릴 테니까.

context: Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

en: I know what you're afraid of. You're afraid of hope.
ko: 네가 뭘 두려워하는지 알아. 넌 희망을 두려워하고 있어.

context: Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

ru: Ты так носишься с ней и готов на любые мучения, лишь бы доказать свою правоту.
en: You fuss over it so much and are ready to suffer any amount just to prove you are right.
ko: 넌 망가진 처지를 부여잡고, 자신이 옳다는 걸 증명하려고 어떤 고통이든 자처하고 있잖아.

context: Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Mysterious Guest (Mission)_Encounters_(Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest Encounter_Actions_Fear Final Argument Actions_Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
en: It's... it's true.

en: After all, you're always thinking—what if I'm wrong? What if it makes sense to move on?
ko: 끊임없이 생각하고 있잖아 — 만에 하나 내가 틀린 거라면? 앞으로 나아가는 게 의미가 있다면 어쩌지, 하고.

context: Afraid of Hope (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

ko: 난 이미 패배했어! 솔직히 털어놓고 있는데 귀를 막고 있는 건 너잖아!

context: Afraid of Struggle (Action - (Mysterious Guest Visit Mission) Confrontation with Guest)

ko: 내가? 질까 봐 겁먹었다고? 넌 날 전혀 모르는군, <username>.

en: You're afraid of losing, and that's why you don't even dare!

en: Me? Afraid of suffering? <male>Boy</male><female>Girl</female>, I've been through things you couldn't even dream of in your lousy Scary Thought!
ko: 내가? 고통이 두렵다고? <male>꼬마야</male><female>꼬마야</female>, 난 네 그 빌어먹을 무시무시한 생각 따위론 짐작도 못 할 생지옥을 겪어왔어!

ko: 넌 삶이 또 다른 고통을 안겨줄까 봐 두려운 거다.

en: And that's why you're ready to do anything just to avoid them!
ko: 그래서 고통을 피하기 위해서라면 무슨 짓이든 저지를 셈이지!

So, here it is. "Night. A knock on the door. An anxious female voice, 
"Who's there?"
"Captain Fiffert, madam!"

en: It's a nasty place, no matter how you look at it... Who knows what goes on up there. I don't even go there unless I have to. There's no one to guard it from.
ko: 어떻게 봐도 고약한 곳이지... 위층에선 때때로 귀신이 곡할 노릇이 벌어지거든. 난 볼일 없으면 발도 안 들여놓소. 딱히 지킬 대상도 없고.

context: Guest Fate - Dont Care (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ko: 그자는 내게 아무것도 아니었고, 앞으로도 그럴 것이오. 이제 본론으로 들어가는 게 어떻겠소?

ko: <userlastname>, 자네가 내 말을 들을 <male>준비가 되었는지</male><female>준비가 되었는지</female>부터 따져봐야겠군.

context: Guest Fate - Dont Care (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

en: I'm not him. But even though he left the Conspiracy, our views are in many ways similar. Or rather... they used to.
ko: 난 그자가 아니네. 그자가 비밀결사를 떠났다 해도, 우리 생각이 통하는 부분은 여전히 많지. 아니... 예전에는 그랬었네.

ko: 그자가 우리와 함께 싸움을 이어가진 못하겠지만, <username>, 자네는 그의 영혼을 지키는 싸움에서 승리했네.

context: Guest Fate - He Will Live (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ko: 그가 살아갈 힘을 되찾을 거라 믿습니다. 안경 너머로도 희망이 엿보였으니까요.

context: Guest Fate - He Will Live (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Guest Fate Response Actions_Guest Fate - He Will Live (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: Yes, <username>, you managed to restore his faith that not everything has lost its meaning...
ko: 그래, <username>, 모든 게 의미를 잃어버린 건 아니라는 믿음을 자네가 되찾아 주었지...

context: Guest Fate - He Will Live (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

context: Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

context: Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Guest Fate Response Actions_Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: It was his decision, and he was responsible for it. Either way, he had become a renegade and posed a threat to the Conspiracy, didn't he?
ko: 그자의 선택이었으니 책임도 그자가 져야겠지요. 어쨌든 그는 변절자가 되어 비밀결사에 위협이 되지 않았습니까?

context: Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

en: It's odd that you couldn't tell the difference. I thought you were pretty familiar with despair—and what it can do to a person.
ko: 그 둘을 구분하지 못하다니 이상하군. 난 자네가 절망이라는 것에 대해, 그리고 절망이 사람을 어떻게 망가뜨리는지에 대해 꽤 잘 <male>알고</male><female>알고</female> 있을 줄 알았는데 말일세.

context: Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Guest Fate Response Actions_Guest Fate - He Deserved It (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1

en: I would have preferred a different nickname. But fate decreed it this way.
ko: 나야 다른 별명이었으면 더 좋았겠지. 하지만 운명이 그렇게 정해버렸네.

en: I'm not asking you to understand this. Just accept it. You're dealing with a true Dead Man.
ko: 이해해 달라고 하진 않겠네. 그저 받아들이게. 자네는 진짜 망자를 대하고 있는 것이니.

ru: Конечно, я бы предпочел не умирать. Но даже если я умер, это не повод оставлять дело моей жизни.
en: Of course, I would prefer not to die. But even though I did die, that's no reason to abandon my life's work.
ko: 물론 나도 죽지 않았으면 더 좋았겠지. 하지만 죽었다고 해서 평생의 과업을 내팽개칠 이유는 되지 않잖나.

context: Question - Who Are You Deadman (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ru: Большая ошибка с их стороны! Теперь я способен на гораздо большее.
en: Big mistake on their part! Now I'm capable of much more.
ko: 놈들 입장에선 중대한 실책을 범한 셈이지! 이제 난 훨씬 더 많은 일을 할 수 있게 되었으니.

ru: Я не смогу и не буду тебе ничего доказывать, <username>.
en: I can't and won't prove anything to you, <username>.
ko: 자네에게 아무것도 증명할 수 없고, 증명할 생각도 없네, <username>.

context: Question - Why Should I Trust You (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ru: Почему мне стоит доверить свою жизнь и свободу вам?
en: Why should I trust my life and freedom to you?
ko: 내 목숨과 자유를 왜 당신들에게 맡겨야 합니까?

context: Question - Why Should I Trust You (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Why Should I Trust You (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Прими это — или уходи и забудь об этой встрече.
en: Accept it—or leave and forget about this meeting.
ko: 받아들이든가, 아니면 떠나서 오늘 만남을 잊어버리게.

context: Question - Why Should I Trust You (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Why Should I Trust You (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Ничего иного предложить не могу. Если тебе действительно нужна эта борьба, то мы — единственное, что у тебя есть.
en: I can't offer anything else. If you really want this struggle, then we're the only thing you have.
ko: 달리 제안할 것은 없네. 진정으로 이 투쟁을 원한다면, 자네에게 남은 건 우리뿐일세.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Name
en: Who is in the Conspiracy?

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: От Заговора, который я основал, осталась лишь горстка самых стойких... или везучих.
en: Of the Conspiracy I founded, only a handful remain. The most resilient ones... or the luckiest ones.
ko: 내가 창설했던 비밀결사에서 이제 남은 건 가장 끈질기거나... 가장 운 좋은 극소수뿐일세.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Кто еще сейчас входит в Заговор?
en: Who else is in the Conspiracy now?
ko: 지금은 또 누가 비밀결사에 속해 있습니까?

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Увы. В этом больше правды, чем хотелось бы.
en: Alas, there is more truth in this than we would like.
ko: 유감스럽게도, 우리가 바라는 것보다 훨씬 더 사실에 부합하는 이야기일세.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Как только прибудете обратно в Брокен, мы введем вас во все наши дела.
en: Once you arrive back in Brocken, we will introduce you to all our affairs.
ko: 자네가 브로켄에 무사히 돌아오면, 우리 동지들이 하는 모든 일을 소개해 주겠네.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Если, конечно, вы не раздумаете присоединяться...
en: Unless, of course, you change your mind about joining...
ko: 물론 자네가 합류하겠다는 결심을 바꾸지 않는다면 말일세...

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Разные нравы. Разное прошлое. Разные взгляды. Но все же мы держимся вместе.
en: Different morals. Different pasts. Different views. But still, we stick together.
ko: 신념도 다르고, 과거도 다르고, 관점도 제각각이지. 하지만 우리는 굳건히 함께하고 있네.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Я <male>слышал</male><female>слышала</female> по радио, что Заговор полностью разгромили. Это очередная ложь прихвостней Траумов?
en: I <male>heard</male><female>heard</female> on the radio that the Conspiracy has been completely defeated. Is this another lie from the Traums' henchmen?
ko: 라디오에서 비밀결사가 완전히 궤멸되었다고 <male>들었습니다</male><female>들었습니다</female>. 트라움 가문 앞잡이들의 또 다른 거짓말입니까?

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Скоро вы встретитесь с остальными заговорщиками. Пока вам назвать их имена, как вы понимаете, я не могу.
en: You'll meet the rest of the conspirators soon. Surely you understand that I can't tell you their names yet.
ko: 곧 다른 음모가들도 만나게 될 걸세. 아직은 그들의 이름을 알려줄 수 없다는 점은 이해하겠지.

context: Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Other Conspirators (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Нас мало. На нас идет бесконечная охота. Но шаг за шагом мы готовим переворот, который положит конец режиму Семьи.
en: We are few in number. We are being hunted endlessly. But step by step, we are preparing a coup that will put an end to the Family's regime.
ko: 우리 수는 적고, 끝없는 추적이 이어지고 있네. 하지만 한 걸음 한 걸음, 가문의 독재를 종식시킬 정변을 준비하고 있지.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Name
en: Who makes the decisions?

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: В любом случае, не путайте меня с Командором Траумом. Я не жажду власти.
en: In any case, don't confuse me with Commander Traum. I don't crave power.
ko: 어쨌든 날 트라움 사령관 같은 자와 혼동하진 말게. 난 권력을 탐하지 않네.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Скажите, Мертвец, кто и как принимает решения в вашем Заговоре?
en: Tell me, Dead Man, who makes decisions in your Conspiracy and how?
ko: 말씀해 주십시오, 망자. 당신들의 비밀결사에선 누가, 어떻게 결정을 내립니까?

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Всё не так просто. Да, я руковожу Заговором. Но, как вы догадались, я мертв. Это накладывает свои ограничения.
en: It's not that simple. Yes, I lead the Conspiracy. But, as you might have guessed by now, I'm dead. That imposes some difficulties.
ko: 그리 단순한 문제가 아닐세. 그래, 내가 비밀결사를 이끌고 있긴 하지. 하지만 짐작했겠지만 난 이미 죽은 몸이라네. 그로 인해 제약이 따를 수밖에 없어.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Если вы присоединитесь к нам, то вам <male>самому</male><female>самой</female> предстоит решать, какой шаг и когда предпринять.
en: If you join us, it will be up to you to decide what step to take and when.
ko: 우리와 함께한다면, 언제 어떤 결단을 내릴지는 자네 <male>스스로</male><female>스스로</female> 정해야 할 걸세.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Не все заговорщики будут с вами согласны. Кто-то будет яростно спорить. Кто-то затаит обиду. Но это цена за то, чтобы не быть теми, против кого мы боремся.
en: Not all conspirators will agree with you. Some will argue fiercely. Some will harbor a grudge. But that's the price of not being the ones we're fighting against.
ko: 모든 동지가 자네에게 동의하지는 않을 걸세. 격렬히 논쟁하는 자도, 앙심을 품는 자도 있겠지. 하지만 그게 바로 우리가 맞서 싸우는 자들과 다른 존재로 남기 위한 대가라네.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Я так понимаю, главный — вы? Вы командуете прочими заговорщиками?
en: I take it you're the one in charge? You command the other conspirators?
ko: 그럼 당신이 우두머리입니까? 다른 음모가들에게 지휘권을 행사하나요?

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Командовать никем я не намерен. Все заговорщики вольны в своих действиях и отвечают за них сами. Но добиться чего-либо мы можем только сообща.
en: I have no intention of commanding anyone. All conspirators are free in their actions and responsible for them. But we can only achieve our goal together.
ko: 누구에게도 명령을 내릴 생각은 없네. 모든 음모가는 행동에 있어 자유로우며 스스로 책임을 지지. 다만 우리는 함께해야만 목표를 이룰 수 있네.

context: Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Questions Actions_Question - Structure of Power (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Я координирую Заговор, поскольку меня им уже точно не поймать. Следовательно, я могу быть связующим звеном для всей нашей организации.
en: I coordinate the Conspiracy because they're not able to catch me anymore. Therefore, I can serve as the liaison for our entire organization.
ko: 내가 비밀결사를 조율하는 건, 놈들이 더 이상 날 붙잡을 수 없기 때문일세. 따라서 내가 우리 조직 전체의 연락책 역할을 맡을 수 있는 거지.

context: Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Неужели ты не боишься этого разговора?
en: Aren't you afraid of this conversation?

context: Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Что ж, довольно о нем. Что случилось, то случилось. А нам предстоит многое узнать друг о друге.
en: Well, enough about him. What happened, happened. And we still have a lot to learn about each other.
ko: 자, 그자 이야기는 이쯤 하지. 이미 일어난 일은 일어난 일이고, 우린 서로에 대해 알아야 할 게 아직 많으니까.

en: Here's what I'd like to know. You do realize, <username>, that you're talking to a convicted felon? A leader of a criminal clique?
ko: 이것 하나는 알아두고 싶군. <username>, 자네가 지금 기소된 중범죄자이자 범죄 집단의 수괴와 대화하고 있다는 사실은 알고 있겠지?

context: Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Testing Player Resolve (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Меня ведь даже казнили за мои преступления против города Брокен.
en: I was even executed for my crimes against the city of Brocken.
ko: 난 브로켄 시에 대한 반역죄로 처형까지 당한 몸일세.

context: Test Resolve (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Testing Player Resolve Actions_Test Resolve (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_TactsFailSkillCheck_Text_1_1
