en: Some of us have connections in the city government. We'll arrange for a vacant position to be waiting for you.
ko: 우리 동지 중 몇몇이 시정부에 연줄이 있네. 자네 몫으로 공직자 빈자리를 하나 마련해 두도록 하지.

context: Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Cover Choice Actions_Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Смогу притвориться чиновником. Работать в городской Канцелярии.
en: I can pretend to be a clerk. I could work at the City Chancellery.
ko: 관리 행세를 할 수 있습니다. 시 관청에서 일하면 되겠습니다.

context: Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Cover Choice Actions_Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Надеюсь, ты не увязнешь с головой в бюрократическом болоте и будешь иногда вспоминать о Заговоре!
en: I hope you don't get bogged down in bureaucratic swamp and will occasionally remember that you're a conspirator as well!
ko: 부디 관료주의의 늪에 머리끝까지 빠져서 가끔씩이나마 자신이 음모가라는 사실을 잊지 않기를 바라네!

context: Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Cover Choice Actions_Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Такое мне будет не в новинку. Сойду среди бюрократов за своего.
en: This won't be new to me. I'll fit right in among the bureaucrats.
ko: 제겐 낯선 일이 아닙니다. 관료들 틈에 자연스럽게 녹아들 수 있습니다.

context: Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Cover Choice Actions_Description
ru: Вы будете притворяться рядовым чиновником городской Канцелярии.
en: You will pretend to be an ordinary official of the City Chancellery.

context: Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Cover Choice Actions_Cover Clerk (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ха-ха, прямо под носом у самых прилежных слуг Семьи! Неплохо, неплохо, <username>.
en: Ha-ha, right under the noses of the Family's most diligent servants! Not bad, not bad at all, <username>.
ko: 하하, 가문의 가장 충직한 종복들 코앞이라니! 나쁘지 않군, 아주 좋아, <username>.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Там доберешься до наших. Они помогут тебе укрыться от Траумов и избавиться от Мысли, которую они в тебя подсадили.
en: Once there, you'll reach our people. They'll help you hide from the Traums and get rid of this Thought they planted in you.
ko: 그곳에 가면 우리 동지들과 접선하게 될 걸세. 그들이 자네를 트라움 가문으로부터 숨겨주고, 놈들이 심어놓은 그 '생각'도 제거해 줄 걸세.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Я приготовил для тебя несколько планов отхода. Воспользуйся одним из них, если дела идут плохо.
en: I've prepared several escape plans for you. Use one of them if things go badly.
ko: 자네를 위해 몇 가지 퇴각로를 마련해 두었네. 상황이 틀어지면 그중 하나를 이용하게.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: С этим разобрались. Скорее, идем дальше.
en: We've sorted that out. Let's move on, quick.
ko: 이 문제는 정리되었군. 서두르게, 다음으로 넘어가세.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman Encounter_Scenes_Description
en: Questions?

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Сегодня в полночь отходит последний поезд. И ты <female>должна</female><male>должен</male> быть на нем!
en: The last train leaves today at midnight. And you must be on it!
ko: 오늘 자정에 마지막 기차가 떠나네. 자네는 반드시 그 기차에 <female>타야 하네</female><male>타야 하네</male>!

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Сейчас наша цель проста. Тебе нужно любой ценой сесть на поезд в Брокен.
en: Our goal now is simple: you must get on the train to Brocken at any cost.
ko: 이제 우리의 목표는 단순하네. 무슨 수를 써서라도 브로켄행 기차에 올라타야 하네.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Но сперва — попасть на поезд. Это будет непросто. По твоему следу уже идут люди... точнее, нелюди Траумов.
en: But first, you need to get on the train. It won't be easy. There are already Traum's men on your trail... well, 'men' is not the right word.
ko: 하지만 먼저 기차에 타는 게 급선무일세. 결코 쉽지 않을 거야. 벌써 자네 뒤를 트라움의 수하들... 아니, '비인간'들이 쫓고 있으니 말일세.

context: Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Final Briefing (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Со дня на день Брокен окончательно закроют. Семья не хочет, чтобы ей кто-то мешал делать с нашим Городом все, что ей заблагорассудится. Туда будет уже не попасть.
en: Brocken will be sealed off any day now. The Family doesn’t want anyone interfering with them as they do whatever they please with our City. It will no longer be possible to get in there.
ko: 며칠 내로 브로켄은 완전히 봉쇄될 걸세. 가문은 우리 도시에 무슨 짓을 벌이든 누구의 방해도 받고 싶어 하지 않으니. 그 뒤엔 들어가고 싶어도 들어갈 수 없게 되지.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Уже какое-то время мы наблюдали за тобой, <userlastname>. И кое-что успели узнать.
en: We've been keeping an eye on you for a while now, <userlastname>. And we've learned a few things.
ko: 한동안 자네를 지켜보고 있었네, <userlastname>. 그리고 몇 가지를 알아냈지.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Ты — ветеран жуткой войны, которую кто-то имеет наглость называть Великой. Соболезную всем сердцем.
en: You are a veteran of a terrible war, which some have the nerve to call the Great War. My heartfelt condolences to you.
ko: 자네는 누군가 뻔뻔스럽게도 '대전쟁'이라 부르는 그 끔찍한 전쟁의 참전용사로군. 진심으로 위로를 전하네.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Даже здесь, на Той Стороне, у нас есть риск быть подслушанными.
en: Even here on the Other Side, we run the risk of being overheard.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Что ж, к делу. Времени у нас в обрез, <userlastname>. Наш разговор неизбежно привлечет внимание Семьи Траум.
en: Well, let's get down to business. We're pressed for time, <userlastname>. Our conversation is sure to attract the attention of the Traum Family.
ko: 자, 본론으로 들어가세. 시간이 촉박하네, <userlastname>. 우리 통화는 트라움 가문의 주의를 끌 수밖에 없으니.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_15_1
ru: <username>, ты даже не представляешь, во что они превращают наш Город!
en: <username>, you have no idea what they are turning our City into!
ko: <username>, 자네는 놈들이 우리 도시를 어떤 꼴로 만들어 놓았는지 상상도 못 할 걸세!

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_10_1
ru: Мы знаем, что тебя изгнали из родного города. Но ты, <username> <userlastname>, спустя все эти годы стремишься вернуться.
en: We know you were exiled from your hometown. But you, <username> <userlastname>, are still yearning to return after all these years.
ko: 자네가 고향에서 추방당했다는 건 알고 있네. 하지만 <username> <userlastname>, 자네는 이 모든 세월이 흐른 뒤에도 여전히 돌아오기를 갈망하고 있지.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Должно быть, тяжело всю жизнь оглядываться за плечо и не знать ни минуты покоя? Сочувствую от всего сердца.
en: It must be hard to spend your whole life looking over your shoulder and never having a moment's peace? I sympathize with you with all my heart.
ko: 평생을 뒤돌아보며 쫓기듯 사느라 단 한순간의 평온도 누리지 못했으니 얼마나 고달팠겠나? 온 마음으로 안타깝게 생각하네.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Должно быть, тяжело каждый день продолжать эту войну внутри себя? Не волнуйся, среди нас ты найдешь понимание.
en: It must be difficult to continue this war inside you every day. Don't worry, you'll find understanding among us.
ko: 매일같이 가슴속에서 이 전쟁을 이어가는 게 쉽지 않았을 텐데. 걱정 말게, 우리 곁에선 온전한 이해를 받을 수 있을 테니.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
ru: Ты ведь <male>видел</male><female>видела</female> только самое начало власти Траумов.
en: You saw only the very beginning of the Traums' coming to power.
ko: 자네는 트라움 가문이 권력을 잡기 시작한 아주 초기의 모습만을 <male>보았을</male><female>보았을</female> 뿐일세.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_11_1
ru: Ты ведь догадываешься, что сейчас творится в Брокене.
en: You know what's going on in Brocken now.
ko: 지금 브로켄에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 자네도 짐작은 하겠지.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_12_1
ru: Заговор был разгромлен. Всех несогласных тихо устраняют. Простые горожане безмолвствуют. Мыслящие люди покидают Брокен.
en: The Conspiracy was crushed. All who oppose the new regime are quietly disappearing. Ordinary citizens keep silent. Thinking people are leaving Brocken.
ko: 비밀결사는 와해되었네. 새 정권에 반대하는 자들은 소리소문없이 사라지고 있지. 평범한 시민들은 침묵하고, 생각할 줄 아는 사람들은 브로켄을 떠나고 있네.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: <male>Беглец. Преступник.</male><female>Беглянка. Преступница. </female> Тебе пришлось пройти через годы заключения в крепости Шлиссель.
en: Fugitive. Criminal. You have endured years of imprisonment in the Schlissel Fortress.
ko: <male>탈옥수. 범죄자.</male><female>탈옥수. 범죄자.</female> 슐리셀 요새에서 수년간의 투옥 생활을 견뎌내야 했지.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: Но ты решаешь вернуться обратно. Прямо в стан врага, который уже однажды едва не сломил тебя.
en: But you decide to go back. Straight to the stronghold of your enemies, who already nearly broke you.
ko: 하지만 자네는 다시 돌아가기로 결심했네. 한때 자네를 거의 무너뜨릴 뻔했던 원수들의 본거지로 곧장 말일세.

context: Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Motivation Question (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_16_1
en: Why are you coming back then?

en: It's my duty

ru: Я ненавижу Семью Траум и их власть всем сердцем.
en: I hate the Traum Family and their power with all my heart.
ko: 온 마음을 다해 트라움 가문과 그들의 권력을 증오합니다.

context: Cause - Revenge (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Motivation Question Actions_Cause - Revenge (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Ненависть.. Ненависть — опасная вещь, <username>. Она может поглотить вас целиком, а после того, как вы отомстите врагам, не оставить вам ничего больше.
en: Hatred... Hatred is a dangerous thing, <username>. It can consume you entirely, and after you've taken revenge on your enemies, it can leave you with nothing.
ko: 증오라... 증오는 위험한 감정일세, <username>. 자네를 송두리째 집어삼키고, 적들에게 복수한 뒤엔 자네에게 아무것도 남겨주지 않을 수도 있으니.

context: Cause - Revenge (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Motivation Question Actions_Description
ru: Ради мести вашим врагам вы готовы на всё.
en: You are ready to do anything to take revenge on your enemies.
ko: 적들에게 복수하기 위해서라면 무슨 짓이든 할 준비가 되어 있다.

context: Cause - Help Others (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Motivation Question Actions_Name
en: Help others

en: I will help others!

context: Cause - Help Others (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

en: I can't live without Home. And I will return there, no matter what the cost.
ko: 보금자리 없이는 살 수 없습니다. 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 반드시 돌아갈 겁니다.

ru: Я уважаю твой выбор. Но если у нас будут сплошные секреты друг ото друга, далеко нам не уйти.
en: I respect your choice. But if we keep nothing but secrets from each other, we won't get very far.
ko: 자네 뜻을 존중하네. 하지만 서로에게 온통 비밀투성이라면 멀리 갈 수 없다네.

context: Cause - Cant Tell (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Actions_Motivation Question Actions_Cause - Cant Tell (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Твое право, <userlastname>. Но у нас принято быть открытыми друг к другу.
en: You're right, <userlastname>. But we're supposed to be open to each other.
ko: 자네 권리일세, <userlastname>. 하지만 우리 사이에선 서로에게 마음을 터놓는 게 원칙이라네.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Каждый день ты будешь ходить среди добропорядочных горожан, зная, что любой из них донесет на тебя, не моргнув и глазом.
en: Every day you will walk among good and obedient citizens, knowing that any one of them will report you without batting an eye.
ko: 자네는 매일같이 점잖고 순종적인 시민들 사이를 걸어 다니겠지만, 그들 중 누구라도 눈 하나 깜빡이지 않고 자네를 밀고할 수 있다는 사실을 알아야 하네.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
ru: Подумай, <male>готов</male><female>готова</female> ли ты к такой жизни? Или же она не для тебя?
en: Think about it. Are you ready for this kind of life? Or is it not for you after all?
ko: 곰곰이 생각해 보게. 이런 삶을 감당할 <male>준비가 되었나</male><female>준비가 되었나</female>? 아니면 결국 자네에겐 맞지 않는 길인가?

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
ru: Но должен сразу предупредить. Наше дело — не для слабых духом.
en: But I must warn you right away. Our cause is not for the faint of heart.
ko: 하지만 미리 경고해 두겠네. 우리 일은 결코 마음 약한 자를 위한 게 아니야.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
en: Do you join the Conspiracy, <username> <userlastname>?

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_HOTEL ESCAPE_Recruiting Conspiracy Call Encounter_Scenes_Description
en: Join the Conspiracy?

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Уже только за то, что ты присоединишься к нам, тебя будут преследовать, давить и ненавидеть.
en: Just for joining us, you will be chased, oppressed and hated.
ko: 우리와 손을 잡았다는 이유만으로도 자네는 쫓기고, 탄압받고, 증오를 사게 될 걸세.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Ты станешь врагом всего родного Города.
en: You will become the enemy of your entire hometown.
ko: 자네는 고향 도시 전체의 적이 될 걸세.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Они ведь всего лишь хотят жить спокойно. Поэтому они будут только рады избавиться от тебя.
en: They just want to live in peace, so they'll be only too happy to get rid of you.
ko: 저들은 그저 편히 살고 싶을 뿐이니, 자네를 치워버릴 수만 있다면 기꺼이 나설 테지.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Потому, что ты для них ты <male><color=#CC80FFFF>странный</color></male><female><color=#CC80FFFF>странная</color></female>.
en: Because to them you are <male><color=#CC80FFFF>strange</color></male><female><color=#CC80FFFF>strange</color></female>.

context: Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Joining (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Ты уже никогда не сможешь дышать спокойно, не оглядываться через плечо. О покое можешь забыть.
en: You'll never be able to breathe calmly again, always looking over your shoulder. You can forget about peace and quiet.
ko: 자네는 두 번 다시 마음 편히 숨 쉴 수도, 등 뒤를 경계하지 않을 수도 없을 걸세. 평온과 안식 따윈 잊어야 하네.

context: Hesitate (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ru: Время колебаний ушло, <username>. Нельзя быть заговорщиком наполовину.
en: The time for hesitation is over, <username>. You cannot be a half-conspirator.
ko: 망설일 시간은 끝났네, <username>. 반쪽짜리 음모가란 존재할 수 없어.

context: Hesitate (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ru: Ну, не знаю... Надо подумать еще.
en: Well, I don’t know... I need to think some more.
ko: 글쎄요, 잘 모르겠습니다... 생각을 좀 더 해봐야겠어요.

context: Hesitate (Action - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

ru: Войдя в этот номер, ты уже не <male>оставил</male><female>оставила</female> себе выбора.
en: By entering this room, you’ve left yourself with no choice.
ko: 이 방에 들어선 이상, 자네는 스스로 선택의 여지를 없애버린 <male>셈일세</male><female>셈일세</female>.

context: Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Но ему не удалось заставить тебя пройти путем, который он тебе приготовил. А значит, все его взгляды потерпели крах.
en: But he failed to force you to follow the path he had planned for you. And so, all his views failed.
ko: 그자는 자신이 자네를 위해 마련해 둔 길을 걷게 만들지 못했네. 즉, 그자의 모든 사상이 패배했다는 뜻이지.

context: Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <color=#00FFFFFF>The guest was not killed!</color>

en: Who remained in the City?

context: Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Reaction to Guest Fate - Guest Disappeared (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Это дает надежду и мне. Я долго искал человека, который не идет по легкому пути. Человека, который не станет оправдывать свои поступки словами: "У меня не было выбора".
en: This gives me hope too. I've been searching for a long time for someone who doesn't take the easy way out. Someone who won't justify their actions by saying, "I had no choice."
ko: 그 덕에 내게도 희망이 생겼네. 난 오랫동안 쉬운 길을 택하지 않는 자를 찾아왔다네. "다른 선택지가 없었다"는 말로 자신의 행동을 정당화하지 않는 자를 말일세.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Я знаю, что ты <male>узнал</male><female>узнала</female> обо мне и этом номере от того, кто назвал себя Гостем. Ведь так?
en: I know you found out about me and this room from someone who called himself The Guest. Is that right?
ko: 자네가 나와 이 방에 대해 알게 된 게 스스로를 '손님'이라 칭한 자를 통해서라는 걸 알고 있네. <male>그렇지 않나</male><female>그렇지 않나</female>?

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
en: He left the Conspiracy. He betrayed us.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_1_1
en: <username> <userlastname>. Finally!

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_7_1
ru: Чтобы принять тебя в Заговор, мне придется пойти на большой риск! Мне нужно знать, с кем я имею дело.
en: To accept you into the Conspiracy, I have to take a great risk! I need to know who I'm dealing with.
ko: 자네를 비밀결사에 들이기 위해 난 막대한 위험을 감수해야 하네! 그러니 내가 상대를 제대로 알아야 하지 않겠나.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_15_1
ru: Когда он стал одним из нас, то горел делом Заговора больше всех... Но, увы, выгорел дотла.
en: When he became one of us, he was burning with passion about the Conspiracy more than anyone else... But, alas, he burned out completely.
ko: 그자가 우리 동지가 되었을 땐, 그 누구보다 비밀결사의 대의에 뜨겁게 불타올랐었지... 하지만, 슬프게도, 완전히 전소되어 버렸네.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_16_1
ru: Но его уже давно не стало. К тебе приходила лишь оболочка, тихая и бледная тень прежнего человека.
en: But he was long gone. Only a shell, a quiet, pale shadow of the man he once was, came to you.
ko: 하지만 그자는 이미 오래전에 죽은 것이나 다름없었네. 자네를 찾아간 건 한때 사람이었던 껍데기, 창백하고 고요한 그림자에 불과했지.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Нам уже давно известно о тебе, мой друг.
en: We have known about you for a long time, my friend.
ko: 우린 오래전부터 자네를 알고 있었네, 내 친구여.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
ru: Теперь мы сможем узнать больше друг о друге.
en: Now we can learn more about each other.
ko: 이제 우린 서로에 대해 더 많은 것을 알게 될 걸세.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_HOTEL ESCAPE_Recruiting Conspiracy Call Encounter_Scenes_Description
en: Performance

ru: И я давно надеялся, что ты решишься присоединиться к нам, <username>.
en: And I've long hoped that you would decide to join us, <username>.
ko: 그리고 난 자네가 우리와 함께하기로 결단하기를 오랫동안 고대해 왔네, <username>.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ждал момента, когда ты будешь <male>готов</male><female>готова</female> прийти сюда и поднять трубку.
en: Waited for the moment when you would become ready to come here and pick up this phone.
ko: 자네가 이곳으로 와서 수화기를 들 <male>준비가 될</male><female>준비가 될</female> 순간만을 기다렸지.

context: Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Abandoned Inn (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman (Encounter)_Scenes_Greeting (Scene - (Abandoned Inn) First Call from Deadman)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
ru: ...Известным писателем, настоящей совестью нашей страны. Наверняка тебе довелось если не читать его книги, то слышать о нем.
en: ...A writer of great renown, the true conscience of our country. You've probably heard of him, if not read his books.

en: <male>He</male><female>She</female> must become a clerk in the Chancellery. Madam Baroness, please arrange this!
ko: <male>그는 관청의 관리가 되어야 합니다</male><female>그녀는 관청의 관리가 되어야 합니다</female>. 남작부인, 번거로우시겠지만 준비해 주십시오!

en: Where is <male>he</male><female>she</female> now, Leper?
ko: 문둥이, <male>그 친구는</male><female>그 친구는</female> 지금 어디 있소?

ru: <male>Он вырос</male><female>Она выросла</female> здесь, в Брокене, в простой семье.
en: <male>He grew up</male><female>She grew up</female> here in Brocken, in a simple family.
ko: <male>그는 이곳 브로켄의 평범한 집안에서 자랐소.</male><female>그녀는 이곳 브로켄의 평범한 집안에서 자랐소.</female>

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_31_1
ru: Сделаем. Мои связи тоже пока еще действуют.
en: Consider it done. My connections are also still in place.
ko: 그리하도록 하지요. 내 연줄도 아직은 쓸만하니까요.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_14_1
ru: Да вы что? Должно быть, я знакома с этим семейством...
en: You don't say! I must know this family then...
ko: 설마요! 그렇다면 저도 분명 알고 있는 집안이겠군요...

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_24_1
ru: В Столице, ваша светлость. Пытается выбраться сюда, в Брокен, пока город не закрыли насовсем.
en: In the Capital, Your Grace. Trying to get out here, to Brocken, before our City is sealed off completely.
ko: 수도에 머물고 있습니다, 각하. 도시가 완전히 봉쇄되기 전에 이곳 브로켄으로 빠져나오려고 안간힘을 쓰는 중이지요.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_21_1
ru: Это неважно. Сообщники нам нужны позарез...
en: It doesn't matter. We desperately need accomplices...
ko: 그건 중요치 않소. 우리에겐 지금 동지가 턱없이 부족하니까...

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_36_1
ru: Хотел бы я знать! Но на это сможет ответить только <male>он сам</male><female>она сама</female>. Что ж, мы ждем тебя, <username> <userlastname>.
en: I wish I knew that! But only <male>he</male><female>she</female> can give us answers. We're waiting for you, <username> <userlastname>.
ko: 나도 알 수 있다면 좋겠소! 하지만 그 대답은 <male>본인만이</male><female>본인만이</female> 해줄 수 있겠지. 기다리고 있겠네, <username> <userlastname>.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_13_1
ru: <male>Он вырос</male><female>Она выросла</female> здесь, в Брокене, в богатой семье.
en: <male>He grew up</male><female>She grew up</female> here in Brocken, in a wealthy family.
ko: <male>그는 이곳 브로켄의 유복한 집안에서 자랐소.</male><female>그녀는 이곳 브로켄의 유복한 집안에서 자랐소.</female>

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_27_1
ru: Нужно немедленно заняться приготовлениями. <male>Ему</male><female>Ей</female> понадобится прикрытие. Конспиративная квартира.
en: We need to make preparations. <male>He</male><female>She</female> will need cover. A safe house, as well.
ko: 당장 채비를 해야겠소. <male>그에게</male><female>그녀에게</female> 위장 신분이 필요할 거요. 안전가옥도 마련해야 하고 말이오.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_33_1
en: It's about damn time!

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_35_1
ru: И почему Семья так истово охотится именно за <male>ним</male><female>ней</female>? Хм...
en: And why is the Family hunting for <male>him</male><female>her</female> so fiercely? Hmm...
ko: 그런데 가문은 왜 유독 <male>그 친구를</male><female>그 친구를</female> 그렇게 지독하게 쫓는 걸까요? 흠...

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
en: <male>He found the Dead Man all by himself</male><female>She found the Dead Man all by herself</female>.
ko: <male>그 친구 혼자 힘으로 망자를 찾아냈더군</male><female>그 친구 혼자 힘으로 망자를 찾아냈더군</female>.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1
en: We have a new conspirator!

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_8_1
en: Oh, really? I thought the search had failed...
ko: 설마 정말이오? 난 수색이 실패한 줄 알았는데...

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_18_1
ru: <male>Связался</male><female>Связалась</female> со столичным дном. <male>Стал беглецом</male><female>Стала беглянкой</female>. Теперь скрывается от закона.
en: Got in touch with the Capital's underworld. Became a fugitive. Now hiding from the law.
ko: 수도의 밑바닥 세계와 얽혔더군. <male>도망자가 되어</male><female>도망자가 되어</female> 지금은 법을 피해 숨어 지내고 있소.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_32_1
ru: Мертвец проведет <male>его</male><female>ее</female> в Брокен. Я верю в это. За этим столом должно появиться еще одно место.
en: The Dead Man will get <male>him</male><female>her</female> all the way to Brocken. I believe it. There must be another seat at this table.
ko: 망자께서 <male>그를</male><female>그녀를</female> 브로켄까지 무사히 데려오실 거요. 난 믿소. 이 탁자에 빈자리 하나는 더 마련해 두어야겠지.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_11_1
ru: Сирота из Брокена, <male>вырос</male><female>выросла</female> тут без родителей.
en: An orphan from Brocken, grew up here without parents.
ko: 브로켄 출신의 고아로, 부모도 없이 이곳에서 자랐소.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_25_1
ru: Что мы можем сделать? Как <male>ему</male><female>ей</female> помочь?
en: What can we do? How can we help <male>him</male><female>her</female>?
ko: 우리가 무엇을 할 수 있겠소? <male>그를</male><female>그녀를</female> 어떻게 도울 수 있단 말이오?

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Верно. Со мной вышел на связь Мертвец.
en: That's right. The Dead Man contacted me.

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Здорово, душегубы! По-прежнему никого не сцапали? Так держать!
en: Hey, you scoundrels! Noone nabbed yet? Keep it up!
ko: 반갑군, 악당 놈들아! 아직 아무도 안 잡혀갔지? 계속 그렇게 잘 버텨보자고!

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Бросай свои шутки, Пуля. Кто созвал сходку?
en: Quit your joking, Bullet. Who called this meeting?
ko: 농담은 그만하게, 불렛. 접선은 누가 소집했나?

context: Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_(PROLOGUE) Payphone Briefing (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_(Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter_Scenes_Conspirators Intro (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Conspirators Discuss Player Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_17_1
ru: Нашего полку прибыло! Давно говорил, что нам нужны бойцы, проверенные фронтом!
en: Good, more proper army men! I've been saying for a long time that we need fighters who have been tested at the frontline!
ko: 우리 편에 새 식구가 늘었군! 전선에서 검증된 전투원이 필요하다고 내가 누누이 말해왔잖나!

context: Homecoming Talk (Scene - Train Compartment Conversation Encounter)

en: And are you one of our people, the Brocken people?
ko: 그쪽은 우리 고향 사람인가, 브로켄 출신이오?

context: Homecoming Talk (Scene - Train Compartment Conversation Encounter)

en: I work as an engineer at the Factory. You've probably heard of it?
ko: 난 공장에서 엔지니어로 일한다오. 들어는 봤겠지?

en: No jobs anywhere, and elections are just around the corner! It's just awful. But take care of yourself. Everything will work out!
ko: 일자리도 없고 선거도 코앞이니 흉흉하지요! 정말 끔찍한 세상입니다. 그래도 몸조심하십시오. 다 잘 풀릴 겁니다!

ru: Да ничего страшного! Просто нервы разыгрались. Сами знаете, какие сейчас времена...
en: It's nothing serious! I was just nervous. You know what times we're living through ...
ko: 별일 아닙니다! 그냥 신경이 좀 곤두섰을 뿐이에요. 시국이 이렇다 보니...

context: Explain Dread (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Concerned Citizen Interaction Encounter)

ko: 동감입니다. 요즘 같은 때엔 누구라도 미쳐버릴 지경이지요.

context: Take Help with Dread (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Concerned Citizen Interaction Encounter)

en: But believe me, everything will work out. I give you my word. Shake my hand.
ko: 그래도 믿으세요, 다 잘 해결될 겁니다. 장담하지요. 자, 악수나 한번 합시다.

context: Take Help with Dread (Action - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Concerned Citizen Interaction Encounter)

ko: 비가 이렇게 쏟아지는데 우산도 안 쓰셨군요. 온통 흠뻑 젖으시겠습니다!

en: Would you like me to at least lend you my umbrella? I live nearby, I can get there without one.
ko: 괜찮으시다면 제 우산이라도 빌려드릴까요? 전 집이 코앞이라 우산 없이도 금방 들어갑니다.

context: Common Offer - Umbrella (Scene - (Payphone Briefing Mission) Concerned Citizen Interaction Encounter)

en: You should get somewhere warm quickly, or you'll surely catch cold.
ko: 어서 따뜻한 곳으로 들어가셔야지요, 감기라도 호되게 걸리시겠습니다.

ko: 혹시 모르니까요. 자, 이거 받으셔서 병원에 갈 때까지 상처 부위라도 붕대로 감아두세요.

en: Don't relax yet! This is just the beginning, <username>!
ko: 아직 긴장 풀지 마! 이제 시작일 뿐이니까, <username>!

context: Start (Scene - Home Ruins Meet Conspirator Encounter)
detail: Encounters_PROLOGUE MISSIONS ENCOUNTERS_HOME RUINS MISSION ENCOUNTERS_Home Ruins Meet Conspirator Encounter_Scenes_Start (Scene - Home Ruins Meet Conspirator Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Пойдем со мной. Отведу тебя в наш штаб — там поговорим в безопасности.
en: Come with me. I'll take you to our headquarters—we'll talk there in safety.
ko: 날 따라와. 우리 본부로 데려다주지. 거기서 안전하게 얘기하자고.

context: Cafe Visit Witch Encounter (Encounter)

en: Enough questions. I'll let you go this time with just a warning.
ko: 질문은 그만해라. 이번에는 경고만 하고 널 보내주마.

context: End Conversation (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: I will not allow anyone to break it.
ko: 누구도 그 규칙을 깨뜨리지 못하게 할 것이다.

context: End Conversation (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Scenes_End Conversation (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Наслаждайся покоем моего кафе не мешая другим. Такой уговор между мной и Брокеном.
en: Enjoy the peace of my café without disturbing others. That's the agreement between me and Brocken.
ko: 다른 이들을 방해하지 말고 내 카페의 평화를 누리거라. 그게 나와 브로켄 사이의 약속이니까.

context: Piss Off (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: Goodbye. I hope we never meet again.
ko: 안녕히 계십시오. 다시는 마주치지 않기를 바라죠.

context: Piss Off (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: Hope, hope. Just keep yourself from catching my eye again.
ko: 그래, 어디 한번 바라보렴. 다시는 내 눈에 띄지 않도록 조심하는 게 좋을 게다.

context: Piss Off (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

ru: Иди с миром и смотри куда суешь руки в следующий раз.
en: Go in peace and watch where you put your hands next time.
ko: 평안히 가거라. 다음에는 함부로 손을 놀리지 않도록 조심하고.

context: Say Goodbye (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_End Conversation_Say Goodbye (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

en: Goodbye. I hope I didn't annoy you too much with my curiosity.
ko: 안녕히 계십시오. 제 호기심 때문에 너무 성가시게 해 드리지 않았기를 바랍니다.

context: Say Goodbye (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_End Conversation_Name

en: Well, as you wish.

en: I can't tell you anything more. And I don't want to.
ko: 네게 더 해줄 말은 없다. 해주고 싶지도 않고.

context: Clue on Master Of The City (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: Hidden beneath the city, out of sight.
ko: 도시 지하 깊은 곳에 숨겨져 있어, 사람들의 눈길이 닿지 않지.

context: Clue on Master Of The City (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Clue on Master Of The City (Scene - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Хозяин твой заточен, словно в клетке.
en: Your master is imprisoned, as if in a cage.
ko: 너의 주인은 새장에 갇힌 것처럼 갇혀 있지.

context: I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1

context: I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: История значит. Иногда прошлому лучше остаться в прошлом.
en: History means. Sometimes the past is better left in the past.
ko: 역사라. 때로는 과거를 그냥 과거로 묻어두는 편이 나은 법이다.

context: I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_I Like History (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Хотя я совру, если скажу, что мне не интереснно будет за этим посмотреть.
en: Although I would be lying if I said I wouldn't be interested in watching it.
ko: 물론 그걸 구경하는 게 흥미롭지 않다고 하면 거짓말이겠지만.

ru: Я интересуюсь историей города. Эта информация сильно бы помогла мне в моих... исследованиях.
en: I'm interested in the city's history. This information would greatly help me in my... research.
ko: 저는 이 도시의 역사에 관심이 있습니다. 이 정보는 제... 조사에 큰 도움이 될 겁니다.

context: Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1

en: He will only listen to someone who can give him what he needs.
ko: 그는 자신에게 필요한 것을 내어줄 수 있는 자의 말만 들을 게다.

context: Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Он может быть опасен, не сомневайся. Многие пытались с ним договариваться. Получалось у единиц.
en: He can be dangerous, no doubt about it. Many have tried to negotiate with him, but only a few have succeeded.
ko: 그는 위험한 자다. 의심할 여지도 없지. 수많은 이들이 그와 협상하려 했지만, 성공한 자는 손에 꼽을 정도야.

context: Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: И жестоко расправится с тем, кого посчитает препятствием.
en: And he will cruelly deal with anyone he considers an obstacle.
ko: 방해물이라 여겨지는 자는 누구든 잔혹하게 짓밟아버릴 게다.

context: Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Name
en: Is he dangerous?

detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Is he Dangerous (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

en: What, is something wrong? Is he dangerous?
ko: 왜 그러시죠, 무슨 문제라도 있습니까? 그자가 위험한 인물입니까?

context: Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1

en: <male>Brave or stupid?</male><female>Brave or stupid?</female> Both are possible.
ko: <male>용감한 것인가, 아니면 어리석은 것인가?</male><female>용감한 것인가, 아니면 어리석은 것인가?</female> 둘 다일지도 모르지.

context: Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_4_1
ru: Как мне бы хотелось узнать, что творится в твоей маленькой головушке. Может в другой раз.
en: I'd love to know what's going on in that little head of yours. Maybe another time.
ko: 네 그 조그만 머릿속에 무슨 생각이 들어있는지 참 궁금하구나. 그건 다음에 알아보기로 하지.

context: Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: В нем ты найдешь столько же союзника, сколько и еще одного тирана.
en: In him you will find as much an ally as you will find another tyrant.
ko: 그자에게서 동맹을 얻는 만큼이나 또 하나의 폭군을 마주하게 될 게다.

context: Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Ask About Master Of The City Actions_Name
en: Looking for allies

context: Looking For Allies (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

ru: Я ищу союзников. И думаю, что кем бы он ни был, Хозяин Города сможет помочь.
en: I'm looking for allies. And I think whoever he is, the Master of the City will be able to help.
ko: 저는 동맹을 찾고 있습니다. 그리고 그가 누구든 간에, '도시의 주인'이라면 분명 도움이 될 테니까요.

context: Ask About Master Of The City (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Ask About Master Of The City (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Ишь кого вспомнил. А зачем он тебе?
en: Look at who you remembered. Why do you need him?
ko: 거 참 대단한 자를 기억해냈구나. 그자는 대체 왜 필요한 거냐?

context: Ask About Master Of The City (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Ask About Master Of The City (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_1_1

en: Do you know anything about the essence of the "Master of the City"?
ko: "도시의 주인"의 정체에 대해 아시는 것이 있습니까?

context: Ask About Master Of The City (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Name
en: Master of the city

en: However, this has nothing to do with our practices.
ko: 하지만 그건 우리의 마법 실천과는 아무 상관이 없단다.

context: Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: How did you do it? Are you a witch?
ko: 어떻게 그런 일이 가능한가요? 혹시 마녀이신가요?

context: Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_5_1

en: It was simply that those who poured sweeter words into the ears of the people drove out those they did not like.
ko: 그저 사람들의 귀에 더 감미로운 말을 속삭이는 자들이, 마음에 안 드는 이들을 몰아냈을 뿐이지.

context: Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_2_1
ru: Называли по разному. Бросались словами и похуже.
en: They called me by different names. They even threw around worse words.
ko: 날 온갖 이름으로 부르더군. 그보다 훨씬 더 심한 욕설을 퍼붓기도 했고.

context: Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Name
en: Are you a witch?

context: Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)
detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Are You A Witch (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_3_1

en: Witches have always been held in low esteem in Brocken.
ko: 브로켄에서 마녀는 결코 환영받는 존재가 아니었단다.

context: Why No One Pays Attention (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

en: Where they can come and leave their fears and sorrows here.
ko: 손님들이 이곳에 와서 두려움과 슬픔을 내려놓고 갈 수 있도록 말이다.

context: Why No One Pays Attention (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

ko: 기이한 일들이야 도시에서도 지겹도록 볼 텐데.

context: Why No One Pays Attention (Action - Cafe Visit Witch Encounter)

ko: 이 카페에는 기이한 것들이 정말 많군요.

detail: Encounters_CAFE ENCOUNTERS_CAFE VISIT ENCOUNTERS_Cafe Visit Wtich Encounter_Actions_Conversation_Name
en: People don't see?
ko: 왜 아무도 신경 쓰지 않는지 묻기

ru: И был еще день, который запомнился навсегда. День, когда всё предвещало беду.

ko: 그리고 평생 잊지 못할 또 다른 날이 있었다. 모든 것이 재앙을 예고하던 그날이었다.

ko: 누구도 브로켄시에 대체 무슨 일이 일어난 건지 설명하지 못했다. 하지만 불길한 소문들이 걷잡을 수 없이 퍼져나갔다...

context: Downfall Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Downfall Exposition (Encounter)
detail: Encounters_HERO GENERATION ENCOUNTERS_(Hero Generation) Downfall Exposition (Encounter)_Scenes_Downfall Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Downfall Exposition (Encounter)_MainTacts_Text_6_1

ko: 도시의 모든 돈이—주머니 속의 푼돈도, 지갑도, 은행의 금고도—전부 재가 되어 사라졌다.

ko: 기계와 설비들이 돌연 인간의 말을 듣지 않기 시작했다. 공장이 멈추어 섰다.

ko: 목적을 위해서라면 무엇이든 할 수 있다는 걸 보여줘 봐! 약속하지, 날 죽일 각오가 되어 있다면... 망자에게 닿을 단서를 주겠다!

en: As you grew older, you learned more and more about your hometown. It turns out this place is full of secrets that even adults only whisper about.
ko: 자라면서 고향에 대해 점점 더 많은 사실들을 알게 되었다. 이곳은 어른들조차도 은밀히 수군거리는 수많은 비밀들로 가득 차 있었다.

en: I'll get at least a little piece from you to chew... Lie down, lie down, and I'll eat you in the meantime.
ko: 네 살점이라도 한 입 얻어 씹어야겠다… 누워 있어, 가만히. 마저 먹을 테니.

context: People Discussion (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)

ru: Ну, началось! И вы объясните нам, неразумным, что делать, поведете за собой... Знаем мы вас, умников! Толку от вас никакого.
en: Here we go again! I suppose you’re going to explain to us fools what to do and lead the way... We know your bookworm kind! Useless, the lot of you.
ko: 또 시작이네! 우리 같은 무지렁이들에게 뭘 해야 할지 가르치고 앞장서서 이끌겠다 이거지... 먹물 든 놈들 행태를 우리가 모를 줄 알고? 너희 같은 자들은 백날 있어 봐야 쓸모없어.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation City Pact with Traums)

ru: В чем же он заключался? Никто вам так и не объяснил. Горожане всерьез отнеслись к своей клятве ни с кем не обсуждать это.
en: What were the terms of this agreement? No one ever explained it to you. The townspeople took their secret oath to heart.
ko: 그 조건이 무엇이었는지는 아무도 설명해 주지 않았다. 주민들은 비밀을 지키겠다는 맹세를 철저히 지켰다.

en: Give me the sharpness of your <color=#FF88A7FF>nerves</color>

detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_17 - (Hero Generation) Major Stat Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Lady Speech (Scene - Hero Generation Major Stat Choice)_MainTacts_Text_5_1
ru: Мир взрослых людей захватит тебя и завертит в своем круговороте. Будет все трудней и трудней помнить о том, что ты <male>знал</male><female>знала</female> еще с рождения.
en: The world of adults will capture you and spin you around in its whirlwind. It will become harder and harder to remember what you have known since birth.
ko: 어른들의 세상이 널 붙들고 소용돌이 속으로 끌어들일 거야. 태어날 때부터 알던 것들조차 갈수록 기억하기 어려워지겠지.

context: Lady Speech (Scene - Hero Generation Major Stat Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_17 - (Hero Generation) Major Stat Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Lady Speech (Scene - Hero Generation Major Stat Choice)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Тебе нужно суметь сохранить себя. Не дать себя сломить. Помни, что я на твоей стороне — и ты выдержишь что угодно.
en: You must find a way to keep you whole. Don't let those hardships crush you. Remember that I'm on your side—and you can endure anything.
ko: 그 속에서도 너 자신을 지킬 길을 찾아야 해. 마음이 꺾여서는 안 돼. 내가 네 편이라는 걸 기억하렴. 그러면 무엇이든 견뎌 낼 수 있어.

context: Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Major Stat Choice)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_17 - (Hero Generation) Major Stat Choice (Encounter)_Scenes_Time Goes By (Scene - Hero Generation Major Stat Choice)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: А вы уже навсегда покидали детство...
en: And you were at the treshold of adulthood...
ko: 그렇게 어린 시절을 영영 뒤로하고 성인의 문턱에 들어서게 되었다...

context: Profession Choice (Scene - (Hero Generation) Brocken Profession Choosing)

ru: Город все еще оправлялся от последствий Краха. С работой было туго. Денег платили мало. Но для вас это не было преградой.
en: The City was still recovering from the aftermath of the Collapse. Jobs were scarce. Wages were low. But that couldn't stop you.
ko: 도시는 여전히 대붕괴의 여파에서 회복 중이었다. 일자리는 귀했고 보수는 짰다. 하지만 그것도 가로막진 못했다.

context: Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_21 - (Hero Generation) Traums Return (Encounter)_Scenes_Traums Appear (Scene - Hero Generation Traums Return)_MainTacts_Text_9_1
ru: Единственная весть, что была обнародована на весь Город: "Семья Траум вернулась и готова исполнить свое обещание. Они знают, как спасти Брокен от упадка и сделают это!"
en: The only news that was released to the entire City was, "The Traum Family has returned and is ready to keep their promise. They know how to save Brocken from the collapse, and they will do it!"
ko: 도시에 전해진 유일한 소식은 이러했습니다. '트라움 가문이 돌아왔으며, 약속을 지킬 준비가 되었습니다. 그들은 브로켄을 몰락에서 구원할 방법을 알고 있으며, 반드시 해낼 것입니다!'

context: Long Night Exposition (Scene - (Hero Generation) Long Night Setup (Encounter)

en: If only your hatred were put to good use... Give up your silly hatred, my dear, and everything will be fine with you. No one will touch you.

ru:
Теперь же люди готовы делать что угодно за жалкий десяток крон в день.
Но внутри страны лютует безработица, правительство в бесконечных кризисах, а снаружи подбирается Мировая война...
en:
Now, people are willing to do anything for a measly ten crowns a day.
The country is in turmoil: unemployment is rampant, the government is mired in one crisis after another, and a world war is looming beyond the borders.
ko:
지금 사람들은 하루에 고작 10 크라운을 벌기 위해 무슨 짓이든 기꺼이 하려 한다.
나라는 혼란에 빠져 있다. 실업이 만연하고, 정부는 연이은 위기에 휩싸여 있으며, 국경 너머에서는 세계대전이 임박해 있다.

이 <color=#FF8000FF>신체</color>는 오직 당신에게 주어졌다. 당신을 위해 움직이고, 당신을 위해 숨을 쉰다.
이 몸이 살아 있는 한, 당신도 살아 있다.

ko: 붕괴는 영원히 내면에 남는다. 벼랑 끝의 위급한 상황에서 당신을 구해줄 수도 있다.

context: Get Fracture - Veteran (Scene - Hero Generation Adult Life - Veteran)
detail: Missions_PROLOGUE Missions_Hero Generation (Mission)_ENCOUNTERS_38 - (Hero Generation) Return from Crisis (Encounter)_Scenes_Get Fracture - Veteran (Scene - Hero Generation Adult Life - Veteran)_MainTacts_Text_3_1
ru: Ваш Надлом навсегда внутри вас. В чрезвычайной ситуации, на краю, он сможет спасти вас. Вы потеряете голову, мысленно вернувшись на передовую, но обретете безумную силу, чтобы уничтожить любое препятствие на пути.
en: Your Fracture is forever within you. In an emergency, on the brink, it can save you. You'll lose your head, mentally returning to the front lines, but you'll gain an insane strength to destroy any obstacle in your path.
ko: 당신의 <color=#D19B9BFF>붕괴</color>는 영원히 당신 안에 남습니다. 벼랑 끝의 위급한 상황에서 당신을 구해줄 수 있습니다. 이성을 잃고 마음은 전선으로 되돌아가겠지만, 앞길을 가로막는 어떤 장애물도 파괴할 수 있는 광적인 힘을 얻게 됩니다.

context: Greet (Action - (Hero Generation) Meet Meet Soul of City)

ru: Какое смышленое дитя! Здравствуй и ты. Но отчего же ты не идешь ко мне?
en: What a bright child! Hello to you too. But why don't you come to me?
ko: 참 영리한 아이로구나! 그래, 안녕. 헌데 왜 내게 오지 않는 거니?

context: Greet (Action - (Hero Generation) Meet Meet Soul of City)

ru: Держись поодаль, если тебе так угодно. Но знай, мои объятия всегда открыты тебе.
en: Keep your distance if you choose so. But know that my arms are always open to you.
ko: 원한다면 거리를 두어도 좋단다. 하지만 내 품은 언제나 너를 향해 열려 있단다.

en: Know this: as long as you are under my care, you shall never know fear.
ko: 기억하렴. 내 보살핌 아래에 있는 한, 결코 두려워할 필요가 없단다.

ko: 아이야, 제발 이 짧은 순간을 잊지 말아다오. 언젠가 이것이 얼마나 큰 의미였는지 깨닫게 될 날이 올 테니.

ru: Смотри, свет по-прежнему горит. Теперь он стал равен тебе, ты сможешь с ним совладать.
en: Look, the light still burns—but now you can harness it.
ko: 보렴, 빛은 여전히 타고 있단다. 이제는 네가 그 빛을 다룰 수 있을 게야.

ko: 빛을 보렴! 그 광채를 기억해 두어라. 이토록 밝고 순수한 빛은 단 한 번뿐이란다.
